At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

As a Manufacturing Engineer, you are responsible for developing and maintaining methods, operating sequences, and processes in the fabrication of parts, components, subassemblies, and final assemblies. You'll work closely with other engineering functions to coordinate the release of product improvements and new products, and you'll use engineering principles to estimate and reduce manufacturing costs, improve product quality, determine time standards, and make recommendations for tooling and process requirements. Your expertise in lean principles, automation, and continuous improvement will be instrumental in driving operational excellence and achieving higher levels of productivity and cost-effectiveness. You'll develop and use test procedures, evaluate test results, and assess work methods, procedures, and policies to identify root cause issues and solutions that ensure operational success.

Who We Are

Applied Materials is the leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. Our expertise in modifying materials at atomic levels and on an industrial scale enables customers to transform possibilities into reality. At Applied Materials, our innovations Make Possible® a Better Future.

Job Summary

Applied Materials is seeking a Weld Engineer to own weld process development, qualification, and continuous improvement for precision mechanical, vacuum, and gas/chemical delivery assemblies used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment. This role partners with design engineering, quality, and manufacturing to develop robust weld procedures, qualify welders and equipment, troubleshoot production issues, and drive root-cause corrective action for weld-related defects, all within a high-purity, ultra-clean fabrication environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, qualify, and document Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS) and Procedure Qualification Records (PQR) for orbital GTAW, manual GTAW, and other applicable welding processes on stainless steel and specialty alloys.
  • Define and validate weld parameters (current, travel speed, purge, filler selection) for new product introductions and design changes, in partnership with mechanical and product design engineering.
  • Lead welder and welding-operator performance qualification (WPQ) programs; evaluate and certify welders/orbital equipment against internal and industry standards.
  • Investigate weld-related nonconformances and field failures; perform root-cause analysis (e.g., fishbone, 5-why, DOE) and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  • Specify and review nondestructive and destructive testing (NDT/DT) methods, including dye penetrant, radiographic, helium leak, and cross-section/metallurgical evaluation, to verify weld integrity.
  • Collaborate with suppliers and internal manufacturing teams to resolve weld quality issues and drive process capability (Cpk) improvements.
  • Support new equipment and tooling qualification for orbital welding heads, power supplies, purge systems, and fixturing.
  • Author and maintain engineering specifications, work instructions, and training materials related to welding processes and cleanliness requirements.
  • Support cost reduction, cycle-time reduction, and yield improvement initiatives across fabrication lines.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable codes and standards (ASME Section IX, AWS D1.1/D1.6, SEMI, customer-specific specifications) and support internal/external audits.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Welding Engineering, Materials Science/Metallurgical Engineering, or a related field required; advanced degree a plus.
  • Typically 2-4 years of relevant experience in welding/joining engineering, manufacturing engineering, or process engineering, ideally in semiconductor, aerospace, medical device, or other high-purity/high-precision manufacturing industries.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and qualifying WPS/PQR documentation and leading welder qualification programs.
  • Prior experience with orbital and manual GTAW welding of stainless steel and exotic alloys (e.g., Hastelloy, Inconel) is required.

Certifications & Technical Qualifications

  • Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) preferred; Certified Welding Engineer (CWEng) or progress toward CWEng a plus.
  • Working knowledge of ASME Section IX, AWS D1.1/D1.6, and SEMI high-purity gas/chemical delivery standards.
  • Familiarity with NDT methods (PT, RT, helium leak testing) and interpretation of metallurgical cross-sections.
  • Experience with root-cause and quality tools such as 8D, FMEA, DOE, and statistical process control (SPC).
  • Proficiency with CAD/PLM tools (e.g., SolidWorks, Creo, Windchill) and standard MES/ERP systems a plus.

Skills & Abilities

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate metallurgical and process data into practical manufacturing solutions.
  • Solid understanding of materials science, metallurgy, and heat-affected-zone behavior in stainless steel and specialty alloys.
  • Effective cross-functional communicator, able to work with design engineering, quality, supply chain, and production teams.
  • Comfortable working hands-on with welding equipment and operators on the shop floor as well as at a desk generating engineering documentation.
  • Self-directed with strong project management skills; able to prioritize across multiple concurrent initiatives.

Work Environment

  • Role is based primarily on-site to support welder qualification, process trials, and shop-floor troubleshooting, with some flexibility for hybrid work depending on business needs.
  • Requires occasional presence in fabrication shop and cleanroom-adjacent environments; use of PPE (safety glasses, welding shade lenses, gloves) as required when observing or conducting weld trials.
  • Some domestic and limited international travel to support supplier qualification and multi-site manufacturing.

Additional Information

  • Relocation: Eligible for this position.

title: Manufacturing Technician II - Sterile Injection - 12-Hr Day Shift 2-2-3
description:
At Alcami, we deliver reliable solutions that unlock the potential of transformative medicines from discovery to commercialization, through trusted partnership with our clients, recognized industry expertise and proven regulatory track record.

Are you interested in joining our team?

Job Summary

The Manufacturing Technician II (Compound/Fill/Finish) is accountable for results in a fast-paced environment and assists with the manufacturing of sterile injectable products in vial and syringe configurations for clinical/commercial distribution. The Manufacturing Tech II is a key role responsible for executing advanced production tasks involving compound, fill and finish processes for sterile injectable pharmaceutical products executed via aseptic isolator technology. This position entails a high level of technical expertise in aseptic processes requiring single-use components, ability to troubleshoot, and responsibility for maintaining quality and compliance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP). The Manufacturing Tech. II performs the operation of manufacturing processing equipment by following standard operating procedures (SOPs) and batch records in accordance with regulatory agencies and current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMPs). The Manufacturing Tech. II employs acceptable techniques while working in manufacturing environments, including PPE gowning. The candidate must have the ability to learn specific department procedures, have a general understanding of Good Documentation Practices (GDP) and GMP, and follow directions from leadership/peers to ensure manufacturing goals are met.

On-Site Expectations

  • 100% on-site position.
  • Day Shift: 12-Hour Rotating (2-2-3), 7:00am - 7:00pm.

Responsibilities

  • Learns and executes manufacturing operations, including setup, operation, and maintenance of equipment used in dispensing, compounding, filling (isolators), and visual inspection.
  • Become a subject matter expert (SME) on compounding/filling processes and equipment.
  • Performs production processes with adherence to SOPs, batch records, quality standards, and minimally contributes deviations to maintain product quality.
  • Conducts in-process and end-of-process sampling/quality checks, ensuring all manufactured products meet rigorous standards.
  • Identifies inefficiencies and escalates to area supervision real-time to support continuous process improvement.
  • Maintains accurate and detailed production documentation. Documentation is completed legibly with minimum errors and recommendations are escalated to drive document revisions to reduce errors.
  • Ensures timely completion and compliance with cGMP and all other relevant company training requirements.
  • Demonstrates technical ability in general manufacturing technologies and utilizes technologies per SOPs and cGMPs.
  • Performs in-process sampling, weight checks, and component counting and basic math calculations.
  • Performs in-process inspection and finished product visual inspection.
  • Performs cleaning of rooms, tools, and equipment before and after use.
  • Assists with other manufacturing areas as required.
  • Performs activities right first time in areas of material handling/dispensing, compounding, and filling.
  • Follows general instructions on routine work and detailed instructions on new projects or assignments.
  • Follows all Safety requirements and leads by example a safety-first culture.

  • Works occasional hours outside of scheduled shift based on business needs, which may include weekend work.

  • Other duties as assigned.

Manufacturing Technologies for Sterile Liquids (including but may not be limited to):

  • Equipment and component preparation and sterilization (i.e., filter integrity testing, autoclaving, parts wrapping)
  • Compounding
  • Vial Washing / Depyrogenation
  • Aseptic Filling / Stoppering / Capping
  • Lyophilization
  • Visual Inspection
  • Facility Cleaning/Sanitation
  • Documentation Review (Batch Record, Logbooks, etc.)

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED is required. Associate or bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • 1-2 years’ work experience required; 2-5 years preferred.
  • Prior work experience in a cGMP pharmaceutical manufacturing environment required.
  • Previous experience in dispensing, compounding, aseptic filling, or visual inspection highly desirable.
  • Candidates with life sciences or engineering degrees will be considered without manufacturing experience.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, works collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Proven ability to operate, troubleshoot, and maintain complex manufacturing equipment.
  • Applies job skills, company policies, and SOPs to complete a variety of assignments.
  • Strong detail orientation and organizational skills required.
  • Strong problem-solving and basic trouble-shooting ability required.
  • Ability to perform basic math calculations.
  • Ability to read and comprehend detailed written instructions and apply instructions during execution is required.
  • Ability to move materials throughout the facility using appropriate methods and equipment required.
  • Ability to use the appropriate PPE based on product handling requirements (i.e. PAPR, Supplied Air Respirator, etc.).
  • General compounding equipment (pH meters, mixers, stir plates, rigid/soft vessels)
  • Single-use solution pathway parts including aseptic connectors and filtration assemblies
  • Drug Product fillers including isolators
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to detect minute defects or discrepancies in product appearance.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively train and certify employees.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and support operations at variable capacities. Ideal candidates must readily adapt to variable operations required batch to batch.
  • Basic computer skills (Microsoft Office) and familiarity with electronic documentation systems is preferred.

Travel Expectations

  • Up to 5% domestic travel expected.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met or encountered by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; talk or hear and smell. The employee is frequently required to walk; climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 25 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds, occasionally lift and/or move up to 75 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move over 75 pounds with assistance. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. The employee must have 20/20 vision (with or without corrective lenses) and must possess the ability to pass a color-blind test.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to moving mechanical parts, fumes or airborne particles and toxic or caustic chemicals. The employee is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions; high, precarious places; risk of electrical shock and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. The employee will be required to wear the appropriate personal protective equipment for specific job duties to be performed. Such personal protective equipment may include, but not limited to safety eyewear, hearing protection, various types of respirators/breathing apparatus, lab coats, full protective body coverings, various types of gloves, etc. The use of tight-fitting respirators limits facial hair for proper protection. Based on product, the use of PAPR or supplied air respirator may be required. Regulations may require employees to participate in routine medical surveillance. description:

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced MuleSoft Developer to design, build, and operate enterprise integration solutions on the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform. In this role you will own the integration lifecycle, including API design, flow development, deployment, observability, and ongoing optimization. The ideal candidate will combine deep hands-on MuleSoft experience with strong API-led connectivity practices, and will partner with enterprise architects, application teams, and integration partners to deliver reliable, secure, and reusable integration assets. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

  • Solid understanding of API-led connectivity and RAML/OAS API design.
  • Hands-on experience with CloudHub, Runtime Fabric, or Hybrid deployment.
  • Experience with API security standards (OAuth2, mTLS, JWT) and Anypoint API Manager.

  • Familiarity with event-driven integration using Anypoint MQ or Kafka.

Preferred Qualifications

title: Senior AI Backend Engineer
description:
About Galaxy
Galaxy is a global leader in digital assets and AI infrastructure, delivering solutions that accelerate progress in finance and artificial intelligence. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in New York City, we serve institutions, startups, protocols, and investors across a platform spanning trading, asset management, tokenization, and large-scale AI and high-performance computing data centers. This role sits on the AI products team, a small, high-ownership group that takes ideas from prototype to production and ships them at scale.
Why you'll want this role
• Greenfield, high-ownership work: build new AI products end to end, rather than maintaining legacy systems.
• Real impact: your work ships to institutional and individual clients and runs in production, not stuck in prototype.
• Modern stack: hands-on with LLMs, agentic systems, and AWS-native AI services.
Role Overview
As a Backend Engineer on our AI Products team, you will design, build, and operate the backend services that power products across Galaxy. You will work with product and engineering teams to implement features end-to-end, from data model to API to production deployment.
Many of these products integrate with Galaxy's AI Suite, our internal platform for Generative and Agentic AI, built on AWS Bedrock, AgentCore, and SageMaker. Day to day, you'll mostly be consuming that platform, calling its APIs, wiring LLM and RAG-based features into application logic, and reasoning about prompts and model behavior as part of building a good product, rather than building or owning the platform itself. From time to time, though, you may be asked to contribute directly to the AI stack, so foundational AI knowledge is important.
Key Responsibilities
Backend Engineering
• Design, build, and maintain backend services and REST APIs that power Galaxy products
• Design data models and schemas, and work with relational and other data stores as appropriate
• Apply strong software engineering and distributed systems principles to day-to-day development
• Write automated tests and maintain CI/CD pipelines for reliable, repeatable deployments
• Diagnose and resolve production issues related to latency, reliability, and data quality
AI Integration
• Integrate backend services with Galaxy's AI Suite (Bedrock, AgentCore, SageMaker-based APIs) built and maintained by the AI Platform team
• Wire LLM, embedding, and RAG-based capabilities exposed by the AI Suite into application features
• Apply prompt engineering and function calling at the application level to build reliable AI-powered features
• Contribute to testing and quality checks for AI-driven features from a product/application perspective
Cross-Stack Contribution
• Contribute across the stack as needed, such as data pipelines, infrastructure, or frontend touchpoints, depending on team and project needs
• Partner with full stack engineers, the AI Platform team, and data teams to deliver features end-to-end
• Balance delivery speed with code quality, maintainability, and operational health
Collaboration & Growth
• Work closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate requirements into working software
• Collaborate with the AI Platform team to stay current on AI Suite capabilities and best practices for consuming them
• Share knowledge with other engineers on backend and AI-integration best practices

  • Mandatory Technical Skills
    7+ years of experience into
    Programming & Engineering
    • Python
    • REST API design and development
    • CI/CD pipelines
    • Automated testing
    • Distributed systems fundamentals
    • Relational database design (e.g. PostgreSQL)
    CI/CD & Infrastructure
    • Kubernetes
    • Terraform
    • Docker
    • Jenkins experience is a plus
    AI Familiarity
    • Working familiarity with Generative AI / LLM concepts: RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, function calling
    • Experience integrating applications with LLM or AI platform APIs (e.g. AWS Bedrock or equivalent); deep agentic architecture or model training experience is not required
    • Comfortable reasoning about prompt behavior and AI output quality from an application/product perspective
    Cloud Platforms
    • Working experience with AWS (or equivalent cloud platform)
    • Exposure to core AWS services such as Lambda, API Gateway, S3, and CloudWatch is a plus
    Data Platforms
    • Databricks experience is a plus
    Production & Operations
    • Observability (logs, metrics, tracing, alerts)
    • Monitoring and reliability engineering
    • Performance tuning and cost optimization
    Security
    • Experience implementing AuthN/AuthZ (OAuth2/OIDC, SSO), RBAC, and secrets management in production applications
    Soft Skills
    • Strong communication skills; comfortable presenting technical recommendations directly to engineering and business stakeholders
    Nice to Haves
    Domain
    • Experience working within the financial services domain is preferred
    • Prior experience across Capital Markets, Digital Assets/Crypto, or AI infrastructure is highly desirable
    • Awareness of the regulatory and compliance landscape relevant to financial services technology delivery
    AI & Product
    • Experience building applications on top of LLM/agentic AI platforms (e.g. AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, or equivalent)
    • Familiarity with vector databases and embeddings (e.g. pgvector) for AI-powered search/retrieval features
    • Ability to evaluate AI feature quality from a product/UX lens (accuracy, latency, hallucination handling, graceful degradation), distinct from model-level evaluation owned by the AI Platform team

Why Version 1?

At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

  • Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
  • Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
  • Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance
  • Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme
  • Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
  • Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
  • Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards & ‘Call-Out’ platform.
  • Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.

And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.

Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer.

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend
description:
Role Description

Cresta’s AI Agent team is building enterprise-grade AI Agents that can operate inside real-world contact center environments. A critical part of that mission is enabling our AI Agents to seamlessly integrate with customers’ CCaaS platforms (Contact Center as a Service), including voice and digital channels — and to smoothly transition conversations between AI and human agents when needed.

This role is focused on building the backend systems that allow our AI Agents to:

  • Integrate deeply with leading CCaaS platforms
  • Participate in live customer conversations across voice and chat
  • Maintain full conversation state and context
  • Perform real-time actions within the CCaaS ecosystem
  • Seamlessly hand off conversations to human agents — without losing context, history, or workflow state
  • Support human agents with AI assistance after transfer

We are looking for strong backend engineers who want to work at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time communication, enterprise integrations, and AI Agent orchestration. This is not a pure research role — it is about building production-grade infrastructure that enables AI Agents to operate reliably in mission-critical customer environments.

Why This Role Is Unique:

  • AI + Real-Time Systems: Work on infrastructure that enables AI Agents to participate in live conversations at scale.
  • Enterprise-Grade Integrations: Design robust integrations with major CCaaS platforms and customer systems.
  • Human-AI Collaboration: Build the systems that make AI-to-human handoff seamless, contextual, and reliable.
  • High-Impact Engineering: Your work directly determines how smoothly AI Agents operate in production environments.

If you’re a strong backend engineer who wants to apply your expertise to real-world AI systems operating inside complex enterprise ecosystems, this role offers that opportunity.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience building scalable backend systems in production environments.
  • Strong experience designing and maintaining robust APIs (REST, gRPC).
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems and real-time communication architectures.
  • Experience integrating with third-party enterprise platforms and APIs.
  • Experience working with CCaaS platforms or contact center systems is a strong plus.
  • Familiarity with AI Agents, Virtual Agents, or LLM-based systems is a plus.
  • Experience with containerized environments (Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Strong understanding of system reliability, observability, and security in enterprise environments.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build scalable backend services that integrate Cresta’s AI Agents with customers’ CCaaS platforms.
  • Architect systems that manage real-time conversation state, context propagation, and session lifecycle.
  • Implement seamless AI-to-human handoff mechanisms, ensuring full context transfer and minimal disruption to the customer experience.
  • Develop secure and reliable integrations with CCaaS APIs (voice, chat, messaging, routing, agent desktop, etc.).
  • Collaborate closely with ML engineers and AI researchers to operationalize AI Agent capabilities in live environments.
  • Ensure high availability, low latency, and strong observability for real-time conversation systems.
  • Implement authentication, authorization, compliance, and enterprise security best practices across integrations.
  • Drive improvements in reliability, performance, and scalability in production environments handling high interaction volumes.

Benefits

  • We offer Cresta employees a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit you and your family’s needs.
  • Paid parental leave to support you and your family.
  • Monthly Health & Wellness allowance.
  • Work from home office stipend to help you succeed in a remote environment.

title: Rotating Equipment Reliability Engineer
description:
An exciting career awaits you

At MPC, we’re committed to being a great place to work – one that welcomes new ideas, encourages diverse perspectives, develops our people, and fosters a collaborative team environment.

Rotating Equipment Reliability Engineer

Job Summary

The Marathon Los Angeles Refinery, located in Carson/Wilmington CA, is seeking a Rotating Equipment Reliability Engineer to maintain and improve operational availability, optimize equipment life cycle cost, and achieve best in class reliability. This position supports operating area teams on issues related to rotating equipment and collaborates with other departments daily. The Rotating Equipment Reliability Engineer will support troubleshooting machinery issues, develop project requests, implement new solutions, and lead reliability programs.

The onsite schedule for the position is 4 days - 10 hours days - Monday-Thursday - core hour 7 AM - 3:30 PM, after hours calls that can be handled over the phone can occur once a month and support of TAR once every two years.

Key Responsibilities:

Maintenance and Area Team Support

  • Serve as a technical resource to the Maintenance Machinery Supervisors, Technicians, and Operations to troubleshoot, diagnose, and repair rotating equipment.

  • Develop and provide training on rotating equipment and support systems for Maintenance and Operations personnel.

  • Lead site reliability programs and initiatives including Incident Investigations (using RCFA methods), Lost Opportunity Tracking, Pump Seal Reliability Program, PM Optimization, and Area Team Threats Neutralization Program to identify opportunities for improvement and drive solutions.

  • Leads multi-department investigation teams to solve recurring rotating equipment failures

  • Submit and approve equipment Preventative Maintenance (PM) plans to ensure compliance with Refinery Standard Practices and reliability initiatives.

  • Perform equipment condition assessments to determine fitness for service and to develop equipment care and repair plans. Review equipment repair reports from outside shops, provide input on inspection requirements and approve repair plans ensuring compliance with Marathon specifications.

  • Identify critical equipment spare part requirements and ensure warehouse storage is aligned with the plan.

  • Identify and maintain a list of obsolete equipment and manages the replacement/upgrade plan.

  • Interface with MPC Rotating Equipment Advisory Group to share lessons learned and best practices. Engage management to champion specification changes to improve equipment reliability and department efficiency.

Projects and TAR Support

  • Develop Project Request Forms (PRFs) for reliability improvements.

  • Develop, submit, and ensure MM/TAR scope is well justified, documented correctly, and meets maintenance specifications and industry best practices.

  • Define expectations and project deliverables related to Mechanical Integrity and reliability requirements, as well as site preferred technologies and methodologies.

  • Review project documentation, P&ID’s, and data sheets to ensure accuracy.

  • Provide technical support to Major Maintenance (MM) and Turnaround (TAR) execution team, assisting with equipment inspection, QA/QC, and FCO process.

Health, Safety, Environmental and Mechanical Integrity Stewardship

  • Participate in safety walks and field audits on a regular basis.

  • Serve as a technical resource to the Process Safety Department during Area Team HAZOP reviews.

  • Lead or support incident investigations to determine root cause and identify corrective actions.

  • Support MOC process and ensure that technical documentation is maintained per company policy.

  • Champion Mechanical Integrity program and the Major Equipment Deficiency process with key stakeholders.

Personal Development

  • Maintain a personal development plan and attend training to foster professional development to support career goals.

Education, Experience and Skills

Minimum Qualifications

  • Must have Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering.

  • Must have at least 3 years of post-degree engineering experience. Experience needs to be in maintenance, machinery or engineering in a refinery, petro-chemical or other related heavy industry.

  • Must have experience interpreting and applying industrial and company standards.

  • Must have strong understanding of Management of Change requirements and process.

  • Must be able to understand mechanical systems and cross-section drawings to troubleshoot field equipment.

  • Must be proficient in Microsoft 365: Word, Excel and Outlook.

  • Must be able to successfully communicate complex system information across various audiences, from hourly personnel to Refinery management.

  • Must be able to wear appropriate PPE in the refinery (respirator), be able to physically perform all tasks in the field and take hair drug test and physical.

  • Must have a valid driver’s license.

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the US without the need for future VISA sponsorship. Details on what VISAs require Company Sponsorships examples are as follows: H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa.

  • Travel Requirement is less than 5%.

  • Must be able to work the onsite schedule for the position is 4 days - 10 hours days - Monday-Thursday - core hour 7 AM - 3:30 PM, after hours calls that can be handled over the phone can occur once a month and support of TAR once every two years.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong working knowledge of all applicable industry standards for rotating equipment is preferred.

  • Experience in the operation, maintenance and troubleshooting of rotating equipment such as pumps, turbines, centrifugal compressors, and reciprocating compressors is preferred.

  • Experience with machinery control systems such as anti-surge protection systems, turbine governors and overspeed protection, and performance control software is preferred.

  • Experience in the use of machinery condition monitoring tools such as Bently Nevada System 1, Emerson CSI, Prognost, and Windrock is preferred.

  • Experience in the installation of large machinery equipment, including foundation design, grouting, pipe strain, and alignment is preferred.

  • Working knowledge and application experience of RCM principles, RCFA and FMEA methodology and application is preferred.

  • Experience utilizing CMMS software. SAP experience is preferred.

Relocation may be available.

This job will posted through August 10, 2026.

This position belongs to a family of jobs with increasing responsibility, competency and skill level. Actual position title and pay grade will be based on the selected candidate’s experience and qualifications.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
Are you excited by the prospect of working with innovative security products?

Do solving some of the Internet's most difficult security challenges interest you?

Partner with the best

Join Akamai's Application & API Security team as an Senior Solution Architect Architect. You will work directly with some of the world's largest enterprises. You will design, integrate, and optimize security solutions across cloud, Kubernetes, networking, and API infrastructures. Highly hands-on technical role with strategic architectural exposure. You'll help customers deploy and operationalize API Security solutions as their primary role.

Become a Technical Influencer

This role supports customers in leveraging Akamai technologies for application and API protection. It suits individuals passionate about resolving technical challenges and enhancing skills in enterprise architecture and security. Responsibilities encompass aiding efforts in App and API Security, WAF, Bot Management, AI-driven protections, CDN, Zero Trust, and cloud security solutions.

As a Technical Solution Architect, you will be responsible for:

  • Integrating and leading the deployment of the API Security Platform and its components across diverse enterprise ecosystems.
  • Resolving deployment issues across Kubernetes platforms, virtual appliances, cloud infrastructure, networking, API gateways, authentication flows, hybrid architectures, and distributed applications.
  • Acting as a partner to customer engineering, DevOps, cloud, networking, or security teams to deploy and operationalize Akamai API Security Platform.
  • Analyzing API traffic to identify misconfigurations, authentication gaps, performance bottlenecks.
  • Supporting configuration of in/out-bound traffic sources for major API gateways and platforms (such as F5, Citrix, Apigee, Kong, NGINX, or MuleSoft).
  • Developing enterprise architecture diagrams, integration patterns, deployment plans, and operational runbooks.
  • Leading customer workshops, technical enablement sessions, and architectural reviews.

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Possess adequate role-experience and customer-facing skills.
  • Demonstrate extensive experience in architecting IaaS solutions for customers. Hold professional certifications from AWS/GCP/Azure/Oracle and/or CNCF.
  • Have experience troubleshooting distributed cloud-native applications and debugging skills across infrastructure, networking, and application layers.
  • Have experience with containerized environments like Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, or traditional enterprise infrastructure systems such as Linux and VMware/OVA hosting.
  • Possess hands-on experience with major cloud platforms and IaC tools while understanding networking fundamentals like TCP/IP, DNS, and HTTP/S.
  • Understand modern API technologies like RESTful APIs, OAuth/JWT, API authentication, and authorization; configure API gateways, ingress controllers, or WAF/WAAP.
  • Demonstrate exceptional communication skills to clearly explain complex technical concepts and explore AI-assisted development and innovative coding approaches.

Build your career at Akamai

Our ability to shape digital life today relies on developing exceptional people like you. The kind that can turn impossible into possible. We’re doing everything we can to make Akamai a great place to work. A place where you can learn, grow and have a meaningful impact.

With our company moving so fast, it’s important that you’re able to build new skills, explore new roles, and try out different opportunities. There are so many different ways to build your career at Akamai, and we want to support you as much as possible. We have all kinds of development opportunities available, from programs such as GROW and Mentoring, to internal events like the APEX Expo and tools such as Linkedin Learning, all to help you expand your knowledge and experience here.

Learn more

Internship-ohjelma käynnistyy kattavalla viikon kestävällä orientaatiojaksolla. Internit toimivat vuoden aikana alaan erikoistuneiden eläinlääkäreiden johdolla pieneläinsairaalan eri yksiköissä. Meillä työskentely on monipuolista ja ammatilliset kehittymismahdollisuudet ovat lähes rajattomat – tervetuloa siis joukkoomme!

Help build targeted insights to inform the design and development of new customer experiences, as well as breakthrough technology and concepts designed to deliver on new go to market strategies

title: Kliininen jatkokoulutettava eläinlääkäri Yliopistolliseen hevossairaalaan
description:
Hevossairauksien internship 2026-2027

Yliopistollinen eläinsairaala hakee hevossairaalaanKLIINISTÄ JATKOKOULUTETTAVAA ELÄINLÄÄKÄRIÄ ajalle 1.10.2026 – 1.10.2027.

Kliiniset jatkokoulutettavat eläinlääkärit suorittavat Internship-ohjelman Yliopistollisen eläinsairaalan hevossairaalassa. Internship-ohjelma on käytössä eläinlääketieteellisissä tiedekunnissa eurooppalaisissa ja amerikkalaisissa yliopistoissa ja siitä on saatu hyvät kokemukset myös Yliopistollisessa eläinsairaalassa.

Interni toimii vuoden aikana alaan erikoistuneiden eläinlääkäreiden johdolla hevossairaalassa. Oman alansa erikoiseläinlääkäreiden kanssa tehtävän tiiviin yhteistyön ansiosta, internivuosi tarjoaakin siihen valituille eläinlääkäreille mahdollisuuden syvälliseen perehtymiseen ja oman ammattiosaamisen kehittämiseen. Kliinisen potilastyön lisäksi opetussairaalamme arki näkyy myös internien työtehtävissä, osallistumisena eläinlääketieteen opiskelijoiden kliiniseen opetukseen.

Interni osallistuu lisäksi viikonloppujen ja pyhien etupäivystyksiin, joista maksetaan yliopistojen yleisen työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät. Tehtävään vaaditaan Suomessa laillistettu eläinlääkärin tutkinto. Hakijoilta toivotaan hyvää suomen kielen taitoa. Eduksi katsomme myös hyväksynnän erikoistumisohjelmaan (huom. haku syksyllä 2026).

Miksi meille?
Meillä työskentely on monipuolista ja ammatilliset kehittymismahdollisuudet ovat lähes rajattomat – tervetuloa siis joukkoomme!

Yliopistollinen eläinsairaala tarjoaa työympäristönä huippuluokan laitteiston ja vaihtelevan potilasmateriaalin peruspraktiikasta haastaviin lähetepotilaisiin, joita ratkotaan moniammatillisen huippuosaajatiimin kanssa yhdessä. Meillä et jää yksin! Työn äärellä tapahtuvien oppimismahdollisuuksien lisäksi pääset osallistumaan eläinsairaalan säännöllisiin sisäisiin koulutuksiin, joita pidetään lehtikatsauksien, jatkokoulutusluentojen ja seminaarien muodossa. Lisäksi interneillä on mahdollisuus osallistua yhteen kotimaiseen seminaariin/ koulutukseen vuoden aikana.

Lisätietoja
Tehtävän palkkaus perustuu yliopistojen palkkausjärjestelmän opetus- ja tutkimushenkilöstön vaativuustasokartan tasoon 3. Tehtäväkohtainen palkka on noin 3 303,99 €, jonka lisäksi maksetaan etupäivystyksen lisät yliopistojen työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti. Internivuoden aikana kertyy vuosilomaa 2 pv/kk ja lomia voi käyttää joustavasti sopien vuoden aikana. Lisäksi tarjoamme kaikille työntekijöillemme työterveyshuollon palvelut, sekä Unisportin-palvelut alennettuun henkilökuntahintaan.

Hakemus jätetään liitteineen Helsingin yliopiston sähköiseen rekrytointijärjestelmään Hae nyt-linkistä 30.8.2026 (23:59) mennessä. Liitä hakemukseesi ansioluettelo.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa hevossairaalan johtava eläinlääkäri Nina Lehmonen, nina.lehmonen@helsinki.fi
Rekrytointia, työsopimusta ja palkkausta koskeviin tiedusteluihin vastaa HR-asiantuntija Emmi Karlstedt, 0294157153, emmi.karlstedt(at)helsinki.fi

Yliopistollinen eläinsairaalaon Suomen ainoa kaikkien eläinlajien eläinsairaala, eläinlääketieteellisen hoidon huippuyksikkö, joka toimii 24 tuntia vuorokaudessa vuoden jokaisena päivänä. Eläinsairaala toimii opetussairaalana eläinlääketieteen viidennen vuosikurssin opiskelijoille sekä jatkokoulutuspaikkana erikoistuville eläinlääkäreille ja harjoittelupaikkana pieneläinhoitajiksi opiskeleville hoitajille. Potilaat luovat tärkeän pohjan korkeatasoiselle kansainväliselle kliinisen eläinlääketieteen tutkimukselle.

Monimuotoinen ja yhdenvertainen opiskelu- ja työkulttuuri ovat meille tärkeitä. Sen vuoksi teemme parhaamme edistääksemme inklusiivista yliopistoyhteisöä. Kannustamme kaikkia osaavia ja eritaustaisia hakijoita hakemaan tehtäviämme.

title: Software Engineer II - Full Stack - Web Engineering
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

elastic.co is how Elastic talks to the world — it's where potential customers first encounter our products and where existing ones come to learn more. As a Software Engineer II on the Web Engineering team you'll own meaningful parts of that experience: building the features, systems, and infrastructure that keep the site fast, reliable, and effective at scale. The ideal candidate is a full-stack engineer who is equally comfortable writing React components, designing backend services, shipping to production, and owning what they build once it's live — including on-call response and security triage.

You'll work closely with stakeholders across the company to ship features that improve the site's quality and performance in a distributed, async-first environment.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own features across the full stack from component design and backend services to deployment pipelines and ship production code end-to-end.
  • Instrument client-side performance (Core Web Vitals, error tracking, real-user monitoring) alongside backend logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and dashboards.
  • Partner with product managers, designers, and other developers to build, test, and release features for elastic.co.
  • Write clean, maintainable code and take ownership for its behavior in production.
  • Triage, investigate, and resolve security vulnerability reports — from reproduction and root-cause analysis to fix, validation, and coordinated disclosure.
  • Participate in code reviews for your team.
  • Diagnose and resolve production issues spanning client regressions to backend failures, and participate in an on-call rotation for an always-on service.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years in a full-stack or frontend role, with proven TypeScript and React depth (component architecture, performance, state management) and hands-on backend experience shipping and operating production services.
  • Production experience with Node.js, Python, or Go — enough to build, deploy, debug, and maintain backend services independently.
  • Experience owning CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent) end-to-end, including front-end build tooling, bundle optimization, and deployment automation without a dedicated ops team.
  • A proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • Experienced in building for high availability and scalability at real production scale, including writing secure code, identifying vulnerabilities, and resolving security issues under pressure.
  • Ability to work autonomously in a globally distributed team.

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Platform Insights
description:
Role Description

As a Senior Backend Engineer in Platform Insights, you'll build and evolve the core backend systems that power GitLab's data platform. In this role, you'll focus primarily on Go-based development for the Data Insights Platform and Siphon, with an emphasis on core system design, production readiness, and deployment across GitLab environments.

You'll own high-throughput, multi-component backend systems and help shape architecture, reliability, deployment, and operational maturity across GitLab's SaaS, Dedicated, and Self-Managed environments.

What you'll do

  • Design, build, and evolve backend services in Go for the Data Insights Platform and Siphon, focusing on scalable ingestion, transport, replication, storage, querying, and deployment paths.
  • Own significant parts of the backend architecture for Data Insights Platform, Siphon, and the Query API, including the gRPC integration between the Query API and the GitLab Rails application.
  • Shape technical direction for system boundaries, reliability, throughput, operability, and maintainability.
  • Contribute to systems built around replication, buffering, query-serving, and query-oriented storage patterns, including Siphon, NATS or similar messaging layers, ClickHouse-backed storage, and APIs consumed by GitLab product surfaces.
  • Drive production readiness and deployment of Data Insights Platform and Siphon across GitLab environments, with attention to rollout safety, environment-specific constraints, and long-term operational readiness.
  • Debug and improve complex distributed systems in production, including performance bottlenecks, scaling limits, failure recovery paths, and observability gaps.
  • Work closely with Infrastructure, Data, and peer Engineering teams on technical design, iteration planning, code review, and delivery to keep the platform reliable, secure, and usable by downstream consumers.
  • Work asynchronously with other team members in GitLab's all-remote environment and contribute to a culture of clear written communication, iteration, and ownership.
  • Use AI effectively in your daily workflow as a productivity multiplier for implementation, debugging, investigation, and documentation work.

Qualifications

  • Strong backend engineering experience in Go, including building and operating production services.
  • Experience designing scalable, reliable systems for high-throughput or data-intensive workloads.
  • Experience building and evolving APIs and service integrations, including gRPC or similar patterns between backend services and application layers.
  • Experience working on data platforms, data systems, event pipelines, or other foundational infrastructure.
  • Experience with ClickHouse or similar query-focused data stores used for query-heavy workloads.
  • Working knowledge of Ruby on Rails, or a clear willingness and ability to ramp up quickly.
  • Experience with infrastructure concerns such as reliability, observability, performance, and deployment across production environments.
  • Experience working across team boundaries to deliver platform capabilities used by other product and engineering teams.

Benefits

  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

As a member of the PSJH System Revenue Integrity Chargemaster (RICDM) team, the CDM Specialist shall ensure that the Chargemaster (CDM) is consistent with all coding and billing regulations and accurately represents services provided.   • Our leadership is needed every day as we are driving projects in collaboration with Development, Supply Chain, Pilot Manufacturing, Manufacturing and Customer Engineering.

Job Summary

As the Product Quality and Reliability Engineer, you will report to the Director of Quality and Reliability (Q&R). You will lead multiple quality engineering projects in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. You will also work with development engineers to ensure the proliferation of Design For Reliability (DFR) methods into our stream of new product developments.   • Drives 8D and FA projects towards successful implementation of solutions.

  • Technically astute and detail-oriented. High-energy, hands-on, self-confident leader with a broad knowledge of product development, manufacturing quality and reliability methods.

  • Strong interpersonal skills, personal presence, style, and demeanor, to effectively influence and lead others to find and implement solutions to complex quality and reliability problems.

  • Excellent listening, written and verbal communications skills.

  • Strong desire to learn and grow your career with the organization.

  • Able to travel to supplier sites in the USA and Asia.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering preferred

  • Preferred: Master's degree in Engineering, Statistics, Reliability, or a related field. Certified Quality or Reliability Engineer. Six Sigma certification (Black Belt, Green Belt). Semiconductor capital equipment experience.

title: Lead Web Front-end Engineer
description:
Role Description

The Lead Web Front-end Engineer is responsible for building and evolving Sedgwick’s enterprise web content management system with a primary focus on theme architecture, reusable components, accessibility, and performance. This role leverages modular systems to deliver consistency, structured customization, and flexibility at scale.

As a member of our Web team, the Lead Web Front-end Engineer partners closely with the web team members, UX/UI Designers, Analytics, and DevOps stakeholders to ensure the site remains performant, accessible, scalable, and resilient as our business grows and thereby with it, content volume and complexity scales.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Web Development, Digital Media, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering or a related technical field from an accredited college or university preferred; equivalent practical experience in front-end engineering, enterprise CMS architecture, accessibility, and performance optimization may be considered in lieu of formal education.
  • Eight (8) years of professional front-end development experience or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
  • Demonstrated experience building custom website themes, block systems, and reusable component libraries within enterprise-scale content platforms (WordPress preferred).
  • Proven experience delivering accessible, high-performance front-end experiences while supporting campaign-driven websites and collaborating with DevOps or platform teams in a CI/CD environment.
  • Deep expertise in HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript.
  • Strong knowledge of component-based front-end development patterns and modular design systems.
  • Solid understanding of Core Web Vitals and Lighthouse performance metrics.
  • Working knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA) and inclusive design best practices.
  • Ability to work independently while providing technical leadership and guidance to the web marketing team.
  • Knowledge of SEO fundamentals and digital analytics platforms (Google Analytics) a plus.
  • Exposure to international or multilingual website implementations.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

Requirements

  • Develops and manages the web content management system theme architecture, block systems, and component library.
  • Develops and maintains reusable, standards-based components that support campaign landing pages, evergreen content, and international content.
  • Ensures front-end implementations scale cleanly as content volume increases.
  • Partners closely with UX/UI designers to bring page designs to life.
  • Builds front end experiences that meet Core Web Vitals and Lighthouse performance targets.
  • Optimizes rendering, image handling, script loading, and layout stability.
  • Partners with Analytics stakeholders to respond to performance regressions and prevent recurrence through improved patterns and guardrails.

  • Partners with the Web Platform Engineer on CI/CD coordination.
  • Contributes to platform documentation, standards, and front-end components.

Benefits

  • Work-life balance.
  • Caring culture.
  • Opportunity for career growth.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Control Plane (Go/Kubernetes)
description:
Role Description

Join Cisco’s Hypershield team, where we are building the next generation of distributed security infrastructure for modern networking environments. Within Hypershield, the Smart Switch team develops foundational security capabilities that extend across multiple Cisco platforms, including switching, routing, and firewall systems. This team is responsible for core control plane software that enables policy configuration, deployment workflows, logging, visibility, and feature orchestration across a shared security architecture used by products spanning Cisco systems networking portfolios, including Nexus, Catalyst, and emerging smart switch platforms.

The work here is highly foundational: features built by this team influence security behavior across multiple Cisco networking products and future infrastructure platforms.

Your Impact:

  • Design and develop control plane software for security features used in smart switching platforms and distributed firewall systems.
  • Contribute to core feature development from design through implementation, with a focus on APIs, policy orchestration, and secure service integration.
  • Work closely with engineers across control plane, data plane, and platform teams to deliver scalable capabilities that support deployment, observability, and policy enforcement across distributed environments.

What you’ll do:

  • Design and develop control plane features for network security products using Go in Linux-based environments.
  • Build and maintain APIs used for policy configuration, deployment workflows, logging, and operational visibility.
  • Integrate third-party components and internal services into Cisco security platforms.
  • Collaborate with data plane and platform engineering teams to deliver end-to-end feature functionality.
  • Contribute to architecture discussions, feature design, and technical execution for new security capabilities.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with peers across a geographically distributed team, with regular overlap during Pacific Time (PST/PDT) business hours.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree + 8 years of related software engineering experience, or Master's + 6 years of related experience, or PhD + 3 years of related experience.
  • 5+ years of development experience in languages such as Go, C, or C++.
  • Experience developing software in Linux environments.
  • Experience building or maintaining software for security, networking, or infrastructure products or distributed systems.
  • Experience developing software for cloud-native applications or services deployed on Kubernetes or similar distributed platforms.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional Go development experience.
  • Experience designing and developing APIs using REST, gRPC, or Protocol Buffers.
  • Experience working with Kubernetes-based applications, including developing, deploying, debugging, or operating software running in Kubernetes environments.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes concepts such as CRDs, Kubernetes APIs, controllers, RBAC, or secrets management.
  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including network flows, policy enforcement, load balancing, or network configuration concepts.
  • Experience working with distributed systems or network infrastructure platforms.
  • Familiarity with network configuration technologies such as YANG, NETCONF, telemetry, or similar infrastructure configuration frameworks.
  • Experience working effectively in a remote or distributed team environment.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance.
  • 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Short and long-term disability coverage.
  • Basic life insurance.
  • 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees.
  • 1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco.
  • Non-exempt employees receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year.
  • Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program.
  • 80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter.
  • Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer.

Job Description:

Job Title: Checker

About Hy-Vee

At Hy-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We're seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers' lives easier, healthier and happier.

The Role and Why It's Important

Our Checkers are often the last face a customer sees before leaving the store, which makes this role one of the most important ones we have. In this position, you'll operate the register, assist customers throughout the store, and help make sure every visit ends on a great note.

If you enjoy working with people, take pride in doing things right, and want to be part of a team that truly cares about customers, we'd love to have you join us.

What You'll Do

No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:

  • Provide prompt, friendly customer service by greeting customers with a smile, learning their names, and going out of your way to make every visit a great one

  • Operate the cash register accurately, scanning product and processing all payment types including cash, checks, credit cards, coupons, food stamps, WIC checks, rain checks, in-store charges, and lottery transactions

  • Count back change, issue receipts, and provide cash refunds or credit memorandums for returned merchandise as needed

  • Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal guidelines regarding WIC, food stamps, and the sale of tobacco, liquor, and lottery tickets

  • Place merchandise in bags or boxes, assist courtesy personnel, and support drive-up and carry-out service

  • Stock, face, and rotate merchandise, clean shelves, understand shelf tags, and take customers to items when requested

title: Information Security GRC Manager
description:
About The Role

Information Security GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) Manager Location: UK flexible location (Hybrid, home, and office) Salary: £54,143 to £58,572 per annum, pro rata, (plus ILW, if residing & working in London) Hours: 35 per week Contract: Permanent

Could you lead a team responsible information security risk management for the British Red Cross, including the identification, assessment, and treatment, well as third-party and supply chain cyber security risk management?

What will a day in the life of an Information Security GRC Manager involve?

  • Develop and maintain the information security governance framework for the British Red Cross, including policies, standards, and processes, ensuring they align with organisational objectives, legal, contractual, regulatory requirements, and best practices.
  • Oversee and continuously improve the information security risk management framework, ensuring robust processes for identifying, assessing, recording, and managing information security risks across the British Red Cross.
  • Own the management of information security risks, including developing appropriate risk mitigation and treatment plans when risk levels exceed acceptable thresholds, providing regular reporting and insight on key risks, risk trends, and control effectiveness.
  • Lead the ISO 27001 certification programme and ongoing compliance with the ISO/IEC 27001 standard.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for external auditors and certification bodies, planning and coordinating certification (and surveillance) audits, ensuring that all necessary evidence, documentation, and corrective actions are managed effectively.
  • Work in partnership with other stakeholders, departments, and functions to ensure a cohesive approach to information security across the organisation.

To be a successful Information Security GRC Manager, what will you need?

  • Strong emotional intelligence, and a commitment to inclusive leadership, creating an environment where team members can grow and excel.
  • Excellent knowledge of common cyber and information security compliance requirements, including PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard), Cyber Essentials, and the NHS Data Security & Protection Toolkit.
  • Proven experience implementing or maintaining an ISO/IEC 27001 certified ISMS, including managing certification audits and continual improvement cycles.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise risk management methodologies and tools, particularly as they apply to information security risk identification, assessment (quantitative and qualitative), mitigation, and monitoring.
  • Demonstrable experience in information security risk management, including establishing risk assessment processes, running risk workshops, managing risk registers, and presenting risk statuses to senior management or governance boards.

Interested?

title: Anaplan Project Manager Specialist
description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

What you get to do in this role:

  • Partner with global business owners across GTM Planning, Sales Operations, and Finance to understand planning processes, identify process improvement opportunities, and design solutions using Anaplan
  • Lead end-to-end business process design and optimization for Anaplan implementations and enhancements; translate complex business requirements into functional specifications and use cases
  • Own project management and coordination of cross-functional Anaplan initiatives including Sales CRM Integration, Capacity Planning, Financial Planning, and GTM Coverage enhancements; manage timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder expectations
  • Design and deliver comprehensive Anaplan enablement programs including training curricula, user documentation, system guides, and best practice playbooks for diverse user audiences
  • Manage and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) planning, execution, and issue resolution; drive user adoption and minimize go-live risks through effective change management
  • Collaborate with Anaplan technical specialists, IT teams, data analytics, and business partners to ensure requirements are clearly defined and solutions are technically feasible and properly integrated
  • Communicate functional and business requirements effectively between business stakeholders, technical teams, and leadership; distill complex planning challenges into clear problem statements and recommended solutions
  • Conduct post-implementation business support including troubleshooting user issues, gathering feedback, and identifying enhancements for continuous improvement
  • Proactively identify process improvements and business optimization opportunities; design solutions that enhance planning efficiency, data accuracy, and decision-making speed
  • Mentor junior business analysts and functional team members on Anaplan planning methodologies, best practices, and business process design principles
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects and workstreams; prioritize competing business needs and deliver results against aggressive timelines
  • Contribute to the development of Anaplan governance frameworks, process documentation, and operational standards

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • 5+ years of business analyst or functional consultant experience; 3+ years working with Anaplan as a functional user, business analyst, or enablement specialist (technical model building expertise not required)
  • Deep understanding of enterprise planning processes including Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), operational planning, quota/territory planning, or capacity planning
  • Proven experience gathering requirements, designing business processes, and translating business needs into functional specifications and use cases
  • Strong project and program management capabilities with ability to manage complex, multi-workstream initiatives across geographically distributed teams
  • Demonstrated expertise in change management, user enablement, and training delivery; ability to drive adoption and overcome resistance to change
  • Experience managing UAT planning and execution for enterprise systems implementations or enhancements
  • Strong business partnership skills and proven track record of successfully driving cross-functional initiatives, coordinating complex stakeholder relationships, and influencing without authority
  • Familiarity with Sales CRM platforms (Salesforce, Varicent, or similar) and understanding of Go-To-Market planning, sales processes, and quota management
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills; ability to articulate complex business requirements to technical teams and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience with AI-driven insights and analytical thinking about how to optimize planning processes and decision-making workflows
  • Senior-level competencies: leadership presence, mentoring ability, and strategic thinking about planning maturity and business capability development
  • Nice to have: ServiceNow platform familiarity, experience with Pigment or other reporting/analytics tools, knowledge of Snowflake or data warehouse concepts, or background in management consulting

title: Software Engineer
description:
Murphy AI deploys voice AI agents that help banks collect debt. We’ve built a fully-fledged platform designed to optimize recovery rates while maintaining respectful and personalized communication. Our advanced automation streamlines the process of collecting overdue invoices for banks and other industries, providing a seamless and effective solution.

Our AI-powered agents adapt instantly, engaging with debtors across channels like voice, messengers, email and sms to maximize results while preserving trust. By combining advanced artificial intelligence with powerful automation, we’re setting a new standard for how businesses recover payments.

As a fast-growing startup that has already made an impact within less than a year in the market, we are building a talented team to scale our operations and drive our vision forward 🌟

💼 About the Role

As a Software Engineer, your mission is to own real problems end-to-end, from design to production, on a platform designed to scale natively: an event-driven architecture where AI agents negotiate with real people on behalf of banks, under real SLAs and bank-grade security.

We're AI-native in how we build, not just what we sell: LLM evals score 100% of our conversations, adversarial agents attack every change before it reaches production, and our CI/CD runs its own AI agents : reviewing code, catching regressions, and fixing vulnerabilities.

You'll build alongside a team of excellent engineers who hold a high bar, shipping to production in your first week and owning more as the company grows.

You will have end-to-end ownership over what you build.

📝 Responsibilities

  • Own problems : understand the real need, design the solution, ship it, run it in production, and iterate on real usage.

  • Build and evolve the products our customers live in - where they configure their strategy, follow their portfolio, and understand every AI conversation.

  • Extend the machinery that lets Murphy scale the business in our sleep: self-serve onboarding, integrations with our customers' systems (CRM, ERP, core banking), and the data flows that feed our AI agents - where every conversation makes the next one smarter.

  • Contribute to internal tools, AI skills and automations that make every team at Murphy faster. Engineers shape how the company works, not just what it ships.

📚 Requirements

  • 4+ years of proven experience building and scaling production software — fullstack, or strong backend/frontend engineers who want to go fullstack.

  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript across the stack: Node.js on the backend, React (or a similar modern framework) on the frontend.

  • Demonstrated ability to design, run, and debug real production systems — failure modes, latency, and cost included.

  • Strong ownership: you take a problem, not a spec, and come back with it solved.

  • You use AI tools aggressively but critically: let them write the code, you own the thinking — and when you merge it, you own it.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, able to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

💡 Bonus points

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)

  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and automated testing

  • Previous experience in AI/ML projects or startup environments.

🤝 What we offer

💶 Compensation: £50k–75k for Mid Level // £75k–100k+ for Senior Level

📈 Stock options: Because we all build Murphy together – you'll own a piece of what we’re creating.

🧩 Impact & Growth: Early role in a fast-growing startup, with mentorship and opportunities to take on more responsibility as you grow.

📚 Learning: Continuous development through mentorship, trainings, and exposure to real-world AI projects.

🙌 Pension Plan: 5% contribution to Aviva Pension Plan

🛜 Hybrid & Flexible: Our default setup is hybrid – 3 days a week at our office in Poblenou, surrounded by a thriving tech scene, and 2 days of remote work. But if there’s one thing that defines us, it’s flexibility: we trust you to organize your time and space in the way that helps you do your best work.

📚 Our Process

1️⃣ First Interview – Getting to Know You

A conversation with a future teammate who’s excited to find a new colleague. We’ll talk about your story, what drives you, and what you’re looking for next—no trick questions, just a genuine exchange.

2️⃣ Second Interview – Deep Dive

You’ll meet the Hiring Manager and potentially another team member. This is a more technical discussion where we explore your skills in detail, walk through real scenarios, and answer any questions you might have about the role.

3️⃣ Tech Assessment or Business Case

A practical exercise to see how you approach challenges similar to those you’d tackle at Murphy. You’ll have time to reflect and showcase your thinking—no rush, no surprises.

4️⃣ Call with the Founders

title: Law Contract Lifecycle Management Analyst
description:
An exciting career awaits you

At MPC, we’re committed to being a great place to work – one that welcomes new ideas, encourages diverse perspectives, develops our people, and fosters a collaborative team environment.

Marathon Petroleum is seeking a Law Contract Lifecycle Management Analyst. This position serves as a member of the Law Contract Lifecycle Management Center of Excellence, responsible for business support, training material development and presentation, contract template creation, metadata capture, data integrity, access governance, compliance with internal and external controls, including SOX requirements, and technical issue resolution related to the Sirion contract management system.

  • Create and modify legal contract templates for use and selection within the Sirion contract management system.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to address contract-related issues & provide necessary documentation & information, address counterparty issues, risks, user access issues and concerns, and identify areas for improvement to ensure effective contract management operations.​

  • Support internal and external audits, compliance, litigations, hold orders, and confidential business development projects by identifying and providing required contract information and documentation. ​

  • Ensure contract compliance, performance reporting, issue / risk management, and contract reporting and metrics within the system.

  • Develop and present training materials and related content.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to identify areas for improvement, best practices, and ensure efficient & effective contract management operations.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

SKILLS:
