About Hy-Vee

At Hy-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We're seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers' lives easier, healthier and happier.

The Role and Why It's Important

At Hy-Vee, our floral department helps customers find the perfect arrangement for every occasion, and our Floral Clerks are a vital part of making those moments special. In this role, you'll assist customers with placing orders, create beginning-level floral designs, keep the department stocked and looking beautiful, and deliver the kind of warm, attentive service that keeps our customers coming back.

Whether you're building a balloon bouquet, sending an FTD order, or helping someone choose the perfect bouquet, your work brings joy to people every single day. If you have a creative spirit, enjoy working with people, and take pride in a job well done, we'd love to have you on our team.

What You'll Do

No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:

  • Deliver outstanding customer service by greeting every customer with a smile and assisting them with placing floral orders in person or over the phone, including completing all required order paperwork

  • Prepare, finish, and replenish product including small floral and greenery arrangements, corsages and boutonnieres, roses, carnations, balloon bouquets, bows, and other floral items

  • Send and retrieve FTD, Teleflora, and computer orders; maintain confidentiality on all orders placed including sender, recipient, order details, and cost

  • Review floral products for freshness and anticipate daily product needs for the department

  • Water plants and maintain the overall appearance and cleanliness of the department including coolers, counters, floors, and sinks

  • Prepare the daily delivery list and deliver orders as needed

  • Unload trucks, place product in appropriate storage areas, check in product, put product away, and process invoices as needed

  • Run the department register, receive payment, and make change as applicable

  • Remove trash in a timely manner and assist with general department upkeep

  • Answer the phone promptly and provide friendly, helpful service to customers who call

  • Follow Hy-Vee's dress code, hygiene standards, and all department and company guidelines

  • Pitch in with other tasks or special projects as they come up

Your Skills

You don't need extensive experience for this role; we'll provide the training you need to succeed. To hit the ground running, you'll need to be able to:

  • Bring commitment to Hy-Vee's mission and a genuine passion for helping customers

  • Solve practical problems and follow instructions carefully in a fast-paced environment

  • Apply math skills including fractions, decimals, and percentages in day-to-day tasks

  • Communicate clearly with customers and co-workers and contribute positively to the team

  • Maintain confidentiality on customer order details including who sent, who received, and order contents

Reporting Relationships

Accountable and Reports to: Store Director; Store Manager; Assistant Managers of Perishables, Store Operations, Health Wellness Home; Floral Department Manager

Education and Experience

  • Less than high school diploma or equivalent experience accepted

  • Six months of similar or related work experience preferred; we'll provide all the training you need to succeed

Physical Requirements

  • Frequently stand and walk throughout a shift in sales, food service, or delivery areas

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to safely use sharp knives and blades for food preparation

  • Where applicable to the role: exposure to heat- and burn-related hazards associated with cooking, baking, or grilling equipment

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to operate a delivery vehicle in accordance with applicable DOT standards

  • Perform repetitive standing, walking, reaching, and bending associated with order fulfillment, POS transactions, and cleaning/sanitation duties

​

Working Environment

This is a fast-moving role with significant pressure to meet deadlines and manage multiple priorities. You'll work primarily in a store environment and can expect exposure to dirt, noise, dampness, equipment movement hazards, electrical equipment, and cleaning chemicals and solvents. Safety is always a priority, and training is provided to help ensure a safe and supportive work environment.

The anticipated hourly starting wage for this position is $13.50 to $16.80 depending on experience.

For information on company benefits visit Benefits | Hy-Vee.

title: Product Manager
description:
Murphy AI deploys voice AI agents that help banks collect debt. We’ve built a fully-fledged platform designed to optimize recovery rates while maintaining respectful and personalized communication. Our advanced automation streamlines the process of collecting overdue invoices for banks and other industries, providing a seamless and effective solution.

Our AI-powered agents adapt instantly, engaging with debtors across channels like voice, messengers, email and sms to maximize results while preserving trust. By combining advanced artificial intelligence with powerful automation, we’re setting a new standard for how businesses recover payments.

As a fast-growing startup that has already made an impact within less than a year in the market, we are building a talented team to scale our operations and drive our vision forward 🌟

About the Role

We're looking for a Product Manager to own a core piece of Murphy, end to end, like a founder would. This is a founding product seat on the most advanced AI product in a $300B+ market — a small product function, an outsized mandate, and the category as your ceiling.

Murphy builds AI voice agents that collect overdue debt for banks: more recovered, faster, cheaper, fully compliant, and respectful to the debtor. We're live with Santander, Revolut, BBVA and dozens others. We've proven the product in large-scale pilots with top-tier banks — now we're turning a service into a product, and we need product builders to own each surface.

What you'll do

  • Own a product end to end. Strategy, roadmap, execution, launch, iterate — you're the CEO of your product, accountable for the business outcomes, not just its ship dates.

  • Make the voice AI agents more efficient. Own the loop: customer segments, experiments on voice, cadence and script, and the evals that prove a change is real before it ships to a bank.

  • Build with AI as the primitive. Prototypes, not design mock-ups; wire agents into the product itself; use AI to design, build and ship faster than a team of 12 people.

  • Turn services into product. Today a new bank goes live through weeks of hand-configuration by our engineers. Convert it into a scaleable product.

  • Dive deep and problem solve. Get to the roots of complex problems, understand all the nuances and design solutions that solve the root cause elegantly.

  • Be an inspiring leader for engineers and data scientists.

Who you are

  • A builder, whatever your title says. You've taken products 0→1 and scaled them past launch whether as a founder, or PM, or engineer.

  • You own outcomes, and you never settle. You turn ambiguity into a clear plan, and hold a high quality bar under speed.

title: AI Project Manager
description:

This is an excellent opportunity to bridge the gap between creative teams, automation tools, and rapid pipeline execution.

Please Note: This is not a "pure PM" coordination or administrative role. We are looking for an execution-focused professional who can actively build and prototype workflows independently, and comfortably operate within undefined operational environments.

What you will do

  • Practical AI Application: Direct proficiency engineering prompts and structuring workflows using foundational models (OpenAI, Claude) to solve real-world operational friction points.

Preferred Qualifications

What we can offer you

title: Senior Software Engineer, Ledgering
description:
Role Description

Ledgering is the accounting core that other teams at Block build on. We keep the authoritative records of balances for Square and Cash App, along with the transactions and settlement that move that money. As a Senior Software Engineer on the team, you will build and operate the systems of record for balances and transactions, the settlement orchestration that decides how sellers and customers get paid, and the automated treasury systems that position Block's own cash. At Block's transaction volume, this work has direct, measurable impact on financial accuracy and on the trust merchants and customers place in us.

  • Design, build, and operate the balance and transaction systems of record that serve as the financial source of truth for millions of merchants and customers.
  • Build settlement orchestration that determines how account holders get paid: schedules, amounts, deposit methods, and withholdings.
  • Develop self-serve ledgering APIs with durable semantics and clear contracts, so partner teams can stand up a new balance or transaction type in about a day instead of waiting weeks on custom integration work.
  • Emit balance and settlement data that downstream finance, reconciliation, and reporting teams can trust, against agreed data contracts.
  • Design and implement reliable, high-volume distributed transaction-processing systems, making thoughtful tradeoffs between consistency and availability when both are not possible.
  • Drive convergence across a large portfolio of financial services: consistent transaction and balance models, shared workflow tooling, and predictable integration patterns.
  • Operate tier-0 and tier-1 financial systems against published SLOs, and debug production issues across services and multiple levels of the stack in a high-reliability environment.
  • Work AI-natively: use AI agents throughout the development lifecycle, and build agents and automation that reduce operational toil across our services.
  • Lead complex projects end to end, breaking the work into components and milestones that other engineers can pick up.
  • Mentor other engineers and contribute to the technical direction of the team.
  • Work with engineers, product managers, and finance and treasury stakeholders across the company to ship new capabilities at scale.

Qualifications

  • A minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 6 years and a Master's degree; or a PhD with 3 years experience; or equivalent experience.
  • Experience designing and operating distributed, high-throughput, fault-tolerant services, with a strong understanding of consistency, idempotency, and failure handling.
  • Experience building money-movement systems such as ledgers, double-entry accounting, settlement, or treasury, or the curiosity and drive to build deep expertise in the domain.
  • Proficiency in at least one major programming language (for example Java, Kotlin, or Go) and strong SQL.
  • Experience leading complex, ambiguous projects across multiple engineering teams and driving clear next steps in areas without clear ownership.
  • High standards for software architecture and engineering practices, including maintainable and testable code, CI/CD, and observability, in a complex, high-stakes financial environment.
  • Proficiency in using AI tools throughout the software development lifecycle to improve engineering productivity, problem solving, and software delivery.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Requirements

  • Technologies We Use and Teach:
    • Java, Kotlin, Python
    • AI agents and tooling across the development lifecycle, including AMP, Codex, Claude, Goose and MCP
    • Temporal, Protocol Buffers, jOOQ, GraphQL
    • MySQL, Aurora, Vitess, Databricks, Snowflake
    • AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Datadog

Benefits

  • Remote work
  • Medical insurance
  • Flexible time off
  • Retirement savings plans
  • Modern family planning

description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Through structured proofs of value, rapid prototyping, innovation workshops, and strategic customer engagements, the team will help customers realize value from emerging Core Business Workflow capabilities while creating a direct feedback loop into product strategy and roadmap development.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Head of Outbound Product Management for Core Business Workflows, this role will define the operating model, success metrics, engagement framework, and talent profile required to scale a world-class product innovation function.

This role serves as a critical bridge between Product Management, Engineering and the field, ensuring product strategy is translated into customer value and customer feedback is translated into product innovation.

What you get to do in this role

  • Define and operationalize a new product commercialization motion for Core Business Workflows, focused on accelerating customer adoption of emerging innovations, AI and strategic product investments.
  • Build and lead a team of highly skilled product and AI specialists who can identify customer problems, rapidly build solutions, and validate business value.
  • Lead structured proofs of value, rapid prototypes, innovation workshops, and executive engagements that connect product strategy directly to customer transformation.
  • Define and scale the Business Value Assessment framework for Core Business Workflows, including customer baselines, expected outcomes, realized value, and executive business cases.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering, Research, Sales, Solution Consulting, Product Marketing, Value Consulting, and Product Success to execute customer innovation initiatives.
  • Establish success metrics and operating mechanisms that measure customer adoption, business impact, proof-of-concept outcomes, customer references, and influenced revenue.
  • Participate as an executive leader for Core Business Workflows in executive briefings, strategic customer engagements, industry events, and innovation-focused forums.

  • 12+ years of experience in Product Management, FDE, Product Strategy, Product Commercialization, Customer Transformation, or related enterprise software leadership roles.

  • Experience designing and executing customer innovation programs, POC initiatives, product adoption strategies, or commercialization efforts.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise workflow platforms, digital transformation initiatives, and modern business process technologies.

title: SECURITY SHIFT SUPERVISOR
description:
The Security Shift Supervisor is responsible for supervising the daily activities of the Security Department on assigned shift; provides support for other departments as needed.

  • Is responsible for training, and motivating, evaluating, and supervising staff on assigned shift to ensure employees receive adequate guidance and resources to accomplish established objectives.

  • Ensures that proper arrest procedures and detainment techniques are carried out in violations of criminal law.
  • Ensures that all company and departmental procedures are followed; assists various local, state and federal authorities in various activities and investigations to ensure that procedures and laws are observed.

  • Resolves guest complaints and ensures that the highest level of guest service is rendered at all times.
  • Provides support to departmental management in the event of sensitive and/or dangerous situations involving terminations, thefts, team member or guest issues, etc.
  • Is responsible for transportation of "for cause” drug/alcohol testing, as needed.
  • Conducts training classes on various topics such as: CPR, First-Aid, Bomb Search & Recognition, Disaster Planning and Evacuation, investigation of accidents, etc.

  • Provides support to other departments to ensure that proper procedures for Games, Slots, Cashiers, drops, etc., are implemented and maintained.

  • Must be able to effectively and efficiently transverse stairs, uneven surfaces, varied flooring surfaces and ground coverings while patrolling, responding to calls for service or emergency situations.

  • Ability to communicate courteously, effectively, and professionally with guests, outside contacts and all levels of employees.
  • Must be able to use tools and equipment, including but not limited to, keys, handcuffs, flashlights, radios, computers and other tools specific to the position.
  • Must be flexible to work varying shifts and time schedules as needed.
  • Ability to perform duties under varying conditions, including but not limited to, exposure to varying levels of smoke, crowds, noise, and changing weather conditions.
  • Minimum of two (2) years’ experience in security, law enforcement or military.
  • At least one (1) year experience in supervision, preferred
  • Basic knowledge of Indiana civil and criminal laws and Indiana Gaming Commission regulations.
  • Basic knowledge of county and state ordinances.
  • Knowledge and understanding of electronic, video, and alarm functions.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office, preferred.
  • Valid driver's license, preferred.
  • AED, CPR Certified, First Aid Certification and Blood Borne Pathogen training, preferred.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to compose clear, accurate, and concise reports.
  • General familiarity with investigative procedures.
  • Ability to maintain confidential information.
  • Must be bondable with no felony convictions.
  • Ability to work in a drug free environment and pass a chemical dependency test as required.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain all licenses / certifications per Federal, State, and Gaming regulations.
  • Must be at least 21 years of age.

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Analytics Instrumentation
description:
Role Description

Analytics Instrumentation is part of the Data Engineering and Monetization (DE&M) group, focused on the collection of Product Usage and Billing event data within GitLab. We build data collection platforms that enable product teams to assess user behavior and make evidence-based choices through privacy-conscious instrumentation that captures product usage throughout the user lifecycle.

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll guide the design and development of a unified data infrastructure platform that consolidates analytics instrumentation across GitLab's engineering organization. You'll build and maintain backend systems that give the company visibility into customer usage patterns across GitLab SaaS and Self-Managed deployment environments. That data directly informs strategic product priorities and strategies. This role offers the opportunity to work on foundational infrastructure that simplifies instrumentation for teams at GitLab, replacing the complexity of multiple language-specific software development kits with a single, unified solution that teams can rely on.

What you’ll do

  • Guide the design, implementation, and evolution of a unified data collection platform using Golang, Kubernetes, ClickHouse, and NATS, with success measured by reliability, performance, and adoption across GitLab teams.
  • Improve the emission, transit, and quality of instrumentation data across the system, with success measured by data quality, data integrity, and usage billing accuracy.
  • Provide technical guidance for usage billing and instrumentation systems during working hours, with success measured by timely incident handling, effective root cause analysis, and reliable service restoration.
  • Work across the organization with research and development teams and the enterprise data organization to deliver common solutions, with success measured by adoption across multiple stakeholders.
  • Make technical choices that balance ease of use for product teams with reliability and correctness for data consumers, with success measured by platform usability and reliable downstream data.
  • Mentor other engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and clear technical documentation, with success measured by stronger code quality, faster technical alignment, and more maintainable systems.

Qualifications

  • Significant experience working with platform or infrastructure systems in production environments.
  • Strong proficiency in the Go programming language, with experience building and maintaining production services.
  • Strong backend development experience, with the ability to design and deliver scalable, reliable systems serving internal and external customers.
  • Experience guiding technical design and making tradeoffs across system reliability, performance at scale, data quality, and observability.
  • Experience working across team boundaries with product teams, data consumers, and other internal stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with cloud native technologies and open source development practices.
  • A track record of mentoring other engineers and helping teams make clear, well-documented technical choices.

Benefits

  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Company Description

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100 trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems.

description:

This role is more than just coding. As a Software Development Engineer at Booz Allen, you’ll use your passion to learn new tools and techniques and identify needed system improvements. You’ll help our team and customers overcome their most difficult challenges at the edge using the latest architectural approaches, tools, and technologies. Join us. The world can't wait.

title: Debt Collections Advisor - UAE
description:
Murphy AI is a next-generation debt collection platform powered by artificial intelligence, designed to optimize recovery rates while maintaining respectful and personalized communication. Our advanced automation streamlines the process of collecting overdue invoices for businesses, providing a seamless and effective solution.

At Murphy AI, we’re tackling one of the toughest challenges in fintech: making debt recovery more efficient, autonomous and scalable. Our AI-powered agents adapt instantly, engaging with debtors across channels like voice, email and sms to maximize results while preserving trust. By combining advanced artificial intelligence with powerful automation, we’re setting a new standard for how businesses recover payments.

As a fast-growing startup that has already made an impact within less than a year in the market, we are building a talented team to scale our operations and drive our vision forward 🌟

💼 About the Role

Murphy is building the AI agents that will run real collections conversations for banks, lenders and collection agencies across UAE — and we need people who've actually done the job to make sure our AI does it right. We're recruiting Debt-Collection Experts to join our advisor network in a consultant/advisor capacity: no full-time commitment, just your judgment and experience, paid by the hour (roughly 5–20 hours per month).

You'll work directly with Murphy's product and AI teams to pressure-test how our voice agents negotiate, escalate, and stay compliant — bringing the floor-level and strategic reality of UAE collections into how we design and train our technology.

📝 Responsibilities

Domain Review & AI Validation

  • Review call flows, scripts and negotiation logic used by Murphy's AI agents and flag anything that doesn't match how a real collections desk would handle it.

  • Validate cadence, cure-rate assumptions, settlement/negotiation ranges, and escalation paths against real-world practice.

  • Stress-test edge cases: disputes, renegotiation, hardship, repeat promises-to-pay, and regulatory triggers.

Compliance & Local Nuance

  • Flag anything that could create compliance risk

  • Advise on tone, channel mix and contact-frequency norms considered acceptable vs. abusive in the UAE market.

Knowledge Transfer

  • Join periodic working sessions (calls/async review) with Murphy's product and engineering teams.

  • Share real examples, scripts and playbooks from your own collections experience (anonymized, no client data).

🎯 What We're Looking For

We're recruiting across two profiles:

  • Bank in-house collections leaders — you've owned the creditor-side process: placement strategy, make-vs-buy decisions, and portfolio oversight.

  • DCA / servicer / BPO collections & contact-centre managers — you've run the floor: cadence, scripts, cure rates, and agent incentives.

And you likely also have:

  • 5+ years of experience in collections.

  • Current or recent (≤2 years) experience at a named bank, DCA, servicer or BPO.

  • A title of Manager, Team Lead, Head, Director or VP (front-line agent/officer/advisor titles only qualify if you've since moved into managing a team).

  • Fluent Arabic; working English OR Spanish is necessary for internal team sessions.

⏱️ The Engagement

  • Format: consultant/advisor, paid hourly.

  • Time commitment: approx. 5–20 hours/month, flexible around your schedule.

  • Fully remote.

🚀 Why Join

  • Shape how AI actually collects debt at some of the world's top banks

  • Flexible, low-commitment engagement that fits around your current job.

  • Work directly with a founding product/AI team backed by Northzone, ElevenLabs and Lakestar.

  • Competitive hourly consulting fee.

title: Senior AI Backend Engineer
description:

  • Design and optimize prompt engineering strategies for consistent, high-quality AI outputs
  • Build high-performance REST/GraphQL APIs using Django and FastAPI with async processing

Tech Stack

  • Django, FastAPI
  • PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB
  • OpenAI, Gemini

  • Docker

  • GraphQL, workflow orchestration (Temporal, Airflow), Kubernetes

Klaviyo is building an AI-first company—and that starts with how we support and scale our people.

We’re looking for a Lead People Technology Engineer to be the first dedicated AI engineer within our People Technology (KPPL) team. As an early leader in this space, you’ll reimagine how our People teams operate in an AI-first world by shaping our architecture, standards, and long-term vision.

You’ll partner across People Operations, Talent Acquisition, Talent, and Finance to design and build intelligent systems that transform how we hire, develop, retain, and support Klaviyos globally. This role is not just about applying AI it’s about defining how AI becomes embedded into the employee lifecycle at Klaviyo.

What You’ll Be Doing

AI-First People Systems & Architecture

  • Reimagine core People workflows (recruiting, onboarding, performance, daily tasks) through an AI-first lens, not just incremental automation

  • Design and build AI-powered workflows, copilots, and agents that automate and augment People processes across the employee lifecycle

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business problems into scalable AI solutions

Driving an AI-First Operating Model

  • Define and track success metrics tied to efficiency gains, time savings, and operational effectiveness
  • Help the People organization shift toward AI-augmented ways of working

  • Enable People teams to leverage AI by building:

    • Playbooks and training materials

  • Help non-technical stakeholders confidently use and iterate on AI-powered tools

Technical Leadership

  • Advocate for scalable, well-governed AI systems that integrate cleanly into Klaviyo’s broader tech ecosystem
  • Act as a key voice in shaping how Klaviyo becomes AI-first internally, starting with People systems

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Passion and Curiosity to experiment and reimagine People workflows

  • 5+ years of engineering or data engineering experience, with 2+ years building AI/ML or LLM-powered delivering tangible business outcomes

  • Experience integrating with enterprise SaaS systems (HRIS, ATS, etc.)

  • Strong ability to translate ambiguous business problems into scalable technical solutions

Bonus Points

This is a foundational role in defining how Klaviyo becomes an AI-first company from the inside out.

You won’t just be implementing AI you’ll be:

  • Defining standards for responsible, scalable internal AI systems
  • Building the blueprint for how AI is embedded across the business

If you’re excited about building from scratch, influencing across functions, and applying AI to core business workflows, this role offers a unique opportunity to have outsized impact.

title: Overnight Stock
description:
Additional Considerations (if any):

Overnight Shifts, Must be 18+

-

At Hy-Vee our people are our strength. We promise “a helpful smile in every aisle” and those smiles can only come from a workforce that is fully engaged and committed to supporting our customers and each other.

Job Description:

Night Stocker

Job Title: Night Stocker

Department: Grocery

FLSA: Hourly

Revision Date: 07/2026

About Hy-Vee

At Hy-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We're seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers' lives easier, healthier and happier.

The Role and Why It's Important

As a Night Stocker at Hy-Vee, you'll be an essential part of the overnight crew that keeps our store shelves full, organized, and ready for customers every morning. From unloading trucks and rotating product to tagging shelves and keeping the backroom in order, your work directly shapes the shopping experience our customers count on.

If you enjoy staying active, work well as part of a team, and take pride in a job well done, this could be a great fit for you.

What You'll Do

No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:

  • Deliver outstanding customer service by greeting customers warmly and helping them find what they need

  • Assist customers with finding products, reaching items, carrying heavy purchases, and passing along any feedback or requests to the team

  • Unload trucks, open containers, stock shelves, run overstock on risers, and rotate product to ensure freshness

  • Monitor for mis-picked items, product outs, and wrong deliveries, and report issues accordingly

  • Organize stock for greatest efficiency and clean and restock any damaged items

  • Tag shelves with overstock in the back room and understock drawers

  • Report new or different items to the scanning coordinator for system input

  • Work alongside your teammates to ensure a smooth, efficient overnight operation

  • Maintain compliance with Hy-Vee's dress code, hygiene standards, and all company policies

  • Assist in other store areas and take on special projects as needed

  • You'll receive direction and support from: Store Director, Store Manager, Assistant Managers of Health Wellness Home, Perishables, Store Operations, and E-commerce, and Night Stock Manager

Your Skills

You don't need prior experience for this role! We'll happily train and support you as you grow. To be successful, you'll need to be able to:

  • Follow written and verbal instructions with confidence

  • Use basic math skills, including fractions, decimals, and percentages

  • Communicate clearly with customers and teammates in a friendly, helpful way

  • Stay organized and keep up with the pace of a busy overnight shift

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; up to six months of similar or related experience preferred

Reporting Relationships

Accountable and Reports to: Store Director, Store Manager, Assistant Managers of Health Wellness Home, Perishables, Store Operations, and E-commerce, and Night Stock Manager

Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent required

  • Up to six months of similar or related work experience preferred

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to frequently lift, carry, push, or pull objects weighing 100 pounds or more, with or without mechanical assistance

  • Continuously stand and walk on hard surfaces for extended periods

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to operate pallet jacks, forklifts, or similar material-handling equipment (required operator certification must be completed prior to independent use)

  • Work in cooler or freezer environments for extended periods

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to safely use sharp knives and blades to cut, trim, or grind product

  • Where applicable to the role, and in accordance with applicable age and legal requirements: operate a cardboard baler or compactor

  • Where applicable to the role: perform repetitive motions associated with dough mixing, scaling, and proofing

  • Ability to unload, lift, stock, and rotate incoming truck freight and merchandise

Working Environment

This is a physically demanding, hands-on role performed primarily during overnight hours. You may encounter daily exposure to dirt, noise, equipment movement hazards, and cleaning chemicals or solvents, with occasional exposure to temperature extremes and potential electrical shock. The role involves working with and around heavy store equipment. Safety is always a priority, and training is provided to help ensure a safe and supportive work environment.

Are you ready to smile, apply today.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre employment drug screen.

We’re looking for passionate people who work hard and are focused yet like to have fun. The independent thinkers who thrive in a top-notch team of diverse talents. You’ll be contributing to a positive force for progress as the world moves to a new way of working. The workplace is changing, and you can be a part of shaping that future.

By minimizing the physical and virtual divide, we enable everyone to feel more connected, present and understood, however they prefer to work. We aim to make our technologies so intuitive that terms like "in-office" and "remote" will seem obsolete in five years. We are an ambitious, accountable, collaborative, responsible, and growing team that fosters an environment where creativity and ingenuity can flourish. title: Backend / Integration Engineer
description:
Company Overview

Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and artificial intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

About the Program

Innodata's Federal Practice builds the trusted data layer for critical infrastructure Trust & Safety work. Partnering with a leading systems integrator, we're delivering a modern, governed data services platform in a secure federal (IL4) environment. Over an intensive 20-week phase, you'll help stand up a data services storefront, a DataCard governance framework, synthetic data integration, and Databricks write-back capabilities.

About this Role

As the Backend/Integration Engineer, you'll build the connective tissue of the platform. You'll develop the data services storefront's backend, stand up ingest pipelines, and implement reliable write-back into our data lakehouse so results flow cleanly across systems. Working alongside the Solution Architect, you'll make sure the platform's components integrate securely and perform under real workloads in a federal (IL4) environment. It's a strong fit for a backend engineer who likes owning integrations and turning architecture into working plumbing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement Databricks REST API write-back for labeled outputs, DataCard provenance records, and synthetic content outputs
  • Build and validate the Duality back-end integration: catalog intake form configuration, parameter translation to Duality generation API, async job lifecycle management (submission, tracking, retry, completion), output handling
  • Implement ServiceNow REST integration for white-glove routing intake path
  • Build and maintain storefront backend services (API layer between frontend UI and platform components)
  • Implement DataCard write-back path in coordination with Solution Architect
  • Design and maintain async job queue management and retry logic across all integration surfaces
  • Structure output metadata for DataCard provenance records per DoD distribution statement requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field required. Equivalent experience may substitute for degree on a 2-for-1 basis.
  • 6+ years total professional experience, 4+ years backend or API integration engineering
  • REST API integration with async job lifecycle patterns (submission, polling, retry, webhook handling)
  • Databricks REST API or strong Spark/Databricks platform familiarity
  • JSON schema design and structured metadata handling
  • Active Secret clearance with TS/SCI eligibility

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • ServiceNow REST API integration experience
  • Federal program API integration background
  • ZenML or ML orchestration pipeline familiarity
  • React or modern frontend experience for storefront skeleton support

Salary Range

The expected hourly salary range for this position is $75 to $80 per hour, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Note to Candidates

The Databricks write-back and Duality integration are the two highest-complexity tasks in Phase B. Candidates should be prepared to discuss async API integration patterns and their approach to retry logic and error handling in federal-data environments during the interview.

Please be aware of recruitment scams involving individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent employers. Innodata will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the application process. To learn more about how to recognize job scams, visit the Federal Trade Commission’s guide at https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams.

Equal Employment Opportunity

As set forth in Innodata Inc.’s Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

Veteran Self‑Identification

If you believe you belong to any of the categories of protected veterans listed below, please indicate by making the appropriate selection. As a government contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA), we request this information in order to measure the effectiveness of the outreach and positive recruitment efforts we undertake pursuant to VEVRAA. Classification of protected categories is as follows:

  • Disabled veteran: one of the following: a veteran of the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service who is entitled to compensation (or who but for the receipt of military retired pay would be entitled to compensation) under laws administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs; or a person who was discharged or released from active duty because of a service‑connected disability.
  • Recently separated veteran: any veteran during the three‑year period beginning on the date of such veteran’s discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service.
  • Active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran: a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense.
  • Armed forces service medal veteran: a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985.

Disability Self‑Identification

We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified people with disabilities. We have a goal of having at least 7% of our workers as people with disabilities. The law says we must measure our progress toward this goal. To do this, we must ask applicants and employees if they have a disability or have ever had one. People can become disabled, so we need to ask this question at least every five years.

Completing this form is voluntary, and we hope that you will choose to do so. Your answer is confidential. No one who makes hiring decisions will see it. Your decision to complete the form and your answer will not harm you in any way. If you want to learn more about the law or this form, visit the U.S. Department of Labor’s Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) website at www.dol.gov/ofccp.

How do you know if you have a disability? A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)
  • Autoimmune disorder, for example, lupus, fibromyalgia, rheumatoid arthritis, HIV/AIDS
  • Blind or low vision
  • Cancer (past or present)
  • Cardiovascular or heart disease

  • Gastrointestinal disorders, for example, Crohn's Disease, irritable bowel syndrome
  • Intellectual or developmental disability
  • Mental health conditions, for example, depression, bipolar disorder, anxiety disorder, schizophrenia, PTSD
  • Missing limbs or partially missing limbs
  • Mobility impairment, benefiting from the use of a wheelchair, scooter, walker, leg brace(s) and/or other supports

title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend (Platform)
description:
Role Description

We are looking for a Staff or Principal-level software engineer to join our Compute team. This is a backend-heavy role with a focus on computation, performance, data systems design, and systems architecture. You'll drive architectural decisions that compound over years, write the technical designs that shape how the team builds, and directly influence the long-term trajectory of Hex's compute platform — all while staying deeply hands-on in the codebase.

What you will do:

  • Evolve Hex's execution architecture — the graph-based system that compiles, plans, and runs user notebooks — including proposing and building entirely new compute components that support faster, smarter execution.
  • Drive parallel execution strategies and caching approaches that reduce latency and minimize unnecessary round trips to external data warehouses.
  • Instrument complex systems to surface and diagnose performance problems to give the team and our customers a much clearer picture of where time is being spent.
  • Collaborate across engineering and product to support new platform capabilities, such as building an internal query language that compiles to the appropriate dialect for any connected warehouse.
  • Author and review technical proposals, and mentor engineers to implement ambitious designs effectively.
  • Propose and roadmap long-term designs with clear milestones across quarters.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of backend engineering experience, with a strong focus on computation, performance, database/storage optimization, and systems architecture.
  • Experience with parallel execution strategies, caching strategies, and the trade-offs involved in remote data warehouse computation.
  • A track record of solving difficult, large-scale systems design problems involving significant data and operational complexity — writing code and reviewing code of your teammates.
  • The ability to move from abstract, vague problems to well-articulated, well-reasoned technical solutions — and to roadmap ambitious designs with clear milestones across quarters.
  • A strong communicator; comfortable leading technical work and collaborating across a remote-first team.
  • Python and/or TypeScript required; experience with both is a plus.

Requirements

  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker and cloud infrastructure (nice to have).
  • Some frontend experience — this is a backend-focused role, but a willingness to occasionally wire a feature all the way through is a plus.

Benefits

  • Competitive total rewards package, including market-benched salary & equity.
  • Comprehensive health benefits.
  • Flexible paid time off.

Company Description

Our product is a web-based notebook and app authoring platform. Our frontend is built with Typescript and React, using a combination of Apollo GraphQL and Redux for managing application state and data. On the backend, we also use Typescript to power an Express/Apollo GraphQL server that interacts with Postgres, Redis, and Kubernetes to manage our database and Python kernels. Our backend is tightly integrated with our infrastructure and CI/CD, where we use a combination of Terraform, Helm, and AWS to deploy and maintain our stack.

title: VP of Delivery
description:
About Akka

Akka builds the platform that enterprises use to develop, deploy, and operate agentic AI systems. Our customers run mission-critical workloads on top of Akka — many of them in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, public sector, defense-adjacent) where the cost of an outage, a data leak, or a botched upgrade is measured in regulatory exposure, not just churn. They are not buying SaaS. They are buying a managed runtime they can stake their business on.

We extend resilience guarantees and 99.9999% availability commitments, and we deliver those through a hosted managed service.

The role

The VP of Delivery owns the end-to-end customer experience: proof of concepts, onboarding, production operations, reliability, support, and the human relationships that turn a first deployment into a long-term partnership. This is not a SaaS-style "customer success" role — it is a delivery leadership role for a high-reliability managed service. The person in this seat is accountable for whether our customers' agentic AI workloads stay up, stay secure, and stay aligned with the commitments we made to them.

What you'll own

  • Customer outcomes. Every customer's production health, renewal posture, and reference-ability. You know the names of the top accounts, the state of their environments, and the next three things we owe them.
  • Reliability as the customer experiences it. SLO commitments to customers, incident response, change management, and the operational rituals that keep customer workloads running. SRE owns platform reliability and Engineering owns building the product; you own how both land for the customer and you push hard on each when the customer experience requires it.
  • The delivery org. customer engineers, TAMs, and the operations function that runs the managed service. You hire, develop, and hold the bar for the people who are physically in the room (or on the call) with our customers.
  • Customer compliance enablement. Our customers run regulated workloads on Akka under many different regimes; you make sure our product and the way we deliver it actively help them maintain their own compliance posture. The CISO owns Akka's posture; you own translating it into evidence, behavior, and product feedback our customers can stand behind to their own auditors.
  • The feedback loop into Product and Engineering. You are the highest-fidelity signal in the company about what our customers actually need next, and you make sure that signal lands.

What we're looking for:

Mindset (the part we care most about)

  • You own the customer's success as if it were your own business.
  • Customer-obsessed, not customer-pleasing. You will tell a customer "no" when "yes" would set them up to fail. You will tell us "we shipped them a problem" when we did.
  • Operator's instinct. You are drawn to the dashboard, the runbook, the postmortem. You believe reliability is a product feature and you treat it like one.
  • Orchestrating us internally for the customer’s best. You make sure we together, irrespective of formal organization, use our strengths to make the customer successful.
  • Comfortable with regulated reality. You don't bristle at change advisory boards, evidence collection, or auditor questions. You see them as part of the job and you've made them efficient before.
  • Bias toward systems over heroics. When something breaks twice, you fix the system, not just the incident. You build delivery orgs that don't depend on any one person being awake.
  • Builder, not administrator. Akka is still small enough that the VP of Delivery writes the playbook, doesn't inherit it. You are energized by that, not daunted.

Experience (the part we'll flex on for the right mindset)

  • Has run a high-reliability managed service — meaning real production workloads, real on-call, real SLAs with teeth — for regulated or security-sensitive customers. Pure multi-tenant SaaS experience is not the same thing and is not sufficient on its own.
  • Background that includes time as an SRE, platform engineer, or solutions architect — not just management.
  • Has led delivery, customer engineering, TAM, or managed-services orgs at a company selling to regulated enterprises (financial services, healthcare, public sector, critical infrastructure, or similar).
  • Has worked across multiple compliance regimes that customers care about — SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, FedRAMP, DORA, EU AI Act, or equivalents. We don't require deep expertise in any single one; we do require having operated in enough of them to know how delivery work shows up in a customer's audit and how our product helps or hurts their compliance.
  • Has built and scaled a delivery organization through a stage transition (e.g., from founder-led delivery to a real org, or from one region to multi-region).
  • Our platform integrates tightly with Kubernetes on all hyperscalers. It uses established technologies and complements those with our competence from distributed systems. (GCP, AWS, Azure, K8s, Go, Helm, Kustomize, Crossplane, Java, Scala, Akka Libraries)

Nice to have, not required

  • Recent, hands-on exposure to AI / agentic systems in production. Our product is an AI runtime; the person leading delivery cannot be learning what an LLM is on the job. "Recent" means within the last ~18 months and on workloads you were accountable for, not workloads you read about.
  • Experience with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, or actor-model platforms.
  • Exposure to data residency / international transfer regimes (GDPR, UK GDPR, Schrems II realities).

How we'll evaluate

We weigh mindset and approach above years-of-experience checkboxes. The interview loop is built to surface:

  1. How you reason about reliability tradeoffs under regulatory constraint.
  2. How you've actually handled a serious customer-facing incident — what you did, what you'd do differently, what you institutionalized afterward.
  3. How you think about AI-specific operational risks (model behavior drift, prompt/tool misuse, data leakage through agents) and how those should show up in a delivery org.
  4. How you build and manage a team that holds a hard line on quality without becoming the team customers route around.

A candidate with ten years of SaaS customer success and no managed-service or AI exposure is not a fit for this seat, regardless of title progression. A candidate with seven years of managed-services delivery in regulated industries and twelve months of serious agentic-AI work probably is.

Logistics

  • Location: Remote – US, Canada, European-based
  • Compensation: Base + variable + equity
  • Travel: Expect meaningful customer-site travel, especially in the first year.
  • Start: This is an immediate need. Once found, the right person will start asap.

What We Offer

  • A transparent, distributed work environment with a strong focus on work-life balance.
  • Challenging work that interacts with innovative applications used by millions.
  • A collaborative culture that attracts the "brightest minds" in the technology community.

Our Core Values:

  • We’re Authentic: We value transparency and genuine communication, without politics or games. We're honest and assume good intentions, cultivating trust and accountability within our organization and in our interactions with others outside of Lightbend.
  • We’re Customer-Focused: We value customer outcomes above all else. By prioritizing our customers' interests, and meeting them where they are today, we help ensure their success. We are dedicated to deeply understanding our customer’s needs, anticipating challenges, navigating time constraints and striving to exceed expectations.
  • We’re Nonconventional: We value fearless innovation by challenging the status quo and embracing alternative approaches. Continuous learning and a growth mindset aimed at improving ourselves, our company, and our products, drives us to push boundaries and explore new solutions. Guided by a bias for action, we leverage industry and customer insights to inspire fresh ideas, enabling optimal future offerings.
  • We’re Persistent: We value excellence through continuous experimentation and courageous problem-solving. We recognize that achieving success often demands approaching challenges with tenacity and taking calculated risks to achieve leading-edge solutions.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

Akka is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace, welcoming individuals from all backgrounds and experiences. We celebrate differences and provide equal opportunities for all employees.

description:
Job Title: Senior Associate Scientist- Vaccine

  • Location: Waltham, MA

About the Job:

We are seeking a highly motivated and scientifically rigorous individual to join the Plasmid Production Pilot team. You will focus on execution and scale-up of a robust pDNA production process focusing on bacterial cell lysis, supercoiled plasmid DNA linearization, and purification for preclinical linearized plasmid DNA production, with the ultimate goal of transferring at scale methods to either the internal or external manufacturing team for mRNA drug substance with applications towards vaccine development.

Join the team protecting half a billion lives every year with next-gen science, mRNA innovation, and AI-driven breakthroughs. In Vaccines, you’ll help advance prevention on a global scale - and shape the future of immunization.

About Sanofi:

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate, and implement purification technology and optimize existing techniques and workflows.

  • Support the execution and optimization of plasmid DNA purification, problem solving.

  • Design and execute decision-quality research; prepare/draft SOPs, technical reports, batch record, and presentations to management and other stakeholders.

  • Work independently, pro-actively, and be an impactful contributor to project teams. Function in highly collaborative cross functional teams.

  • Execute ~20 batches per year.

  • This will be primarily a lab-based position.

About You:

Basic Qualifications:

Education:

  • Bachelor's OR Master's degree in Biotechnology, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or related scientific field

Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree holders: Minimum 3+ years of relevant industry experience in pharma, biotech, or laboratory settings

  • Master's degree holders: Minimum 1+ year of relevant industry experience in pharma, biotech, or laboratory settings

  • Hands-on experience with HPLC (High-Performance Liquid Chromatography) operations

  • Wet lab experience, particularly with fermentation or purification processes (plasmid DNA, protein, or similar)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience in small- and large-scale plasmid DNA extraction and purification methodologies including alkali lysis, chromatography separation (anion exchange, hydrophobic interaction) and buffer exchange methods

  • Familiar with Cytiva AKTA Pilot and Repligen TFF system (K2Ri and KMPi)

  • Familiar with Sartorius PATfix system

  • Prepare buffers for purification process

  • Familiar with equipment setup, process troubleshooting and maintenance and experience in GLP environment is advantageous

  • Works collaboratively within group for improved operational excellence as well as within interdisciplinary teams

  • Desire to work in a team-first, fast-paced environment, learn new technologies and skills, and to efficiently solve problems

  • Excellent organizational and communication skills

  • Attention to detail & meticulous record keeping

  • Demonstrate continuous growth in depth and breadth of personal scientific knowledge and understanding of strategic goals of group, team, and company

Why Choose Us?

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.

  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.

  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.

  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.

  • Work at the forefront of AI-driven research, smart manufacturing, and groundbreaking mRNA platforms that are redefining the future of immunology.

  • Help protect half a billion people every year, contributing to one of the largest global vaccination efforts in healthcare.

  • Develop your career with access to mentoring, international mobility programs, and opportunities to grow across four continents.

title: ProServices Program Analyst

This position is based at our headquarters in Mooresville, North Carolina. Our corporate office is a space where you can collaborate and do your best work. Take a walk, grab a bite (or a cup of coffee), work out or get a check-up – we invest in you so you can find your inspiration.

This role is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, influence decision-making across functions, and lead continuous improvement efforts that create lasting value for the business, field teams, and customers.

title: Bird Tour Coordinator
location: Remote (with travel as needed. All travel will be reimbursed.)
description:
Title: Bird Tour Coordinator

Supervisor: Vice President of Development

Location: Remote (with travel as needed. All travel will be reimbursed.)

Salary: Estimated at $86,310 - $95,900*; Based on experience


Application Deadline: Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.


Position Summary:


American Bird Conservancy (ABC) is seeking a passionate and experienced full-time Bird Tour Coordinator to organize and oversee domestic and international birding field trips for ABC’s major supporters. ABC is a fast-growing, results-focused wildlife conservation non-profit seeking an employee with an entrepreneurial spirit and a desire to make a difference for birds throughout the Americas. ABC takes bold action to conserve wild birds and their habitats. Inspired by the wonder of birds, we achieve lasting results for the bird species most in need while also benefiting human communities, biodiversity, and the planet’s fragile climate. Our every action is underpinned by science, strengthened by partnerships, and rooted in the belief that diverse perspectives yield stronger results.


This position is crucial for strengthening ABC’s relationships with donors by planning and executing exceptional birding experiences that highlight ABC’s conservation efforts. The Bird Tour Coordinator will plan and organize birding trips, some of which ABC has operated for years, and others which would be new to the organization.


Primary Duties:

  • Plan and coordinate domestic and international birding field trips for ABC’s major supporters, approximately three 3-4 day domestic trips/year and two week-long international trips/year, noting that some trips may be outside of the Americas.
  • Arrange for ABC staff and/or experienced birding tour guides to lead trips, and lead select birding trips.
  • Manage logistics related to travel, accommodations, permits, and schedules for ABC-led birding excursions.
  • Promote ABC’s mission by communicating with tour participants and industry professionals about ABC’s conservation work.
  • Ensure high-quality birding experiences that align with ABC’s values and conservation priorities.
  • Coordinate closely with Development, Communications & Marketing, and Program staff as well as ABC partners to ensure the success of trips and events.
  • Help develop ABC field trip policies and practices, such as trip descriptions, travel/medical insurance info/waiver, participant responsibilities, etc.
  • Advise on ABC trips organized by other staff members.
  • Provide input into birding trip pricing structure and strategy.

description:
Interwell Health is a kidney care management company that partners with physicians on its mission to reimagine healthcare—with the expertise, scale, compassion, and vision to set the standard for the industry and help patients live their best lives. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you’re a highly motivated individual with strong fundamentals in computer science and hands‑on experience across the full model development lifecycle—including feature engineering, model development, calibration, deployment, and ongoing monitoring. In this role, you will be flexible, eager to learn new skills, and willing to contribute wherever the team needs support. This Machine Learning Engineer is comfortable working with both traditional tabular machine learning models and modern AI techniques, including prompt engineering and LLM‑based capabilities.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and deliver end‑to‑end machine learning solutions, including defining technical requirements, architecting scalable systems, and implementing monitoring, logging, and maintenance workflows.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, clinicians, and cross‑functional partners to build new ML products and enhance existing systems.

  • Develop and customize API integrations to enable seamless connectivity between cloud‑based systems and ML services.

What You’ll Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Software/Computer Engineering, Computational Statistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
  • 3+ years of end‑to‑end ML development in production (data prep, feature engineering, modeling, calibration, deployment, monitoring, maintenance).
  • 3+ years of MLOps experience building production pipelines (CI/CD, model registry, feature store), implementing monitoring & drift detection, and automating retraining.
  • 3+ years of Python for production ML (testing, packaging, type hints, linting) and SQL for analytical and production workloads; Scala a plus.
  • 2+ years working with distributed compute and cloud ML environments (e.g., Spark/Databricks on Azure/AWS/GCP) and modern data ecosystems (data lakes, DBMS).
  • Strong debugging and optimization skills across data and ML workflows.
  • Track record of ownership and problem solving—driving measurable impact and quality under ambiguity and evolving requirements.
  • Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly and contribute to documentation and design discussions.
  • Demonstrated system design & architecture skills for scalable, high‑performance ML services and batch/streaming workflows; familiarity with API design and service integration patterns.
  • Proven understanding of tradeoffs in latency, cost, performance, and compliance.

Preferred

  • 1+ years of Databricks experience + some experience in infrastructure/networking
  • 1+ years implementing LLM‑based solutions in production (prompt/response design, evaluation frameworks, guardrails/safety, latency/cost optimization).
  • 1+ years designing compliant ML platforms (e.g., HIPAA, SOC 2) and working with PHI/PII governance, access controls, and auditability.

title: Product Manager
description:
Murphy AI deploys voice AI agents that help banks collect debt. We’ve built a fully-fledged platform designed to optimize recovery rates while maintaining respectful and personalized communication. Our advanced automation streamlines the process of collecting overdue invoices for banks and other industries, providing a seamless and effective solution.

Our AI-powered agents adapt instantly, engaging with debtors across channels like voice, messengers, email and sms to maximize results while preserving trust. By combining advanced artificial intelligence with powerful automation, we’re setting a new standard for how businesses recover payments.

As a fast-growing startup that has already made an impact within less than a year in the market, we are building a talented team to scale our operations and drive our vision forward 🌟

About the Role

We're looking for a Product Manager to own a core piece of Murphy, end to end, like a founder would. This is a founding product seat on the most advanced AI product in a $300B+ market — a small product function, an outsized mandate, and the category as your ceiling.

Murphy builds AI voice agents that collect overdue debt for banks: more recovered, faster, cheaper, fully compliant, and respectful to the debtor. We're live with Santander, Revolut, BBVA and dozens others. We've proven the product in large-scale pilots with top-tier banks — now we're turning a service into a product, and we need product builders to own each surface.

What you'll do

  • Own a product end to end. Strategy, roadmap, execution, launch, iterate — you're the CEO of your product, accountable for the business outcomes, not just its ship dates.

  • Make the voice AI agents more efficient. Own the loop: customer segments, experiments on voice, cadence and script, and the evals that prove a change is real before it ships to a bank.

  • Build with AI as the primitive. Prototypes, not design mock-ups; wire agents into the product itself; use AI to design, build and ship faster than a team of 12 people.

  • Turn services into product. Today a new bank goes live through weeks of hand-configuration by our engineers. Convert it into a scaleable product.

  • Dive deep and problem solve. Get to the roots of complex problems, understand all the nuances and design solutions that solve the root cause elegantly.

  • Be an inspiring leader for engineers and data scientists.

Who you are

  • A builder, whatever your title says. You've taken products 0→1 and scaled them past launch whether as a founder, or PM, or engineer.

  • You own outcomes, and you never settle. You turn ambiguity into a clear plan, and hold a high quality bar under speed.

  • You have a STEM-degree, and you were top of your class. You’re technical and have a strong philosophy of a champion.

  • AI-native. You're deeply curious about AI, already build with it daily, and think in agents — not "add an AI feature". You know exactly where AI gets sloppy. You never let that through, and you control quality rigorously.

  • You don't need a collections or fintech background. We'd rather teach the domain to a killer product builder than hire a domain lifer who can't ship.

🤝 What we offer

💰 Salary at the top of the benchmark.

📈 Fair equity with enormous upside potential.

🧩 Real Ownership - Murphy's strategy is yours to drive.

🙌 Small team, high autonomy, and outsized impact.

🗣️ The founding team's direct attention, and a category with a $300B+ industry behind it.

🛜 Hybrid & Flexible: Our default setup is hybrid – 3 days a week at our office, and 2 days of remote work.

📚 Our Process

1️⃣ First Interview – Getting to Know You

A conversation with a future teammate who’s excited to find a new colleague. We’ll talk about your story, what drives you, and what you’re looking for next—no trick questions, just a genuine exchange.

2️⃣ Second Interview – Deep Dive

You’ll meet the Hiring Manager and potentially another team member. This is a more technical discussion where we explore your skills in detail, walk through real scenarios, and answer any questions you might have about the role.

3️⃣ Tech Assessment or Business Case

A practical exercise to see how you approach challenges similar to those you’d tackle at Murphy. You’ll have time to reflect and showcase your thinking—no rush, no surprises.

4️⃣ Call with the Founders

Our founders meet every team member and it’s a great opportunity for you to learn about the company and its direction.

👉 To learn more about how we hire and what to expect at every step, feel free to explore our Hiring Guide!

👉 We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where everyone, regardless of background, identity, or experience, feels valued and empowered to thrive. We believe that different perspectives drive innovation and success, and we actively foster an environment where all voices are heard and respected.

title: Senior Mobile Authentication Integration Engineer (iOS/Android)
description:
Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a highly experienced Mobile Authentication Integration Engineer to support the Department of Defense's next-generation enterprise Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) platform that is replacing DS Logon and providing secure authentication services for millions of Service Members, Veterans, Family Members, and Beneficiaries. The Alternative Multi-factor Authentication Support Services (AMASS) Program provides secure, scalable identity and access management services across the Department of Defense, enabling authentication, authorization, and digital identity interoperability for high visibility DoD systems.

In this role you will specialize in native mobile identity integration to support a Federal customer's secure mobility and authentication programs with emphasis on implementing phishing-resistant authentication, enterprise identity workflows, and secure SDK integrations into native iOS and Android applications. This role is oriented toward enterprise identity engineering, not traditional user-interface or consumer application development.

This is a 100% remote role.

Responsibilities
• Integrate Okta Identity Engine (OIE) Embedded SDKs into native iOS and Android applications in compliance with Federal identity requirements
• Implement OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), PKCE, token lifecycle management, and secure session handling
• Develop secure mobile authentication, identity enrollment, and account recovery workflows aligned with Federal digital identity standards
• Implement FIDO2/WebAuthn, passkeys, and other phishing-resistant authentication mechanisms
• Integrate CAC/PIV, Purebred, and other government-issued mobile credentials
• Manage secure storage of credentials and tokens using iOS Keychain and Android Keystore
• Implement device registration, trusted device policies, and mobile biometric authentication (Face ID, Touch ID, Android Biometrics)
• Apply mobile application security controls including OWASP Mobile Top 10, certificate pinning, TLS configuration, and secure network communication
• Troubleshoot authentication, SDK, API, and mobile platform integration issues

Design mobile enrollment workflows compliant with NIST SP 800-63.

Implement secure application routing using Universal Links and Android App Links.
• Implement proxy user experiences supporting dependent access.
• Design seamless in-app authentication experiences eliminating browser redirects.
• Support integration of native mobile applications with enterprise IAM/CIAM systems used across Federal agencies
• Ensure compliance with NIST SP 800-63 Digital Identity Guidelines and Zero Trust authentication principles
• Participate in Agile development processes, DevSecOps pipelines, and CI/CD workflows
• Collaborate with Federal cybersecurity, identity management, and mobile engineering teams to ensure secure delivery of mobile identity capabilities.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications
  • Minimum of 8 years with BS/BA; Minimum of 6 years with MS/MA; Minimum of 3 years with PhD
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline; or equivalent experience
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust
  • U.S. Citizenship required
  • Extensive experience in native iOS development using Swift
  • Extensive experience in native Android development using Kotlin/Java
  • Hands-on experience integrating Okta Identity Engine (OIE) Embedded SDKs into native applications
  • Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0, OIDC, PKCE, and secure token management
  • Experience implementing FIDO2/WebAuthn, passkeys, and other phishing-resistant authentication methods
  • Knowledge of mobile identity enrollment, account recovery, and secure credential storage techniques
  • Experience integrating RESTful APIs and enterprise backend identity services
  • Familiarity with CAC/PIV, Purebred, and other Federal mobile credentials
  • Background in mobile security including OWASP Mobile Top 10, certificate pinning, and TLS
  • Experience with CI/CD systems, automated testing, and mobile release management
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across authentication flows, SDK integrations, and mobile platforms
  • Experience supporting enterprise or Federal mobile authentication solutions
  • Knowledge of NIST SP 800-63 Digital Identity Guidelines
  • Understanding of Zero Trust authentication principles
  • Experience with Agile development and Git-based workflow
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working directly on Federal identity or cybersecurity programs
  • Experience integrating third-party authentication SDKs within regulated environments
  • Knowledge of Federal IAM architectures, identity federation, and enterprise identity platforms
  • Experience contributing to mobile security documentation, risk assessments, or compliance reviews

title: Professor of Practice: Environmental and Interior Design
description:
PROFESSOR OF PRACTICE (Non-Tenure-Track) SYRACUSE UNIVERSITY, School of Design-Environmental and Interior Design/B.F.A.

SYRACUSE UNIVERSITY invites applications to fill a full-time, three-year renewable Professor of Practice position in Environmental and Interior Design (EDI) within the School of Design, College of Visual and Performing Arts. Our four-year program is accredited by the Council for Interior Design Accreditation (CIDA), and has consistently been ranked among the best programs nationally. This success is attributed to our community; our faculty are experienced and committed to supporting the success and growth of the students, and our students are engaged, curious, and passionate. Our graduates earn a Bachelor of Fine Arts (BFA) degree, and are eligible to take the NCIDQ Examination, the industry's leading credential for interior design licensure. This is a three-year position, beginning Fall 2026.

The successful applicant should have ample industry experience and the ability to teach a broad range of undergraduate courses core to the EDI curriculum, including: lecture-based courses that cover technical, structural, and building, accessibility, and life-safety code content, professional practice, courses that teach design technology and digital tools relevant to industry, and design studios. The candidate must have a deep understanding of interior design and the flexibility to work and teach collaboratively with a diverse set of colleagues within the program and across the School of Design. Ideally, the successful candidate will foster relationships with alumni, industry, and outside stakeholders.

Responsibilities of the appointment include teaching undergraduate courses each semester as assigned, but also supporting relevant programmatic initiatives, participating in program-related meetings, assisting with assessment-related documentation, supporting and advising students, developing projects that enhance the curriculum, engaging with curricular enrichment events (i.e. field trips, firm crawls), and demonstrating continued excellence in relevant professional activities.

The School of Design is an inquisitive and intelligent community of faculty and students who address issues in context. As a professionally-oriented academic unit in a large research university, the School is fully committed to forging bold, imaginative, reciprocal relationships with constituents who are local as well as global. As a top tier research institution, Syracuse University faculty and students are equally encouraged to interact with the academic core of the University.

With a long and distinguished history at Syracuse University, the School of Design currently offers several highly ranked undergraduate programs in addition to the Environmental and Interior Design (BFA) degree, including: Industrial and Interaction Design (BID), Fashion Design (BFA), and Communications Design (BFA), and Design Studies (BS). The School also houses a graduate program in Museum Studies (MA). Enrolling approximately 420 undergraduate and 30 graduate students, the School of Design occupies the Nancy Cantor Warehouse in downtown Syracuse. To learn more about the School of Design, please visit our website at

The College of Visual and Performing Arts at Syracuse University is committed to the education of cultural leaders who will engage and inspire audiences through performance, visual art, design, scholarship, and commentary. We provide the tools for self-discovery and risk-taking in an environment that thrives on critical thought and action. description:
