title: Senior Datacenter and Cloud Engineer
description:
Senior Datacenter and Cloud Engineer

Cooley is seeking a Senior Technology Datacenter and Cloud Engineer to join the DevOps team.

Position summary: The Senior Data Center and Cloud Engineer ("DCE") is responsible for the firm's Datacenters and local office server rooms and is a technical expert who executes effectively on server infrastructure projects. This position will have a thorough understanding of firm technologies and systems and will be able to understand both the business and technical requirements for new products that will be engineered and implemented by the group.

Position responsibilities:

  • Analyze system performance, modify parameters to improve throughput and effectively utilize system resources. Monitor resource usage, making required adjustments
  • Participate in on-call production support activities
  • Work closely with the Architecture and Engineering group as well as the Network Engineering group to provision complex infrastructure designs, for example, the design, implementation and support of VMware server infrastructure
  • Monitor, maintain and ensure the regular execution of backup routines by responding to system alerts and maintaining data replication between datacenters and DR locations
  • Participate in the planning, testing and execution of DR/BC procedures including failover and failback between datacenters and across the Firm's network
  • Proactively create and implement procedures to prevent and reduce the severity of outages. Implement automation wherever possible
  • Responsible for implementation of required hardware and/or software for all tier and affinity infrastructure
  • Responsible for all aspects of the datacenternetwork including racking, cabling and power related to the infrastructure including those involving services from providers such as co-location management and carrier services
  • Maintain the integrity of the servers (physical and virtual), storage systems, network and security devices and overall network infrastructure for the business unit via actively monitoring, troubleshooting, and participating in regular monthly systems patching and upgrade activities
  • Responsible for identifying problem areas in a proactive way and developing solutions to meet the challenges in theDatacenter environment
  • Responsible for troubleshooting and issuemanagementthroughout the datacenter and cloud systems
  • Analyze business needs and the external environment to develop, scope, and enable implementation of enterprise infrastructure
  • Communicate ideas through presentations, reports, and documentation
  • Work with stakeholders, management, and subject matter experts to develop and implement technology strategies
  • Collaborate with technology leadership in developing and maintaining a roadmap for assigned areas
  • Coordinate with and participate in activities with vendors, as required
  • Provide clear and grammatically correct documentation, emails, procedures, and status (both verbal and written)
  • Comply with all department policies, standards and procedures
  • Participate in change control and change managementprocesses
  • Respond to administrative requests and responsibilities in a timely manner
  • All other duties as assigned or required

Skills and experience:

Required:

  • After orientation at Cooley LLP, exhibit proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite, iManage and other firm applications
  • Ability to work extended and/or weekend hours, as required
  • Ability to travel, as required
  • 6+ years' direct applicable experience (e.g., system administration with advanced systems engineering)
  • Enterprise architecture expertise for both collocated and cloud datacenters
  • Experience with Hyperscalers, specifically Azure and AWS
  • Experience with VMWare and other enterprise hypervisors

Preferred:

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or related discipline
  • Current certifications in AWS or Azure or VMware
  • Experience working in a law firm or professional services environment
  • NetApp storage and enterprise storage protocols to include CIFS, NFS, iSCSI, and FC
  • Experience with backup software Cohesity or Veeam and AWS Backup
  • Experience with:
  • Enterprise server technology, specifically Cisco UCS
  • Scripting with PowerShell and/or Python
  • Enterprise backup technologies
  • Enterprise DR Methodologies and technologies
  • DevOps technologies and methods

Competencies:

  • Professional demeanor at all times, including during project engagement
  • Excellent communication (verbal and written) skills
  • Strong project management skills, and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into simple language
  • Strong team player who can successfully interact with all levels of business professionals and effectively work with diverse personalities
  • Strong analytical and project management skills. Capable of interpreting and applying complex technical information
  • Ability to work independently and to make sound judgments regarding the best course of action to resolve problems; ability to determine when further expertise is necessary and contact the proper individuals, as required
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure, set priorities, handle a number of matters concurrently and in a timely manner, all within a fast-paced environment
  • High level of organizational skills required to adequately manage projects, monitor numerous live systems simultaneously, ascertain trends which may indicate problems and keep accurate up-to-date records

Cooley offers a competitive compensation and excellent benefits package and is committed to fair and equitable employment practices. EOE.

title: Scrum Master

title: Configuration Management Coordinator
description:
Configuration Management Coordinator

The Opportunity:

As the Configuration Management Lead, you will be responsible for defining, maintaining, and auditing the baseline configuration of complex enterprise network systems deployed across naval and defense environments. You will lead the configuration control board (CCB) process, ensure strict compliance with Department of Defense (DoD) cybersecurity frameworks, manage baseline changes (ECR), and maintain accurate configuration records. This role requires close collaboration with systems engineers, network architects, cybersecurity specialists, and U.S. Navy stakeholders.

What You’ll Work On:

  • Establish, document, and manage the project’s Configuration Management Plan (CMP) and Navy-specific engineering policies.

  • Establish and maintain Functional, Allocated, and Product baselines for enterprise network hardware, operating systems, firmware, and logical topology configurations.

  • Maintain the Configuration Management Database (CMDB) and ensure 100% traceability from initial requirements through deployment and operational maintenance.

  • Chair and facilitate the project Configuration Control Board (CCB), managing technical reviews, risk assessments, and impact analyses for all proposed system modifications.

  • Draft, review, and process Engineering Change Requests (ECRs).

  • Assess proposed network routing, switching, and security policy changes for potential technical conflicts, security vulnerabilities, or operational downtime impacts.

  • Ensure all technical configurations strictly adhere established policies and technical guidelines such as STIGs.

  • Coordinate with Information Assurance (IA) and Cybersecurity leads to align CM processes with the Risk Management Framework (RMF) Authorization to Operate (ATO) lifecycle.

  • Support configuration auditing for cloud and shore-based systems, verifying physical and functional configurations against baseline documentation.

  • Execute and document formal functional configuration prior to key program milestones and system handoffs.

  • Maintain detailed CM product artifacts such as SVDDs, configuration plans and ECRs.

  • Maintain real-time visibility into baseline status, open ECRs, and pending hardware or software modifications.

  • Drive continuous automation.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience in configuration management

  • 3+ years of experience supporting U.S. Navy or DoD maritime network engineering programs such as CANES, ISNS, ONENet, Navy Sea2Sky, or shore communications infrastructure

  • Experience with technical writing and developing robust CM plans, ECRs, and technical standard operating procedures (SOPs)

  • Knowledge of network topology, enterprise routers or switches, firewalls, VLANs, routing protocols such as OSPF or BGP, and network baseline auditing tools

  • Ability to present complex configuration impacts to military commanders, technical directors, and civilian program managers

  • Ability to proactively solve problems

  • Secret clearance

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Information Technology

Nice If You Have:

  • Experience supporting NAVWAR, NAVSEA, or NIWC Atlantic or Pacific

  • Experience with Navy afloat operational environments, shipboard installation processes, including SHIPMAIN, Installation Drawings, or SCDs, and C4I systems

  • Experience building and executing test plans

  • Experience with digital CM platforms, Jira, ServiceNow, enterprise CMDB tools, and version control software such as Git, GitLab, or Azure DevOps

  • Experience with automated configuration tracking and network compliance assessment tools

  • Ability to pay strict attention to detail

  • Possession of excellent leadership and briefing skills

  • Configuration Management Certification such as CMPIC, NDIA CM, or CMI Certification

  • DoD 8570.01-M IAT Level II certification such as Security+ CE, CCNA, or CISSP Certification

title: Staff Solutions Architect
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

Fivetran is building the infrastructure that powers analytics and AI. We’re looking for a New Business Commercial Account Executive to help more companies across DACH move, trust and use their data at scale.

About The Role

A Staff Solutions Architect is a senior pre-sales technical leader who partners with sales, customers, partners, and internal stakeholders to shape technical strategy, design strong dbt-centered solutions, and convert technical progress into predictable commercial outcomes. The role includes the full Senior Solutions Architect foundation and adds broader scope, deeper architectural leadership, stronger influence across complex accounts, and greater contribution to reusable patterns, enablement, and field standards.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys creating opportunities as much as closing them. You’ll play a hands-on role in outbound prospecting, shaping your own pipeline and guiding customers through thoughtful, consultative sales conversations. This is a high-ownership role with significant autonomy and responsibility from day one.

What you'll do:

  • Lead technical discovery to understand business drivers, technical context, constraints, decision process, and success criteria.
  • Run product demonstrations, workshops, evaluations, and proof-oriented engagements that map dbt capabilities to real customer problems.
  • Design pragmatic solution architectures spanning dbt, warehouses, orchestration, BI, governance, and adjacent ecosystem tooling.
  • Partner closely with account teams on qualification, technical win criteria, risks, next steps, and forecast accuracy.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor for analytics engineers, data engineers, architects, and technical decision-makers.
  • Communicate complex topics clearly in both written and verbal form, adapting depth and framing to the audience.
  • Support customer adoption and expansion by connecting technical outcomes to additional use cases and long-term platform value.
  • Model dbt values through professionalism, curiosity, accountability, collaboration, and a growth mindset.

What differentiates a Staff Solutions Architect:

In addition to the responsibilities above, a Staff Solutions Architect is expected to:

  • Consistently frame strong early technical angles that improve pipeline quality and qualification.
  • Uncover root causes, decision processes, and hidden constraints in varied and often complex customer situations.
  • Use the sales process deliberately to structure technical work, maintain clear status, and provide actionable risk assessments.
  • Engage as a credible peer on design, performance, maintainability, and architecture trade-offs across the modern data stack.
  • Deliver well-phased architectures that reflect organizational complexity, adoption realities, governance needs, and long-term evolution.
  • Design strong integration approaches across multiple warehouses, orchestrators, BI tools, and partner technologies.
  • Equip champions with compelling narratives, proof points, and technical materials that help advance initiatives internally.
  • Maintain a complete and comprehensible view of deals, workload, and technical milestones that improves forecasting quality.
  • Generate reusable demos, templates, write-ups, patterns, and assets that other SAs can adopt and adapt.
  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships across sales, product, marketing, success, partners, and the broader SA organization.
  • Influence how dbt-centric architecture patterns are defined, scaled, and reused beyond a single account or territory.

Skills we're looking for:

A strong candidate for this role will typically bring:

  • Experience in pre-sales, solutions architecture, sales engineering, or a comparable customer-facing technical role.
  • Strong understanding of dbt, analytics engineering, SQL, data transformation, and modern cloud data platforms.
  • Ability to lead technical strategy in complex enterprise opportunities with multiple stakeholders and moving parts.
  • Comfort navigating ambiguity, balancing short-term deal support with long-term architectural quality, and operating in a fast-changing environment.
  • Evidence of mentoring, force-multiplying peers, or creating assets and practices that improve team effectiveness.
  • Strong executive communication, technical storytelling, and written documentation skills.

title: Scientist 2, Biochemical and Cellular Pharmacology
description:
The Opportunity

Join Genentech's Biochemical and Cellular Pharmacology Department and help shape the future of cardio-metabolic therapeutics. We are seeking a creative, motivated scientist to drive the discovery and characterization of innovative drug candidates that could transform patient outcomes.

Operating at the intersection of cutting-edge science and drug development, you will support the selection and characterization of therapeutic candidates across our pipeline. In this role, you will develop, validate, and execute sophisticated biochemical and cell-based assays in heterologous and physiologically relevant systems to evaluate drugs in cardiovascular, renal and metabolic areas. You will support projects from initial lead finding through optimization, conducting detailed mechanistic studies on complex receptor signaling pathways and protein interactions. Ultimately, your scientific insights will help define target candidate profiles and shape the screening cascades that deliver our next-generation therapeutics.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Design and execute rigorous experiments independently, troubleshoot issues, analyze complex data using advanced computational tools and software, and document results

  • Drive screening efforts across multiple projects, leveraging a comprehensive toolkit of functional assays and technologies

  • Pioneer novel assay platforms that interrogate complex receptor pharmacology and mechanism of action, showing scientific curiosity and reviewing literature to drive your initiatives

  • Drive automation and efficiency using laboratory robotics (Bravo, Tecan, Echo…) to streamline workflows and accelerate timelines

  • Collaborate across multidisciplinary teams in a fast-paced environment, generate high-quality presentations, and communicate findings to stakeholders

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree and/or Master's degree in Cell Biology, Pharmacology, Biochemistry, or related field

  • 5+ years of hands-on research experience in fast-paced pharma or biotech environments

  • Expert-level proficiency with culture of mammalian cells, primary cells, and stable cell line generation

  • Knowledgeable in G-protein coupled receptor (GPCR) signaling pathways, ligand-receptor binding kinetics, and standard pharmacological characterization

  • Hands-on experience with a variety of microplate-format biochemical and cellular assays (e.g., HTRF, AlphaScreen, or luminescence-based readouts)

  • A critical thinker with strong problem-solving abilities and scientific rigor

  • Independent and collaborative—equally comfortable leading your own work and working as a team

  • Organized and detail-oriented, with excellent time management skills

  • An excellent communicator (written and verbal) who can work seamlessly across cross-functional project teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • Expertise in the cardiovascular, renal, or metabolic disease field

  • Experience with flow cytometry, ELISA assays, or high-content image analysis

  • Experience with lab automation and high-throughput screening

  • Proficiency with data analysis software and visualization tools (GraphPad Prism, Genedata, Excel, Python, R)

title: Senior Data Analyst - Analytics & Transformation
description:
Senior Data Analyst - Analytics & Transformation

At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems. The Enterprise Data team is focused on maximizing the value of our data ecosystem and enabling real-time, intelligent experiences built on a scalable, future ready foundation. We are a highly collaborative, cross-functional team working across Product, Technology, Design, Risk, and other partners to build a modern enterprise data ecosystem.

We are looking for an exceptional and innovative Senior Data Analyst to solve complex business and product challenges across our Enterprise Data Product teams. You will lead Product Analytics to measure and improve the performance and health of our Products and Platforms, transforming complex data into actionable, AI-enabled insights that shape product strategy and drive better decisions. If you are a strategic thinker who thrives on solving complex problems and using Data and AI to influence product development, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

On any given day you will be challenged by three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

Innovation

  • Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms

  • Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers

  • Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives

Business Intelligence

  • Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization

  • Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies

Data Management

  • Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions

  • Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance

  • Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality

Our ideal candidate will have:

  • Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline

  • Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)

  • Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)

  • Experience utilizing and developing within Snowflake services

Basic Qualifications:

  • Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 2 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.

  • At least 1 year of experience working with at least one scripting language

  • At least 1 year of experience utilizing business intelligence visualization tool

  • At least 1 year of experience querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline

  • At least 2 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL

  • At least 2 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.

  • At least 1 year of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services

  • At least 1 year of experience working with and demonstrating knowledge of data governance, data quality management concepts and data quality tools (i.e. Informatica DQ)

title: Produce Clerk
location: Iowa Falls, S Oak St, Iowa Falls, IA
description:
Additional Considerations (if any):

Must be 18+

-

At Hy-Vee our people are our strength. We promise “a helpful smile in every aisle” and those smiles can only come from a workforce that is fully engaged and committed to supporting our customers and each other.

Job Description:

Job Title: Produce Clerk

Department: Produce

FLSA: Hourly

Revision Date: 07/2026

About Hy-Vee

At Hy-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We're seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers' lives easier, healthier and happier.

The Role and Why It's Important

At Hy-Vee, our produce department is one of the first impressions we make on every customer who walks through the door, and our Produce Clerks play a big role in making it a great one. In this role, you'll keep the department stocked, fresh, and inviting while delivering the kind of friendly service that keeps customers coming back. Whether you're rotating product, checking in deliveries, or helping a customer find what they need, your work makes a real difference every single day.

If you enjoy staying active, take pride in a job well done, and thrive working as part of a team, we'd love to have you on our team.

What You'll Do

No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:

  • Deliver outstanding customer service by greeting every customer with a smile, assisting them with their needs, and going the extra mile to make their shopping experience a great one

  • Review the status and appearance of merchandise for freshness and replenish and rotate product to maintain quality standards

  • Ensure an adequate product supply is ready and on hand; develop or follow a production list and anticipate daily product needs for the department

  • Check in product, put product away, and review invoices as needed

  • Prepare, finish, and replenish product as necessary

  • Practice proper sanitation procedures and keep the work area clean, neat, and safe at all times

  • Remove trash in a timely manner and assist with general department upkeep

  • Order product and supplies and price products for customers as needed

  • Answer the phone promptly and provide friendly, helpful service to customers who call

  • Follow Hy-Vee's dress code, hygiene standards, and all department and company guidelines

  • Pitch in with other tasks or special projects as they come up

Your Skills

You don't need extensive experience for this role; we'll provide the training you need to succeed. To hit the ground running, you'll need to be able to:

  • Bring commitment to Hy-Vee's mission and a genuine passion for helping customers

  • Follow written and verbal instructions carefully and with attention to detail

  • Apply basic math skills including simple addition, subtraction, counting, and recording

  • Communicate clearly with customers and co-workers and contribute positively to the team

  • Learn and apply proper sanitation, food safety, and department procedures

Reporting Relationships

Accountable and Reports to: Store Director; Store Manager; Assistant Managers of Perishables, Store Operations, Health Wellness Home; Produce Department Manager; Assistant Produce Department Manager

Education and Experience

  • Less than high school diploma or equivalent experience accepted

  • Six months or less of similar or related work experience; we'll provide all the training you need to succeed

Physical Requirements

  • Frequently stand and walk throughout a shift in sales, food service, or delivery areas

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to safely use sharp knives and blades for food preparation

  • Where applicable to the role: exposure to heat- and burn-related hazards associated with cooking, baking, or grilling equipment

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to operate a delivery vehicle in accordance with applicable DOT standards

  • Perform repetitive standing, walking, reaching, and bending associated with order fulfillment, POS transactions, and cleaning/sanitation duties

Working Environment

This is a fast-moving role where things stay busy and engaging. You'll work in the produce department and can expect frequent exposure to temperature extremes and dampness, as well as possible equipment movement hazards, electrical equipment, and cleaning chemicals and solvents. Safety is always a priority, and training is provided to help ensure a safe and supportive work environment.

Are you ready to smile, apply today.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre employment drug screen.

title: Strategic Sourcing Lead

As a Strategic Sourcing Lead within PNC's Supply Chain organization, you will be based in Pittsburgh, PA, Cleveland, OH, Strongsville, OH, or Birmingham, AL.

As a Strategic Sourcing Lead within PNC's Supply Chain Management organization, you will operate as a senior-level sourcing professional, driving complex initiatives and shaping category strategies that deliver enterprise-wide value.

title: Sr. Program Manager, M&A
description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

The Opportunity:

We’re looking for a sharp, execution-obsessed Senior Manager to join the Strategic Execution Office within Global Marketing Strategic Operations. This is not a traditional PMO role—it’s a high-impact seat at the intersection of M&A integration, marketing transformation, and AI-native ways of working.

You’ll translate enterprise priorities into structured integration plans, clear execution roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes. You’ll operate across cross-functional boundaries, bring operational rigor to complex initiatives, and drive accountability from kickoff to close-out—using AI as a strategic partner, not just a productivity shortcut.

The ideal candidate has a track record in transformational marketing program leadership, thrives in ambiguity, embraces AI-enabled workflows as foundational to how work gets done, and knows how to move fast without sacrificing quality.

What You’ll Do:

Program Leadership & Execution

  • Own end-to-end planning and execution strategic transformation programs.

  • Translate business priorities and acquisition objectives into structured program charters, workstreams, milestones, and measurable outcomes.

  • Manage multiple concurrent initiatives, ensuring delivery on time, within scope, and within budget.

  • Drive accountability and urgency across cross-functional teams. Challenge unproductive patterns and protect execution standards.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with leaders across Marketing and enterprise functions to align on strategy and drive execution.

  • Facilitate working sessions, governance forums, and executive reviews that move work forward—not just update stakeholders.

  • Serve as the connective tissue between strategic direction and day-to-day operational execution.

Strategic Planning & Prioritization

  • Support portfolio-level planning and prioritization within the Strategic Execution Office.

  • Identify and allocate resources to the highest-impact initiatives aligned to organizational strategy.

  • Translate strategic imperatives into actionable roadmaps with clear ownership and accountability.

Process Excellence & Documentation

  • Identify and implement improvements to workflows, tools, and integration processes.

  • Maintain structured documentation including charters, requirements, decision logs, roadmaps, and post-integration reviews.

  • Define and document business requirements to support operational and system changes.

  • Establish KPIs, milestones, and dashboards to monitor program health and outcomes.

  • Deliver structured status updates and executive-ready reporting to senior stakeholders.

  • Design feedback mechanisms into programs to drive continuous improvement.

AI-Native Execution & Accountability

  • Leverage AI tools (Microsoft 365 Copilot, Claude, Zoom AI Companion, and emerging platforms) as foundational to how you plan, execute, and communicate—not as optional add-ons.

  • Identify manual processes ripe for AI automation, design end-to-end AI-enabled workflows, and measure time savings and adoption across the team.

  • Use AI to generate executive-ready program narratives, QBR content, and stakeholder communications—always verifying outputs for accuracy before distribution.

  • Coach cross-functional partners and junior PMs on AI-native methodologies, prompt engineering, and workflow automation best practices.

Qualifications

What You’ll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree required.

  • 12+ years of relevant experience in Program/Project Management, Strategic Operations, or Marketing Operations.

  • 5+ years managing large, cross-functional initiatives in complex enterprise environments.

  • Demonstrated success driving marketing programs to measurable business outcomes.

  • Strong command of project management fundamentals: planning, risk management, stakeholder alignment, and execution tracking.

  • Proficiency with AI-enabled workflows and tools (Microsoft 365 Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT Enterprise, Zoom AI Companion, or similar). Not just familiarity—demonstrated usage in day-to-day execution.

  • Experience building or maintaining golden prompt libraries, AI-enabled reporting workflows, or automation pipelines for program management.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills with a bias toward clarity and action.

  • PMP and/or Agile certification preferred but not required.

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

title: Tier 2 SOC Analyst / Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Tier 2 SOC Analyst/Engineer to serve as the escalation point for our Tier 1 SOC team. This role owns in-depth investigation of escalated alerts, performs root cause analysis, leads incident response activities, and drives detection engineering and threat hunting initiatives to continuously mature our security monitoring program. You will be a technical anchor for the SOC — turning raw alerts into confirmed incidents, confirmed incidents into lessons learned, and lessons learned into better detections.

Department: Security Operations Center (SOC)

Reports to: SOC Manager

Works closely with: Tier 1 SOC Analysts (escalation point), Detection Engineering, IT Infrastructure, Application Development

## Key Responsibilities

**Escalation & Investigation**

- Serve as the primary technical escalation point for Tier 1 analysts on alerts requiring deeper analysis

- Conduct in-depth investigations across endpoint, network, cloud, identity, and application telemetry

- Correlate data across multiple tools/log sources (SIEM, EDR, NDR, cloud logs, identity providers) to determine scope and impact

- Distinguish true positives from false positives and refine triage logic accordingly

**Root Cause Analysis**

- Perform root cause analysis on confirmed incidents to determine initial vector, method, and any control gaps

- Document attack timelines/kill chains and produce clear technical findings for stakeholders

- Identify systemic issues (misconfigurations, missing patches, process gaps) surfaced during investigations

**Incident Response**

- Lead or co-lead containment, eradication, and recovery activities for security incidents

- Coordinate with IT, engineering, legal, and management during active incidents per the IR plan

- Author incident reports, timelines, and post-incident/lessons-learned reviews

- Support tabletop exercises and continuous improvement of IR playbooks and runbooks

**Detection Engineering**

- Design, build, test, and tune detection rules/use cases (SIEM correlation rules, EDR detections, Sigma rules, etc.)

- Translate threat intel, incident findings, and threat hunt results into new or improved detections

- Reduce alert fatigue by improving detection fidelity and eliminating noisy/low-value alerts

- Map detections to a framework such as MITRE ATT&CK to identify and close coverage gaps

**Threat Hunting**

- Conduct proactive, hypothesis-driven threat hunts using threat intelligence, ATT&CK TTPs, and anomaly analysis

- Identify indicators of compromise or adversary behavior not caught by existing detections

- Convert hunt findings into new detection logic and share findings with the broader team

**Mentorship & Process**

- Mentor and provide technical guidance to Tier 1 analysts, including escalation reviews and knowledge transfer

- Contribute to and maintain SOC playbooks, runbooks, and standard operating procedures

- Support onboarding of new log sources, tools, and data feeds into the SOC's monitoring scope

- Participate in an on-call/escalation rotation as needed

## Required Qualifications

- 3+ years of hands-on SOC experience, with demonstrated progression into Tier 2/senior analyst responsibilities

- Strong understanding of the attack lifecycle, common TTPs, and the MITRE ATT&CK framework

- Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar, Elastic) — writing/tuning correlation rules and queries

- Experience with EDR/XDR tools (e.g., CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne, TrendAI) for endpoint investigation

- Solid grasp of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, proxies) and ability to read packet captures

- Experience with incident response processes: containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident reporting

- Familiarity with cloud security monitoring (AWS/Azure/GCP logs, IAM, CloudTrail or equivalent)

- Scripting/automation skills (Python, PowerShell, or similar) for detection logic, parsing, or workflow automation

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical findings for non-technical stakeholders

- Ability to remain calm and methodical under pressure during active incidents

## Preferred Qualifications

- Certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, CySA+, OSCP, or equivalent

- Experience writing Sigma, YARA, or Snort/Suricata rules

- Experience with SOAR platforms for playbook automation

- Familiarity with digital forensics tools and techniques (memory/disk forensics)

- Experience with threat intelligence platforms and integrating IOC feeds

- Prior experience mentoring or training junior analysts

## What Success Looks Like

- Reduced mean-time-to-detect (MTTD) and mean-time-to-respond (MTTR) for escalated incidents

- Measurable improvement in detection coverage against ATT&CK techniques relevant to the organization

- A steady cadence of proactive threat hunts with documented findings and resulting detections

- Well-documented incidents with clear root cause and remediation tracking

- Stronger, more capable Tier 1 team through consistent mentorship and escalation feedback

title: Senior IAM Engineer: IBM Verify
description:
Senior IAM Engineer, IBM Verify

We are seeking an experienced IBM Verify engineer who can architect, deploy, and operationalize enterprise identity and access management solutions across the full Verify platform. This role covers IBM Verify (SaaS), IBM Verify Identity Access for on-premises and hybrid access management, and integration with IBM Verify Identity Governance where lifecycle and certification are in scope.

This is not a support-only or console-administration role. The ideal candidate has designed and implemented Verify environments end-to-end, understands federation and access architecture, and can deploy and operate the containerized on-premises components reliably at scale.

This position is remote, but the candidate MUST be located in India.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Architecture and Deployment

  • Design and implement IBM Verify architecture across SaaS and hybrid enterprise environments
  • Stand up and configure IBM Verify Identity Access (v11), including reverse proxy, web and API gateways, and junction configuration
  • Deploy containerized Verify Identity Access on OpenShift or Kubernetes, including Helm-based configuration
  • Build multi-environment setups (DEV, QA, PROD) following platform best practices
  • Configure Verify SaaS tenants, application onboarding, and connectivity to enterprise systems
  • Implement secure configuration aligned with enterprise security standards

Authentication, Access, and Federation

  • Configure SSO across SAML, OIDC, and OAuth 2.0
  • Implement MFA, including passwordless, biometric, and one-time-passcode methods
  • Configure adaptive and risk-based access using the platform risk engine
  • Build identity orchestration and authentication flows using the no-code flow designer
  • Integrate consumer and workforce access use cases

Integration and Customization

  • Integrate IBM Verify with Active Directory, HR systems, and cloud directories
  • Onboard target applications using connectors, API-based provisioning, and SCIM
  • Configure provisioning policies, access governance, and certification campaigns where Verify Identity Governance is in scope
  • Implement role-based access control and segregation-of-duties controls
  • Develop custom adapters and API integrations where required

High Availability, Performance, and Resilience

  • Architect HA and failover for on-premises and containerized Verify Identity Access deployments
  • Design load balancing and failover strategies for hybrid components
  • Develop and test disaster recovery procedures for self-managed components
  • Tune performance, including connection pooling, session handling, and reconciliation throughput
  • Conduct capacity planning and resolve system bottlenecks

Note: HA, DR, and backup for the SaaS tier are managed by IBM. This work applies to the on-premises and containerized components the candidate owns.

Automation and DevOps

  • Automate builds and deployments using scripting (Shell, Python, Ansible)
  • Develop environment provisioning and configuration scripts
  • Support CI/CD integration for containerized Verify components
  • Maintain infrastructure-as-code where possible

Documentation and Knowledge Transfer

  • Create architecture diagrams and build documentation
  • Develop operational runbooks
  • Provide handover documentation to support teams

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on IAM engineering experience, with significant time on IBM Verify (SaaS and Verify Identity Access / ISAM)
  • Proven experience designing and implementing Verify environments end-to-end
  • Strong experience with federation standards: SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0
  • Strong experience with SSO, MFA, passwordless, and adaptive access configuration
  • Experience deploying and operating Verify Identity Access, including reverse proxy and junction configuration
  • Experience with container orchestration (OpenShift or Kubernetes) for self-managed components
  • Experience integrating with Active Directory and enterprise systems
  • Strong understanding of identity governance concepts (IGA, RBAC, certification campaigns, SoD)
  • Linux system administration and strong scripting skills (Shell, Python)
  • Experience working in enterprise production environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience migrating from ISAM or ISIM/ISVG to the current Verify platform
  • Familiarity with IBM Verify Identity Governance (v11) and hybrid SaaS plus on-premises governance use cases
  • Experience with API authorization and identity orchestration flows
  • Knowledge of enterprise load balancers (F5, Netscaler)
  • Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, government)
  • Security certifications (CISSP, CISM) or IAM-specific certifications

Key Competencies

  • Strong access and federation architecture skills
  • Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis
  • Ability to design scalable and resilient hybrid architectures
  • Strong documentation and communication skills
  • Independent ownership of the platform lifecycle

What Success Looks Like

  • A fully operational Verify environment spanning SaaS and self-managed components
  • SSO, MFA, and adaptive access deployed and validated across target applications
  • Failover tested for self-managed components
  • Clean architecture documentation and operational handoff
  • A stable, scalable identity and access platform ready for enterprise production use

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
Role Description

We're seeking an AI Software Engineer who is passionate about building production-grade AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agentic AI. This is a hands-on engineering role where you'll design, develop, deploy, and optimize secure AI solutions running on AWS.

This is a fully remote, full-time position offering the opportunity to work on emerging AI technologies that support mission-critical public sector initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • AI Application Development
    • Design, develop, and maintain AI-powered applications using Python.
    • Build intelligent applications leveraging OpenAI APIs, Amazon Bedrock, and other enterprise LLM platforms.
    • Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures using enterprise knowledge sources and vector databases.
    • Develop Agentic AI workflows capable of autonomous reasoning, planning, and task execution.
    • Build reusable AI services, APIs, and software components for enterprise applications.
    • Optimize prompts, model interactions, and application performance for reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.
    • Leverage AI development tools safely and effectively, taking ultimate human accountability for the design, security, and test coverage of all generated code.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure Engineering
    • Design, deploy, and maintain AI solutions on AWS.
    • Build Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
    • Develop containerized applications using Docker.
    • Deploy and manage workloads on Kubernetes.
    • Collaborate with DevOps engineers to automate deployments through CI/CD pipelines.
    • Ensure AI solutions meet security, scalability, and operational requirements.
  • Software Engineering & Integration
    • Develop secure REST APIs and backend services.
    • Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications, cloud services, and external APIs.
    • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested, and reusable code following software engineering best practices.
    • Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and technical design discussions.
  • Innovation & Research
    • Evaluate emerging AI frameworks, tools, and technologies.
    • Prototype new AI capabilities and rapidly validate proof-of-concepts.
    • Recommend improvements that increase developer productivity and enhance customer outcomes.
    • Help establish reusable AI patterns, templates, and best practices across projects.
  • Documentation & Collaboration
    • Create technical documentation, architecture diagrams, implementation guides, and operational runbooks.
    • Work closely with Solution Architects, Cloud Engineers, Product Managers, and customers to translate business requirements into AI solutions.
    • Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline (or equivalent professional experience).
  • 4–8 years of professional software engineering experience.
  • 2+ years of professional Python development experience.
  • Must be a U.S Citizen or Green Card Holder.

Requirements

  • Strong Python programming skills.
  • Efficient prompt engineering.
  • Experience building applications on AWS.
  • Experience integrating OpenAI APIs and/or Amazon Bedrock.
  • Hands-on experience implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions.
  • Experience designing or developing Agentic AI workflows.
  • Experience developing RESTful APIs.
  • Experience using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code.
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience using Git and modern CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of software design principles, API development, and cloud-native architectures.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Nice to have worked with LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar AI orchestration frameworks.
  • Nice to have worked with vector databases such as Pinecone, Amazon OpenSearch, pgvector, or Weaviate.
  • Experience with Amazon ECS, Amazon EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, or S3.
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI evaluation, and model observability.
  • Experience with DevSecOps and secure software development practices.
  • Nice to have experience supporting U.S. Federal Government customers.
  • Familiarity with NIST 800-53, FedRAMP, FISMA, or CMS security requirements is a plus.

What We're Looking For

  • Passion for solving complex business problems using AI.
  • Curiosity to learn and experiment with emerging AI technologies.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced Agile environment.
  • Customer-first mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality software solutions.

Eligibility to Work at ArcheSys

  • All work must be performed within the continental United States.
  • Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.
  • Selected candidates may be required to complete background investigations and obtain government security authorization for certain projects.
  • ArcheSys participates in E-Verify.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to build next-generation AI and cloud-native solutions.
  • Exposure to OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, Agentic AI, and emerging AI technologies.
  • Continuous learning through certifications, training, conferences, and professional development.
  • Collaborative culture that encourages innovation, experimentation, and career growth.
  • Opportunity to support impactful Federal and Commercial digital transformation initiatives.

title: Partner Solutions Engineer (Mumbai)
description:
Meet the Team

The Solutions Engineering team is responsible for designing, implementing, and enabling Cisco's Digital Resilience strategy for organizations across India. Working at the forefront of Enterprise Networking and Cybersecurity, the team partners with customers and strategic channel partners to build next-generation networking, security, cloud, and application delivery solutions.

As part of this high-impact team, you'll collaborate with Cisco Sales, Partner Account Managers, Channel Leaders, and cross-functional technical specialists to develop innovative architectures that help customers modernize their infrastructure, improve cyber resilience, and accelerate digital transformation.

Your Impact

As a Solutions Engineer, you will serve as the trusted technical advisor to Cisco's strategic partners, driving technical strategy, solution development, and partner enablement across Cisco's Enterprise Networking and Security portfolio. You will build strong relationships with channel partners and distribution teams, lead technical discussions, drive Go-to-Market (GTM) initiatives, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to deliver innovative solutions that accelerate customer success and business growth.

Responsibilities

  • Build and own strategic technical relationships with partners, serving as their primary technical advisor throughout the sales lifecycle.

  • Develop Partner Technical Business Plans and drive technical readiness across Cisco's Networking and Security architectures.

  • Design, position, and demonstrate end-to-end Cisco solutions through customer workshops, executive presentations, demonstrations, and Proof of Concepts (POCs).

  • Collaborate with Partner Account Executives, Partner SE Leaders, Channel teams, and Cisco Business Units to develop strategic opportunities and grow partner capabilities.

  • Provide technical leadership on Enterprise Networking, Security, Cloud, and Digital Resilience architectures while influencing long-term partner investment and technology strategy.

  • Enable partner technical teams through architecture workshops, technical training, solution positioning, and use-case development.

  • Identify market trends, competitive technologies, and partner capability gaps, providing recommendations that align with Cisco's architectural priorities.

  • Support partners throughout the customer lifecycle, including opportunity qualification, solution design, technical presentations, implementation planning, and post-sales technical guidance.

  • Act as the primary escalation point for partner technical issues while promoting Cisco support services and technical resources.

  • Capture field feedback and collaborate with Cisco Product Management and Engineering teams to influence future product enhancements and solution development.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree with 12+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Technical Pre-Sales, Network Architecture, Security Consulting, or Technical Sales.

  • Cisco certifications such as CCNA, CCNP Enterprise, CCNP Security, or CCIE are required or highly preferred.

  • Strong expertise in Cisco Enterprise Networking and Security solutions, including Routing & Switching, Wireless, SD-WAN, Data Center, Cloud Networking, and Cisco Security technologies such as Secure Firewall, Secure Access (SASE), Umbrella, ISE, Duo, Secure Endpoint, XDR, and Zero Trust Architecture.

  • Proven experience working with Cisco Distribution and Channel Partner ecosystems, driving technical enablement, partner onboarding, GTM execution, and partner-led sales motions across Enterprise Networking and Security solutions.

  • Experience managing or influencing large distributed technical organizations, including distributor SE teams, partner technical communities, or regional technical enablement programs.

  • Proven experience working with Channel Partners, System Integrators, or Value-Added Resellers (VARs), driving partner enablement, technical strategy, and complex customer engagements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience delivering executive presentations, technical workshops, demonstrations, and Proof of Concepts (POCs) for enterprise customers and partners.

  • Experience working with Cisco distributors or large partner ecosystems, supporting partner enablement, GTM execution, and technical engagement across regional or national markets

  • Strong knowledge of Cisco's cross-architecture portfolio, including Enterprise Networking, Security, Cloud, Collaboration, Data Center, and AI-driven solutions.

  • Experience integrating Cisco Networking and Security solutions with public cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.

  • Strong consultative selling, stakeholder management, and influencing skills with the ability to engage technical and executive audiences.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills, with a strong understanding of industry trends, competitive technologies, and Digital Resilience strategies.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Senior Product Design Manager (6-month Term)
description:
Senior Product Design Manager

Initial Term: 6-month assignment, with potential for regular full-time conversion based on business need and performance

Position Summary

The Senior Product Design Manager will lead the design of clear, intuitive, and scalable product experiences across CharacterStrong’s digital platform. This role will be responsible for shaping the structure, navigation, workflows, and overall usability of complex product experiences while ensuring design decisions align with product priorities and user needs.

This leader will directly oversee UX designers, providing direction, coaching, feedback, and quality oversight while also fully engaging in the work. The position requires deep expertise in information architecture, design systems, interaction design, and UX problem-solving, with the ability to guide both strategy and execution.

This coach-player role will bring order to complexity, strengthening experience quality across our digital experiences, and lead the UX team to produce engaging, coherent, and innovative solutions.

This position is structured as a contract-to-hire opportunity. The selected candidate will begin in an initial contract engagement for approximately 6 months, with the potential to transition into a regular full-time role based on performance, business need, and mutual fit.

CharacterStrong’s Background & Mission

CharacterStrong, a FullBloom Company, is a fast-paced, tech education company that makes PreK-12 digital, social-emotional learning curricula and offers professional learning opportunities to support schools with implementation. There’s currently a team of more than 90 full-time employees and over 30 contractors and interns collaborating to bring this work to life. Our mission is to create a more loving world by equipping educators with tools to teach the critical social, emotional, and character skills necessary to foster a more empathetic, connected, and generous world. In less than 10 years, our aim is to have reached 50 million students and over 2 million educators. We were ranked by INC. as the 449th fastest-growing private company in the country.

At CharacterStrong, you will have the opportunity to positively impact education, both in the United States and internationally. CharacterStrong employees offer their innovation, dedication to excellence, and compassion to help produce transformational curricula and professional learning for educators.

CharacterStrong’s Company Values & Norms

  • We Produce Excellence - Producing timely, quality results and consistently asking the question, “How can we make this 1% better?”
  • We Take Full Ownership - Taking initiative to drive work forward, demonstrating responsibility when things do not go according to plan, and being proactive in closing identified gaps.
  • We Practice Kindness - Exercising inclusion, care, and empathy with others, balancing honesty with compassion, and cultivating the well-being of self and others.
  • We Problem-Solve - Identifying issues, analyzing for understanding, and taking action to implement the best possible solution.

Key Responsibilities

Product Design Leadership

  • Lead product design and UX efforts across the digital platform, with a focus on information architecture, user journeys, accessibility, usability, and consistent design system execution.
  • Define and evolve navigation systems, content hierarchy, interaction patterns, and end-to-end user flows.
  • Translate product priorities, user needs, jobs to be done, and business goals into clear UX direction and actionable design solutions.
  • Ensure experiences are intuitive, efficient, and scalable across complex product areas.
  • Oversee accessibility, ensuring all experiences meet WCAG AA standards and inclusive design principles.
  • Balance design quality with business timelines and engineering constraints, ensuring solutions are high-impact while meeting critical release and launch windows.
  • Champion innovation and continuous learning, leveraging emerging tools, systems, and best practices to improve design efficiency and output quality.

Team Leadership & UX Oversight

  • Directly manage and support UX designers, including providing strategic coaching in IA and UX best practices to elevate the team’s independent execution.
  • Review UX design work regularly to ensure quality, consistency, and alignment with product goals, business and user needs.
  • Help the team move effectively from ambiguity to clarity through strong problem framing, design critique, and strategic decision-making.
  • Establish expectations for design artifacts, workflows, and collaboration so the team can execute with consistency, clarity, and confidence.
  • Foster a healthy, thoughtful, and accountable product design culture grounded in clarity, ownership, and continuous improvement.

Design System Governance

  • Work closely with UX/UI designers, developers, and other stakeholders to integrate the design system into the product development process.
  • Ensure consistency in design across products by enforcing adherence to and governing maintenance of an evolving design system.
  • Manage versioning of the design system to ensure that updates are communicated effectively and legacy components are phased out responsibly.
  • Guide and maintain thorough documentation, including usage guidelines, best practices, and training resources for team members to effectively utilize the system.
  • Audit the design system and implementation for WCAG AA accessibility compliance.

Information Architecture & UX Execution

  • Set the standard for early alignment in priority initiatives by creating high-level frameworks (user flows, journey maps, wireframes, prototypes) that serve as blueprints for the broader design team.
  • Simplify complex or fragmented product experiences through stronger information architecture and workflow design.
  • Identify friction points and opportunities across the product experience and drive practical improvements.
  • Adhere to a human-centered design process by using available insights, supporting usability testing, and gathering SME feedback to inform design decisions while keeping robust or formal research ownership outside the core scope of the role.
  • Use available customer feedback, product data, and team insights to inform design decisions, while keeping formal research ownership outside the core scope of the role.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with the Senior Director of Product Development to align design requirements with product strategy and user stories, ensuring evidence-based insights and prioritization reflect validated user needs
  • Coach and empower UX/UI designers to partner effectively with Product Managers, ensuring they lead the design's voice within the 'Iron Triangle' to shape solution direction and clarify requirements.
  • Collaborate with Engineering to ensure design solutions balance user value with technical feasibility.
  • Work with cross-functional stakeholders to align on priorities, make tradeoffs visible, and improve confidence before development begins.
  • Partner with the Senior Art Director to ensure ongoing brand alignment in an evolving design system and product design execution.

Ideal Profile

  • 8+ years in product design, with 3+ years leading designers for complex digital products, ideally in SaaS, edtech, or multi-user platforms.
  • Mastery in information architecture, interaction design, navigation systems, and user journeys.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership of complex product experiences.
  • Experience managing, mentoring, or leading product designers with clear standards and strong design critique.
  • Demonstrated ownership of overseeing usability testing across the design lifecycle, translating user insights into clear, actionable improvements to product experiences
  • Proven track record of implementing Accessibility (A11y) standards at scale within a design system.
  • Expertise in navigating ambiguity by asking the right questions, facilitating alignment across departments, and establishing a clear, structured design path forward.
  • Strong cross-partnership and communication skills, including the ability to explain rationale, influence priorities, and move work forward collaboratively.
  • Experience leading, building, and governing design systems, including adoption, scalability, and accessibility integration.
  • Good judgment in using feedback, data, SME, and user input to inform design without functioning as a dedicated research leader.

Other Duties:

  • Perform additional responsibilities aligned with business needs and evolving growth goals.

Benefit Package

  • Company laptop and other needed equipment provided
  • 401k Savings Plan with employer contribution
  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance
  • Life, AD&D, and Disability Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program, Mental Health Support, and Well-Being Programs
  • Flexible Time Off, Paid Sick Days, Paid Company Holidays

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.

Salary Range

$103,500.00 - $172,500.00

This pay range represents the minimum and maximum compensation that the position offers, and final compensation can vary within the range depending on work location, job experience, skills, and relevant educational attainment and/or training.

Position

AI Software Engineer

Location

Lake Forest, United States of America (Hybrid)

Employment type

Full-time

We are looking for passionate and seasoned AI Software Engineers to join our Core AI Services team. In this role, you will help design, develop, and scale AI-enabling platform services and public APIs that are secure, reliable, and cloud-native. These services will act as foundational building blocks for AI adoption across AVEVA's product portfolio and partner ecosystem.

You will be part of a Scrum team to build innovative, standards-compliant, secure and production-grade AI capabilities, with a builder mindset, rapid prototyping and continuous improvement with agility of a start-up.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with multiple teams to create AI solutions, which include AI model deployment, training, and AI tooling development.
  • Build scalable, fault-tolerant cloud-native services on Microsoft Azure, ensuring high performance and reliability.
  • Develop secure, well-documented public APIs and SDKs for consumption by internal and external developers.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver end-to-end solutions across data pipelines, orchestration, and service APIs.
  • Embed robust security controls to protect sensitive data and ensure secure access to AI services.

Essential Requirements

  • Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs) and understanding of trade-offs between performance, cost, and capability.
  • Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agent orchestration, prompt engineering, and tool calling.
  • Familiarity with AI standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent2Agent (A2A).
  • Fluent in developing code using AI Tools such as GitHub Copilot. Must be able to use prompt engineering to carry out multiple development tasks.
  • Familiar with AI orchestration and agentic frameworks.
  • Experience in Python and AI frameworks / tools such as PyTorch and TensorFlow.
  • Experience with tools for automated testing and evaluation of AI outputs.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyse complex technical challenges and propose scalable solutions.

Desired Skills And Competencies

  • Extensive experience in software engineering, preferably in platform or cloud-native service development (using Microsoft and .NET technologies a bonus).
  • Strong expertise in RESTful API design, versioning, testing, and lifecycle management.
  • Strong knowledge or experience in working with various ML algorithms (regression, classification, clustering, deep learning).
  • Proficient in securing APIs, managing authentication/authorization and data privacy practices.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and associated PaaS services (e.g., Azure Functions, AKS, API Management) preferred; experience with other cloud platform (AWS, GCP) is also valued.
  • Proficient in securing APIs, managing authentication/authorization and data privacy practices.
  • Knowledge of AI ethics and regulations (e.g., NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act), and commitment to responsible AI development.
  • Experience working in Agile teams and collaborating across global R&D locations.

R&D at AVEVA

Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the center of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.

Our track record of innovation is no fluke - it's the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.

Flex work hours, 20 days PTO rising to 25 with service, three paid volunteering days, primary and secondary parental leave, well-being support, medical, dental, vision, and 401K.

title: Full Time - Merchandising Service Associate - Day

As a Lowe's Merchandising Services Associate, you are a key connection point between Merchandising and Store Operations, allowing us to deliver a great shopping experience in every Lowe's store. If you want to build eye-catching displays and implement strategies that showcase in-demand products, you'll enjoy working with our Merchandising Services Team.

How We Support You

Whether you need a part-time position or a place to plant yourself and grow, Lowe's is ready to support your goals. As a Lowe's associate, you'll gain access to many benefits beyond competitive pay and flexible schedules.
  • Keep your weekends free with a set weekday schedule. *
  • Make your well-being a priority with multiple top-tier health insurance options.
  • Explore educational opportunities with Lowe's tuition assistance program.
  • Take charge of your financial future with a company-matching 401(k) and optional Employee Stock Purchase Program.
  • Gain extra savings with a 10% Associate Discount.
  • Learn new trade skills with our Track to the Trades program.
For information about our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit .

*Live Nursery MST Associates may be required to work weekend shifts.

Your Day at Lowe's

As a Merchandising Services Associate, you ensure our store's signage, pricing information, and displays are accurate so merchandise is easy to locate. You create product displays that are safe, clean, visually appealing, and easy for customers to access.

While most of your time will be spent on activities that don't involve customer interaction, you may be expected to engage with customers when the opportunity arises. You'll be expected to listen to customers and answer questions, communicate product or warranty information, and assist in locating or handling merchandise.

Key Responsibilities
  • Complete merchandising resets and service-related projects according to Lowe's specifications and provide proof of completion for assigned tasks
  • Verify buyback items and ensure they are pulled, prepped, and ready for shipping
  • Update/validate wayfinding and product location signage, as well as digital maintenance of this information throughout the store
  • Confirm product pricing information is clearly visible and replace any missing price labels
  • Help drive add-on sales by staging clearance products, sorting products in proper locations, and ensuring displays are placed appropriately throughout the store
  • Repair/replace damaged or missing items, including signage, merchandise and displays.
  • Communicate project priorities, schedule, and needs with Merchandising Services Team and Manager
  • Analyze metrics and provide feedback on project execution and in-store service to store, market, and corporate leaders
  • Complete other duties as assigned

Minimum Qualifications
  • Read, write, and perform basic arithmetic (addition and subtraction)
  • Ability to hear, listen, and to communicate verbally with others
  • Utilize web-based computer programs to accomplish assigned tasks
  • Ability to sit and stand for long periods of time
  • Minimally lift 25lbs unassisted or over 25lbs with or without accommodation

Preferred Qualifications
  • Lowe's sales floor experience
  • Experience performing product merchandising tasks, including reading planograms and setting up and tearing down displays.
  • Experience operating power equipment such as lifts, order pickers, and similar equipment
  • Working knowledge of essential tools (e.g., hand tools, drills, saws, etc.)

Lowe's commitment to growth and teamwork extends to the community as well. To better equip our stores and serve our communities, we strongly encourage bilingual, military, and veteran talent to apply and join our team.

title: Physics Expert (Statistical Physics / Quantum Information / Condensed Matter)
description:
Role Title: Physics Expert (Statistical Physics / Quantum Information / Condensed Matter)


Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote


micro1 is engaging Physics Experts (Statistical Physics / Quantum Information / Condensed Matter) to contribute to a research-driven customer project at the intersection of theoretical physics and numerical benchmarking.


In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.


Scope of Work

  1. Analyze and provide expert insights into complex statistical physics phenomena, with a focus on replicated random-bond Ising/Ashkin-Teller models, the toric-code threshold, and the Nishimori line.
  2. Deliver clear, well-documented solutions or critiques of problems relating to Kramers-Wannier duality, quenched disorder averaging, square-lattice self-duality, and domain-wall free energy.
  3. Engage in advanced numerical work, particularly around 4-state Potts model simulations and interpretation.
  4. Identify, discuss, and resolve technical challenges involving noncontractible loop defects and related topological features.
  5. Participate as a Solver, Auditor, or Adjudicator on specific project assignments based on your experience and subfield strengths.



Preferred Qualifications

  1. Advanced academic background (PhD or equivalent experience) in physics, with specialization in statistical physics, quantum information, or condensed matter theory.
  2. Direct, hands-on experience applying Kramers-Wannier duality, quenched disorder averaging, and square-lattice self-duality in research or project settings.
  3. Demonstrated proficiency in numerical simulations involving the 4-state Potts model and analysis of domain-wall free energy.
  4. Familiarity with topological quantum codes, particularly the toric code and its threshold phenomena.

title: Sales Floor Dept Supervisor - Hardware-Tools
description:

All Lowe’s associates deliver quality customer service while maintaining a store that is clean, safe, and stocked with the products our customers need. As a Sales Floor Department Supervisor, this means:

The Sales Floor Department Supervisor is primarily responsible for leading and enabling a team of associates to deliver the best possible customer experience in the store. This includes coaching and training associates, delegating, following-up on daily tasks, managing performance, and ensuring adequate department coverage. The Role and Why It's Important

At Hy-Vee, our produce department is one of the first impressions we make on every customer who walks through the door, and our Produce Clerks play a big role in making it a great one. In this role, you'll keep the department stocked, fresh, and inviting while delivering the kind of friendly service that keeps customers coming back. If you enjoy staying active, take pride in a job well done, and thrive working as part of a team, we'd love to have you on our team.

What You'll Do

No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:

  • Deliver outstanding customer service by greeting every customer with a smile, assisting them with their needs, and going the extra mile to make their shopping experience a great one
