title: McAllen - Direct Care Supervisor
description:
Salary $35,568 - $1,000 Sign on Bonus!!!

South Texas Community Living is hiring a full-time Direct Care Supervisor to Supervise Direct Support / Caregiver Staff assisting individuals with intellectual disabilities in group home settings in the McAllen area.

Our program provides a rewarding job experience for anyone interested in promoting the independence of people with disabilities. The Direct Care Supervisor will work under the supervision of the Director of Residential Services with input from the Registered Nurse, and in a strong team atmosphere. The ideal candidate would have Supervisory, Caregiving, Direct Support and/ or Direct Care, C.N.A. or Home Health experience. To support our population of individuals one must be fun, clean, mature, dependable, organized, respectful, and patient in challenging situations.

Shift: Monday - Friday Hours: 11AM to 7PM (with 1 hour lunch).

Direct Care Supervisor Duties include:

  • Coordinating schedule of group home direct support staff in all group homes throughout the 7-day week; preparing the schedule in Microsoft Excel every week, 3 weeks in advance.
  • Coordinating and assisting caregiver staff with purchasing, including but not limited to groceries, over-the-counter medications, fuel for vehicles, and household supplies and decorations.
  • Communicating with Director of Direct Support Services daily regarding issues and concerns related to group homes and group home caregiver staff and implementing Director's instructions to address those concerns.
  • Hiring: Posting ads for open positions, screening and selecting caregivers, and assisting with all new-hire documentaries, orientation, and initial training.
  • Coordinating with Maintenance Specialist to facilitate proper maintenance in homes (e.g., reporting problems, availability to let outside repair people in).
  • Rounds at group homes to monitor efforts of Direct Support Staff to ensure overall home cleanliness, quality interactions between caregiver staff and individuals, following of diets and other special instructions for client care, following of set schedules for daily routines and recreational activities, following of detailed instructions for medication pass and related procedures, ensuring of safety precautions associated with activities of daily living for high risk individuals, providing supportive and respectful interaction with assigned individuals, following of instructions for all related documentation (e.g., time sheets, training records-goals and objectives, medication administration records, daily service activity logs, incident and accident reports, other medical data, and other documentation, as needed.
  • Ongoing follow-up visits to determine and ensure Direct Support Staff can demonstrate all above-mentioned skills thoroughly and effectively.
  • Coordinate with Nurse daily to determine medical appointment instructions for the upcoming day; coordinate with Director daily to determine and resolve scheduling conflicts.
  • Plan and monitor recreational activities, and provide support to Direct Support Staff, as needed (e.g., attend outings, assist with activity transportation, etc.).
  • Report all issues and concerns to the Director of Direct Support Services and/or Nurse (as appropriate) and implement all related instructions to resolve problems.
  • On-call to address group home issues.
  • Other duties, as assigned.

Benefits:

  • Health Insurance (after 90 days)
  • 401K (after 1 year)
  • Vacation (Immediate Accrual - 2 weeks after 1 year, 3 weeks after 5 years)

title: Software Engineer IV
description:
Software Engineer IV
Senior Level | $110,000 - $135,000 | Huntsville, AL | Active Secret Clearance Required

Lead the development of advanced missile defense software that evaluates and manages real-time threat environments—supporting ground fire control systems responsible for protecting the nation.

A Day in the Life - What you’ll do

  • Design and architect advanced software capabilities and algorithms supporting the ground weapon systems� and ground fire control product.
  • Lead development and enhancement of software that evaluates and manages threat scenes within the U.S. Missile Defense System.
  • Apply advanced mathematics and physics-based solutions supporting Missile Defense Agency (MDA) mission capabilities.
  • Provide technical leadership within a large-scale codebase (~1.5 million lines) supporting mission-critical missile defense operations.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering best practices across the development team.
  • Lead or support integration, testing, and validation of complex software capabilities.
  • Participate in and lead technical reviews, engineering discussions, and stakeholder briefings supporting mission deployment.
  • Support occasional travel (up to 10%) to meet program and mission requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) discipline from an accredited university.
  • 8 years of related software engineering experience with a Bachelor’s degree or 6 years of related experience with a Master’s degree or 4 years of related experience with a PhD
  • Recent experience developing software in C++, Java, or Ada
  • Willingness to become proficient in Ada software development
  • Strong communication skills for technical collaboration, documentation, and presentations
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into engineering solutions and mission outcomes
  • Ability to work independently and lead within collaborative engineering environments
  • Ability to work within a closed-area / in-person development environment
  • Ability to travel up to 10% to support mission needs
  • Active in-scope DoD Secret security clearance required at time of application

Preferred Qualifications

  • Extensive experience with Linux operating systems and scripting
  • Experience with MATLAB and Python
  • Experience supporting large-scale missile defense systems
  • Advanced degree or strong academic background in Mathematics or Physics
  • Experience supporting Battle Management or Fire Control systems
  • Experience with Agile development tools such as Jira and Confluence

title: Data Scientist
description:
Murphy AI deploys voice AI agents that help banks collect debt. We’ve built a fully-fledged platform designed to optimize recovery rates while maintaining respectful and personalized communication. Our advanced automation streamlines the process of collecting overdue invoices for banks and other industries, providing a seamless and effective solution.

Our AI-powered agents adapt instantly, engaging with debtors across channels like voice, messengers, email and sms to maximize results while preserving trust. By combining advanced artificial intelligence with powerful automation, we’re setting a new standard for how businesses recover payments.

As a fast-growing startup that has already made an impact within less than a year in the market, we are building a talented team to scale our operations and drive our vision forward 🌟

About the Role

We're looking for a Data Scientist to build the Murphy’s brain — the ML that decides who we contact, when, how and how often, to recover the most debt inside hard legal limits. Recovery is a data problem before it's a voice problem, and you own the data problem. This is one of the highest-leverage seats in the company: your models set the strategy every AI agent executes, on every call.

Murphy builds AI voice agents that collect overdue debt for banks: more recovered, faster, cheaper, fully compliant, and respectful to the debtor. We're live with Santander, Revolut, BBVA and dozens others. We've proven the product in large-scale pilots with top-tier banks — now we're making every contact smarter, and we need a scientist to own the models that decide how we collect.

What you'll do

  • Own the contact strategy. Who Murphy contacts, when, how often, on which channel — voice, WhatsApp, etc. — to maximise recovery inside hard legal guardrails.

  • Model the debtor. Propensity and uplift models — who picks up, who pays, who responds to which voice, script or offer — turned into live segments the agents act on.

  • Optimise with experiments. A/B tests and bandits over timing, cadence, voice and negotiation policy; find what lifts recovery, and ship it fast.

  • Own business-level outcomes. Collaborate with product, engineering and commercial teams to define solutions and improve the key metrics.

Who you are

  • You hold a degree in mathematics, statistics, machine learning, or computer science.

  • Rigorous with probability and statistics. Experimental design, causal inference. You reach for the right tool, and you know when a result is real.

  • AI-native, ruthless on quality. You reach for AI to automate and streamline by default — and you know exactly where it gets sloppy. You never let that through, and you control quality rigorously.

  • You don’t need a collections or fintech background. We’d rather teach the domain to a killer than hire a lifer who can’t ship — you’ll pick up the domain, the data and the regulation cold, fast.

Requirements

  • 2+ years shipping ML that ran in production and moved business metrics. Models that pick the best next action and measure whether it actually changed the outcome; ranking, pricing or contact-strategy models. Models that ship as code, not notebooks.

  • Expert Python. Comfortable in a real production codebase — you take a model from idea to production and monitor it. We use Python for ML/AI services and TypeScript around it, on AWS and PostgreSQL.

  • Statistics you can defend. Experimental design, causal inference, measuring the real effect of an action — not just correlations. You know when a result is real, when it’s noise, and how to test it.

  • Experimentation. You’ve designed, run and interpreted A/B tests or bandits on live traffic, and shipped the winner.

  • You turn models into decisions. You can explain to stakeholders why the model says to call this client at 6pm — and defend it.

🤝 What we offer

💰 Salary at the top of the benchmark.

📈 Fair equity with enormous upside potential.

🧩 Real Ownership - Murphy's strategy is yours to drive.

🙌 Small team, high autonomy, and outsized impact.

🗣️ The founding team's direct attention, and a category with a $300B+ industry behind it.

🛜 Hybrid & Flexible: Our default setup is hybrid – 3 days a week at our office and 2 days of remote work.

📚 Our Process

1️⃣ First Interview – Getting to Know You

A conversation with a future teammate who’s excited to find a new colleague. We’ll talk about your story, what drives you, and what you’re looking for next—no trick questions, just a genuine exchange.

2️⃣ Second Interview – Deep Dive

You’ll meet the Hiring Manager and potentially another team member. This is a more technical discussion where we explore your skills in detail, walk through real scenarios, and answer any questions you might have about the role.

3️⃣ Tech Assessment or Business Case

A practical exercise to see how you approach challenges similar to those you’d tackle at Murphy. You’ll have time to reflect and showcase your thinking—no rush, no surprises.

4️⃣ Call with the Founders

Our founders meet every team member and it’s a great opportunity for you to learn about the company and its direction.

👉 To learn more about how we hire and what to expect at every step, feel free to explore our Hiring Guide!

👉 We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where everyone, regardless of background, identity, or experience, feels valued and empowered to thrive. We believe that different perspectives drive innovation and success, and we actively foster an environment where all voices are heard and respected.

Job Description

Arista Component Engineers work closely with Design Engineers, Supply Chain Management, and New Product Introduction Engineers to identify new components, drive an alternate sourcing strategy, and successfully launch products and sustain them in production. Component Engineers are responsible for ensuring components meet quality, reliability, and assurance of supply requirements for use in Arista products. Component Engineers report to the Component Engineering Manager.

What You’ll Do

  • Provide technical and sourcing support to design engineers. Performs component research by collaborating with designers, manufacturers, and supply chain to find components that meet performance, pricing, availability, and volume production needs..
  • Monitor, identify and resolve lifecycle issues. Can work with manufacturers, supply chain, and design engineers to identify substitutes, and make recommendations for NPI and Sustaining products.

Qualifications

  • BS, MS, or PhD in Mechanical Engineering + 10 years’ experience.

  • Experience with liquid cooling systems is a plus.
  • Expertise in PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) and comprehensive working knowledge of change order management processes, including PCN (Product Change Notification), ECO (Engineering Change Order), BOM (Bill of Materials), and Deviation.
  • Experience with Agile or Propel systems is a plus.
  • Experience using ProEngineer (PTC Creo) is a plus.
  • Experience with Mechanica (PTC Creo Simulate) a plus.
  • Experience with thermal simulation and air flow testing is a plus.
  • Experience designing sheet metal parts using soft and hard tooling guidelines.
  • Plastic part design for both cosmetic and non-cosmetic uses.
  • Familiarity with PDMLink (PTC Windchill) is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience with tests (shock, vibe, EMC, etc.) is a plus.

The new hire base pay for this role has a pay range of $120,000 to $180,000.

Arista offers different pay ranges based on work location, so that we can offer consistent and competitive pay appropriate to the market. The actual base pay offered will be based on a wide range of factors, including skills, qualifications, relevant experience, and work location.

The pay range provided reflects base pay only and in addition certain roles may also be eligible for discretionary Arista bonuses and equity. title: Network Development Analyst
description:
Network Development Analyst

The Opportunity:

Do you find yourself constantly looking for more and better information? Do you want a job where you can use your knowledge and research skills to improve national security? Never has the role of a network development analyst been so meaningful. More connected devices, larger storage capacity, and faster connections have resulted in an explosion of available information. The problem facing the intelligence community is no longer how to get more data, it’s understanding how to turn the data they have into answers. That’s where you come in. With critical thinking and flexibility, you quickly seek out accurate data sources, sift through the raw data, and turn it into valuable intelligence. If you have strong analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset, we have an opportunity to use those skills to protect our national security.

As a Network Development Analyst on our team, you’ll explore new data sources, create effective queries, and combine information from disparate sources to help your client understand their mission environment. You’ll validate the information and apply client tradecraft as you build assessments for senior policymakers. This is a chance to grow your expertise, develop new skills, and share your methodologies with other analysts. We focus on growing as a team to deliver the best support to our customers, so you’ll have resources for mentoring and learning new skills and tools. You'll leverage expertise in all-source analysis techniques, methodologies, tools, and databases to inform senior policymakers and DoD officials of military capabilities, political-military issues and military strategies, and the doctrine and intent of the specified client area of responsibility (AOR). You'll use structured methodologies and techniques appropriate to the topic and apply specialized subject matter expertise to guide efforts. You'll analyze the development of products tailored to clients in tactical to strategic levels, including actionable leads, complex written products, and formal or informal briefings. Join us as we provide the right information at the right time to support the critical needs of our policymakers.

Join us. The world can't wait.

  • Experience with targeting or network development analysis and U.S. government all-source analysis production within the IC or Combatant Command environments

About This Position:

As a Principal Product Manager for Agentic AI Platform at G-P, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our Agentic AI strategy and driving the success of platform capabilities that enable AI-powered experiences across our products and operations. You will work at the intersection of AI, platform services, developer experience, security, data, and enterprise SaaS.

You will be expected to define how agents, tools, APIs, workflows, evaluation frameworks, permissions, and governance models come together to create reliable, secure, and scalable AI capabilities. This is a platform product role with a strong AI focus. The ideal candidate has deep platform product management experience, strong curiosity about AI, and the ability to translate emerging technology into practical product outcomes.

What you will do:

  • Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of Agentic AI platform capabilities, from strategy and discovery to roadmap, execution, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
  • Define and drive key AI platform capabilities, including agents, tools, action interfaces, API integrations, orchestration patterns, evaluation frameworks, observability, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
  • Partner with engineering, data, security, and product teams to build scalable AI-powered capabilities using cloud-native, SaaS, microservices, serverless, and event-driven architectures.
  • Own the product strategy for how agents answer questions, assist users, take actions, access data, use tools, and safely interact with business systems.
  • Work with business product teams to identify and prioritize high-value agentic use cases across customer experience, professional experience, reporting, onboarding, compliance, support, and internal operations.
  • Drive a platform approach for AI by creating reusable patterns, shared capabilities, clear standards, and developer-friendly interfaces that can be adopted across multiple teams and products.
  • Define AI quality and evaluation requirements, including golden datasets, test cases, pass/fail criteria, trace reviews, regression testing, and production monitoring.
  • Collaborate with identity, security, and platform teams to ensure agentic actions follow proper authentication, authorization, permissions, auditability, privacy, and compliance controls.
  • Drive a developer-centric approach for Agentic AI platform services by improving discoverability, documentation, onboarding, usability, and adoption for internal product and engineering teams.
  • Use AI-powered tools in your own product workflow to improve discovery, analysis, documentation, prioritization, decision-making, and execution.
  • Work with cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities, gather requirements, manage trade-offs, and ensure successful adoption of AI platform capabilities.
  • Drive KPIs that reflect real-world AI and platform impact, including adoption, task completion, answer quality, automation success, deflection, operational efficiency, satisfaction, and reliability.

What we are looking for:

Minimum Requirements:

  • Experience: 15+ years of product management experience, including owning and driving large-scale technology platforms, AI products, developer-facing products, or enterprise SaaS capabilities across multiple lifecycle stages.
  • Agentic AI Product Thinking: Strong understanding of how AI, LLMs, agents, tools, workflows, automation, and orchestration can be applied to enterprise SaaS products. Ability to think beyond chatbot experiences and define how AI can help users complete meaningful tasks and business outcomes.
  • AI Quality and Governance: Familiarity with AI evaluation methods such as golden datasets, test suites, trace analysis, human review, LLM-as-a-judge, regression testing, and production monitoring. Strong awareness of AI risks around accuracy, privacy, security, explainability, permissions, and compliance.
  • Technical Depth: Deep familiarity with cloud platforms, SaaS business models, microservices, serverless computing, event-driven architectures, API-first design, data integrations, and modern enterprise architecture. Ability to translate technical possibilities into product outcomes.
  • Platform Product Management: Strong platform mindset with experience creating reusable capabilities, standards, interfaces, and services that support multiple product teams and business use cases.
  • Developer Experience: Ability to build platform services with empathy for developers, including onboarding, authentication, documentation, observability, service discoverability, and lifecycle needs. Prior experience with Internal Developer Portals such as Backstage is a plus.
  • Identity, Security, and Access Control: Experience with authentication, authorization, role-based access, policy-based access, API security, OpenAPI, or platform security workflows is highly desirable.
  • Internal Stakeholder Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work closely with internal customers, especially PMs and engineering leaders of business applications. Skilled in building strong relationships, understanding needs, and creating alignment.
  • Prioritization and Decision-Making: Excellent skills in managing and prioritizing requirements in situations with conflicting needs, ambiguity, emerging technology, and platform dependencies.
  • Execution Rigor: High ownership mindset. Ability to balance long-term vision with short-term wins. Comfortable driving specs, writing docs, aligning teams, and getting into details.
  • Effective Communication: Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and platform concepts clearly to technical, business, and executive audiences.
  • Documentation and Requirements: Expertise in creating clear PRDs, strategy documents, product briefs, specifications, and operating models.
  • Strategic and Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving ability and strategic thinking. Proficient in analyzing market trends, user feedback, platform usage, and AI performance data to inform product strategy.
  • Data-Driven Approach: Proficiency in defining and tracking KPIs and metrics to measure AI quality, platform adoption, user satisfaction, automation success, and business impact.
  • Agile Methodologies: Experience with Agile and Scrum methodologies, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and adaptability.
  • Educational Background: Solid technical foundation, preferably with a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field. Advanced degrees such as M.S. or MBA are a plus.

Actual compensation for this position may vary and will depend on multiple factors such as relevant qualifications, experience, education, and geographic location. For Full-Time Regular Employees, this position is also eligible for additional compensation as follows:

title: Senior DSP Engineer
description:
Worker Type

Regular

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Digital Signal Processing (DSP) Engineer to implement and support efforts in detecting and classifying Unmanned Aerial Surveillance (UAS) platforms using their Radio Frequency (RF) link. The ideal candidate will have experience in Software Defined Radio (SDR) based systems, signal detection, RF protocol (WiFi, LTE, WiMAX, Bluetooth, LoRa,...) decode, and strong software skills. Familiarity with phased array DF techniques and AI/ML-based classification approaches is a plus.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement DSP algorithms to detect and analyze UAS RF signals.
  • Reverse engineer RF protocols associated with commercial and custom UAS platforms.
  • Familiarity with Software Defined Radios for signal acquisition and experimentation.
  • Develop signal processing workflows in MATLAB and production-ready implementations in C++.
  • Analyze RF environments to distinguish UAS signals from background noise and benign emitters.
  • Manage source code and collaborative development using Git.
  • Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams including RF engineers, data scientists, and mission analysts.
  • Contribute to research efforts on novel RF-based UAS detection methods including AI.

This role will:

  • Set the strategy and technology roadmap for signal processing and development.
  • Influence decision-making and strategic planning for signal programs.
  • Determine new areas for software technology introduction or proof-of-concepts based on industry trends.
  • Research and evaluation of emerging technology, industry, and market trends to assist in project development and/or operational support activities.

Qualifications:

  • B.S. or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical discipline. A minimum of 8 years of professional experience. Note: Military experience is equivalent to professional experience.
  • Proficient in C++ and MATLAB for algorithm development and simulation.
  • Experience in RF signal detection, demodulation, and characterization.
  • Strong background in reverse engineering wireless communication protocols.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD security clearance.

No Clearance

title: Administrativ medarbejder til Børnekulturhuset
description:
Om Jobbet:
Børnekulturhuset i Aarhus søger en administrativ medarbejder til forskellige administrative opgaver, koordinering, kommunikation og borgerkontakt. Vi tilbyder en varieret hverdag præget af kultur, læring og travlhed, hvor dine dage ikke vil være ens.

Som administrativ medarbejder får du en central og alsidig rolle, hvor du fungerer som Børnekulturhuset og ULF – Ud & Lær’s digitale og koordinerende anker. Stillingen rummer et bredt ansvar fordelt på fire hovedområder:

  • IT-drift & Systemadministration: Du varetager den daglige drift af vores centrale systemer, herunder Gecko (lokalebooking), Pretix (tilmelding) og Paxton (adgangskontrol). Du har desuden ansvaret for drift af udlejningslokalerne "Stubbene", herunder brugerkontrol, udsendelse af fakturaer og booking.
  • Digital Kommunikation & Web: Du står for redigering og opdatering af vores hjemmesider i Drupal og Umbraco (fx. Ulfiaarhus.dk og boernekulturaarhus.dk). Her opretter du events og nyheder samt administrerer ULF-portalen i dialog med eksterne udbydere. Du står ligeledes for opsætning af nyhedsbreve i HeyLoyalty og formidling af aktiviteter på Facebook.
  • Koordinering & Service: Du er den primære kontaktperson for borgere, kunstnere, dagtilbud og skoler. Du koordinerer workshops og forløb og fungerer som administrativ nøgleperson ved større arrangementer og festivaler. Du anvender Plandisc og Planner.
  • Kerneadministration & Projektsupport: Du mestrer de kommunale systemer og varetager bl.a. den daglige drift af Børnekulturhusets hovedpostkasser, indkøb via TrueTrade samt administration af møder og seminarer. Du indgår desuden i administrative processer omkring lokale, nationale og internationale projekter, herunder koordinering, opfølgning og afrapportering


Din profil:
Du er uddannet kontorassistent med speciale i offentlig administration. Du trives i en rolle, hvor høj fleksibilitet og evnen til at skifte mellem digitale systemer, borgerkontakt og struktur går hånd i hånd med praktisk opgaveløsning og samarbejde på tværs af organisationen.

Du er struktureret og detaljeorienteret, men trives også i et kreativt miljø med liv og kaos fra børn, kunstnere og kolleger. Selvom dit primære arbejde er digitalt, hjælper du gerne med hverdagens praktiske opgaver (bemærk: huset har mange trapper og ingen elevator).

Du kan balancere fokuseret skærmarbejde med uforudsete hasteopgaver. Du er serviceminded, tålmodig og skaber gode relationer til alle samarbejdspartnere. Du evner at arbejde selvstændigt, har et stærkt overblik og kommunikerer klart og professionelt.



Derfor skal du vælge os:

  • En spændende og varieret stilling i et dynamisk og kreativt miljø.
  • Gode muligheder for både personlig og faglig udvikling.
  • En positiv, inkluderende og samarbejdsorienteret arbejdskultur.
  • Løn efter kvalifikationer og attraktive ansættelsesvilkår.


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer.

Ugentligt timetal: 32

Der vil blive indhentet privat straffeattest og ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at attesten ikke viser, at du er uegnet/uværdig til stillingen. Du kan læse mere her om hvordan vi behandler dine oplysninger her. Stillingen er til enhver tid betinget af en tilfredsstillende privat straffeattest.

Der vil blive indhentet børneattest og ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at attesten ikke viser, at du er uegnet/uværdig til stillingen. Du kan læse mere her om hvordan vi behandler dine oplysninger her. Stillingen er til enhver tid betinget af en anmærkningsfri børneattest.



Hvis du vil vide mere:
Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til Kommunikations- og projektmedarbejder, Karina Rask Nordtorp på telefon 41856670



Ansøgning:
Klik på ”Søg stillingen” ude i højre side for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Kopi af eksamensbevis skal vedlægges.

Ansøgningsfrist: 16. august 2026

Vi forventer, at 1. samtale finder sted den 1. september om eftermiddagen. Evt. 2. samtale finder sted den 4. september.



Om os:
Børnekulturhuset i Aarhus er en lille kulturinstitution i Kultur og Borgerservice, Aarhus Kommune med lokaler på Brobjergskolen i Aarhus C. Børnekulturhuset udvikler kunst- og kulturtilbud til skoler, dagtilbud og børnefamilier i samarbejde med kulturinstitutioner og kunstnere og varetager forskellige forvaltningsmæssige opgaver med relation til børn, unge og kultur.

Afdelingen ULF i Aarhus – Ud og Lær er en del af Børnekulturhuset. Det er Aarhus Kommunes indsats for, at den pædagogiske værdi i kulturinstitutioner og natur- og idrætsfaglige miljøers særlige læringsrum inddrages i dagtilbud, skoler og ungdomsuddannelser, så læring, oplevelse og faglighed kan gå hånd i hånd.

We design, build and service cutting-edge equipment that helps our customers manufacture display and semiconductor chips – the brains of devices we use every day. As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world – like AI and IoT. description:

About this Opportunity

Reporting to the Assistant Director for Freshman Recruitment, the Admissions Counselor is responsible for ensuring accurate, consistent and friendly customer service is provided to prospective students, families, guidance counselors and other influencers who interact with the Office of Admissions.

Additional responsibilities of this position include providing recruitment and outreach support to transfer and international applicants, managing a recruitment portfolio and/or territory, budget planning, and using and adapting to CRM and other existing and emerging recruitment and office technology.

The ideal candidate:

  • is a trusted teammate

  • is an excellent communicator

Traveling in-state and/or out-of-state for recruitment travel. (35%)

  • Reviewing undergraduate applications 1-5 days per week during peak application review season. (approximately November to March). (25%)

Equivalent education and/or experience may substitute for minimum qualifications except when there are legal requirements, such as a license, certification, and/or registration.

  • Must be flexible and have the drive to work in a fast-paced office.

The Office of Admissions is a unit within the Division of Enrollment Management. title: Børnehuset Ole Rømer søger 3 pædagogmedhjælpere
description:
Om jobbet:
Vores medhjælpere skal starte på studie og ud og rejse og derfor søger vi 3 medhjælpere med start medio august – september.

Der er tale om to flyverstillinger og en stilling på en gruppe. Ved flyver stillingerne vil du blive tilknyttet to teams og ved gruppestillingen vil du blive tilknyttet et team – to grupper med hver 13 børn og to pædagoger og en medhjælper fast tilknyttet hver gruppe. Du vil også skulle varetage en flyverfunktion i teamet.

I vuggestuen skal vi skabe de bedst mulige rammer for børns udvikling, trivsel og læring – dette så børnene kan mestre det næste. Vi forventer du vil kunne bidrage aktivt til dette – blandt andet via samarbejde med kollegaer, samarbejde med forældre, aktiv deltagelse i dagligdagen og på møder, engageret og imødekommende tilgang til børnene.


Din profil:
Vi søger pædagogmedhjælpere, som kan støtte op om vores mål om at være en højkvalitetsvuggestue hvor:

medarbejderne har de fornødne faglige kvalifikationer i forhold til at udføre pædagogisk arbejde og løbende tilbydes faglig udvikling

medarbejderne har et mål med deres daglige arbejde med børnene og har fokus på kvalitet i interaktionen med børnene

Vi prioriterer at strukturere vores hverdag, så børnene kan inddeles i små grupper med nærvær og fælles opmærksomhed, som fokus

forskellighed ses som betydningsfuld og et bidrag til at udføre kerneopgaven bedst muligt – Forskellighed i kraft af at være pædagog, medhjælper eller forældre og forskelligheden som menneske - det vi har med os

børn, forældre, kollegaer og ledelse mødes med tillid, positiv tilgang, åbenhed og varme

vores fysiske rammer understøtter den pædagogiske praksis

børn og forældre oplever tryghed i mødet med vuggestuelivet

vi serverer et sundt, nærende og indbydende måltid, økologisk mad

vi tør tænke nyt og anderledes.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Ansættelsen er en medhjælperstilling med en gennemsnitlig ugentlig arbejdstid på 37 timer, som udgangspunkt. Du skal kunne tiltræde medio august eller 1. september 2026 eller hurtigst muligt derefter. Der afholdes samtaler løbende.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer, medmindre stillingen er omfattet af en forhåndsaftale, som kan danne grundlag for lønfastsættelsen.

Der vil blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest og ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at attesterne ikke viser, at du er uegnet/uværdig til stillingen. Du kan læse mere her om hvordan vi behandler dine oplysninger her.

Hvis du vil vide mere:
Ansøgningsfrist er søndag den 16. august 2026.


Ansøgning:
Klik på linket ”SØG JOB” for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Ansøgningen skal være os i hænde senest den 16. august 2026 Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Om os:

Børnehuset Ole Rømer er en vuggestue med 91 børn fra ca. 9 måneder til ca. 3 år, fordelt på syv stuer. Der er 26 ansatte. Vi placeret på Frederiksbjerg i Aarhus C. Vi er del af Frederiksbjerg Dagtilbud, som har i alt 8 afdelinger.



Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

description:

Webber is headquartered in Houston, Texas, with offices and projects in the United States and Canada. Webber supports a wide range of project models to meet client needs, including traditional design bid build, design build, alternative delivery models and public private partnership (P3) solutions. Webber also has an in-house engineering services department to help optimize building efficiency and quality while solving complex project challenges using field experience, innovative construction methods and BIM technology. As a subsidiary of Ferrovial, Webber has access to a global network of skilled engineers, best-in-class technology and vast resources.

Job Description:

Inspiring Career Opportunity

Are you passionate about employee benefits, retirement programs, and helping employees navigate their benefits with confidence? Webber, an industry leader in construction and infrastructure, is seeking a Benefits Specialist to join our team in The Woodlands, Texas.

As a subsidiary of the global infrastructure leader Ferrovial, Webber is dedicated to intelligent solutions and sustainable development, impacting communities and advancing the industry. With a workforce of approximately 3,500 employees, we know our success is built on our people. That's where you come in.

Your Role: Supporting Employee Wellness and Benefits Excellence

As a Benefits Specialist, you will play a key role in administering and supporting Webber's employee benefits programs with a strong emphasis on retirement plans, wellness initiatives, and vendor administration. You will serve as a trusted resource to employees, helping them understand and maximize their benefits while ensuring compliance, accuracy, and exceptional customer service across all benefit-related processes.

Fluency in English and Spanish is required, as this role regularly supports a diverse employee population across the organization.

  • Administer and support 401(k) and retirement programs, including funding, audits, testing, and employee inquiries.
  • Review, reconcile, and process monthly benefits vendor invoices and billing.
  • Conduct eligibility and enrollment audits to ensure data accuracy and compliance.
  • Manage HSA account issues, Evidence of Insurability (EOI) tracking, and vendor reporting.
  • Administer Wellness@Webber programs, communications, and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Assist with annual enrollment activities and employee benefits education.
  • Provide bilingual (English/Spanish) support to employees regarding benefits questions and programs.
  • Partner with vendors, internal stakeholders, and participating employers to support benefits administration and process improvements.
  • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

  • 3-5 years of Benefits or Human Resources experience, including retirement plan administration.
  • Strong knowledge of 401(k) programs, benefits administration, and compliance practices.
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish (required).
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, human resources, or related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Workday, and UKG preferred.
  • PHR or SHRM certification is a plus.
  • Highly organized with strong analytical, auditing, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills with the ability to work across all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining confidentiality and attention to detail.
  • Team-oriented professional capable of working independently and collaboratively.

What You'll Love: The Webber Advantage

  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career development.
  • Collaborative culture that values innovation, teamwork, and employee engagement.
  • Exposure to enterprise-wide benefits and wellness initiatives.
  • Meaningful work that directly impacts employee well-being and experience.
  • A company committed to safety, sustainability, and serving the communities where we live and work.

Ready to Support the People Who Build Our Success?

At Webber, we believe our employees are our greatest asset. As a Benefits Specialist, you will help ensure our workforce receives the support, resources, and benefits they need to thrive. If you are passionate about employee benefits, wellness, and delivering outstanding service, we encourage you to apply today.

Seize the challenge. Move the world together! Innovative, creative, respectful, and diverse are some of the ways we describe ourselves. We are motivated by challenges, and we collaborate across our business units to move the world together. Your journey to a fulfilling career starts here!

title: Fixed Wing Aviation SME
description:
Fixed Wing Aviation SME

As an expert in defense missions, your unique background inspires you to think bigger, push further, and ask questions others don’t. Work with us to identify, analyze, and evaluate systems and policies as part of service missions. Further your career while creating mission-forward solutions that matter.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

title: Financial Aid Service Specialist, FAME
description:
We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. If you are interested in joining our growing team, please apply to thislinkdirectly.

Who we are

At Aquila, we invest in category-defining B2B/B2G software companies globally, acting as a thought-partner, striving for the success of our companies in the long term. We are a well-managed, profitable company that operates like a startup with the financial backing of a parent company. For our people, this means limitless possibilities.

We are unapologetically unique, pivoting to respond to the needs of the multiple markets we operate in. We have ambitious goals, and we are looking for genuine contributors with integrity, energy, flexibility, and loyalty. We are investing in building future leaders who can take an idea and make things happen.

Who we need

For over 45 years, Fame has been a trusted partner to post-secondary schools. We recognize the challenges career school administrators face in managing their institutions, from streamlining operations to ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements. At Fame, we provide the support and tools needed to navigate these complexities and run academic institutions efficiently. Our student information systems, supporting tools, and Admission CRM Software, including powerful EDlumina, help simplify and streamline these processes.

We are looking for a Financial Aid Service Specialist to join our remote Financial Aid Services team. Reporting to the Director, Product Strategy & Operations, you will help institutions navigate complex financial aid processes—from advising on packaging logic to documenting resolutions—with precision and confidence. You will provide exceptional customer service across all channels, delivering clear and accurate answers to financial aid and software-related questions. You will support school financial aid offices by interpreting policies and regulations, guiding them through system functionality, and ensuring compliance in every interaction. Collaborating with internal teams, you will contribute to achieving seamless client outcomes and maintaining resources, including SOPs and knowledge base articles.

This is a remote-first role from anywhere in the United States, with working hours aligned to the Eastern Time zone.

Who you are

You are a financial-aid professional—perhaps currently working in a trade school, college, or university—who is ready to bring your expertise to the vendor side. You understand that accuracy, responsiveness, and strict compliance are non-negotiable in supporting institutional aid operations. You have a solid track record of interpreting and applying federal and state regulations.
You are an empathetic and patient communicator who can explain technical or regulatory information in plain, direct language that supports decision-making by administrative users.

What’s in it for you

Purpose. You want to be part of a mission-driven organization where your expertise helps schools remain compliant, efficient, and focused on student success by ensuring that financial aid processes run smoothly, comply with regulations, and enable access to education for students. You are motivated by work that reduces administrative burden and improves the ability of schools to serve their communities.

Stability. You want to join a long-standing, profitable, and growing organization that values excellence, integrity, and lasting relationships. You are looking for a team where your expertise is respected and your contributions matter. You will gain a broader understanding of the education and financial aid landscape, working closely with institutions to see how technology and compliance intersect to support student success.

Professional growth. Many of the senior leaders at FAME began in this role. You will be part of a team that values internal growth and creates clear paths for advancement—whether that means moving into a team lead or manager role, or exploring new opportunities in areas like QA, product development, or consulting. As part of the Constellation Software family, you will also have access to a broad network of companies and the ability to explore new roles across a global portfolio. Your growth will be supported through mentorship, internal mobility, and opportunities to take your career in the direction that works best for you.

How you will make an impact:

  • Case management and client support. You will triage incoming cases, calls, and chats related to financial aid software, ensuring timely and accurate responses. You will assist school administrators with interpreting financial aid policies, regulations, and system functionality to support effective program management. You will offer real-time support through chat and phone with a professional and friendly approach. You will provide same-day responses whenever possible and maintain consistent follow-up, handling sensitive client information with confidentiality and integrity.

  • Problem resolution and collaboration. You will participate in “swarm” problem-solving sessions to resolve complex issues, leveraging team knowledge and expertise. You will engage in group communication channels to share insights and work toward efficient, client-focused solutions. You will participate in scheduled team meetings, training sessions, and webinars to remain current and aligned.

  • Knowledge sharing and process improvement. You will contribute to the development of knowledge base articles and standard operating procedures to enhance client resources and streamline internal workflows. You will take part in continuous learning and knowledge sharing to drive ongoing improvement across the team.

  • Institutional partnership. You will serve as a trusted resource for financial aid professionals at colleges and universities, providing expertise on compliance, packaging processes, and regulatory guidelines. You will ensure that institutional staff have the guidance needed to manage federal aid programs effectively.

Here’s what you bring:

  • The experience. You have a strong background in financial aid administration, including Title IV awarding, packaging, certifying, disbursing, and performing return calculations. You have served as a lead advisor or in a similar role at a trade school, technical school, college, or university, with experience packaging and managing student financial aid. You are skilled at interpreting and applying federal and state regulations, guiding institutional staff through complex questions, and managing cases from inquiry to resolution with clear documentation and follow-through. You bring proven customer service experience, ideally from a call center, help desk, or high-volume support environment.

  • The knowledge. You have a deep understanding of federal and state financial aid regulations, including NSLDS reporting, eligibility determination, verification processes, and Title IV disbursement requirements. Familiarity with Fame Freedom, Freedom FinAid, Advantage, and Advantage FinAid applications is preferred. You stay current with regulatory changes and can interpret new guidance to inform client decisions and ensure compliance.

  • The technical skills. You are proficient in financial aid management and student information systems, with strong skills in Microsoft Office applications. You are comfortable using AI-enabled tools and can learn new technologies quickly. You can leverage AI for knowledge retrieval, workflow optimization, and client support enhancements and are comfortable working within chatbots, automated ticketing systems, or AI-enhanced help desk platforms to streamline support. You are analytical, detail-oriented, and client-focused with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

  • The interpersonal skills. You have excellent verbal and written communication abilities. You can interact confidently with administrative, financial, and operational teams at schools, delivering clear information and support and translating technical guidance for nontechnical audiences. You are a collaborative team member in a virtual environment. You are responsive, exercise sound judgment, and understand the importance of tone, timing, and clarity in every exchange. You value inclusivity and show respect for differing perspectives.

  • The flexibility. You are available to travel on occasion to client sites and attend conferences to deliver in-person training and strengthen relationships.

Why join?

Aquila is a division of Constellation Software Inc., one of the largest and most successful software companies in Canada and the most successful technology stock in Canada over the last 10 years [TSE: CSU].

Our entrepreneurial culture, lean environment, and people come together to form a dynamic organization where purpose drives our growth. This is a place where high performance and hard work are rewarded, where leaders are grown, and where the best ideas win. With the autonomy to be creative and curious, we collaborate and iterate to achieve real impact in the communities we support.

We spend our days asking questions and challenging the status quo, manipulating our structure, roles, and internal operations in order to stay ahead in a competitive landscape.

If you share our growth mindset, relationship-focused approach, and high moral fiber, you will thrive at Aquila.

Apply now.

Diversity and inclusion are not mere words on paper to us. We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have most of the qualifications we are seeking, and want to play an integral role in our success, apply to express your interest.

What you can expect from our interview process:

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor will discuss your interest in the role and your background in family services and counselling. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.

  • A virtual technical interview with the Manager, Customer Success to review your financial knowledge and customer service approach.

  • A virtual interview with the CEO, FAME. You will have the opportunity to learn more about their career path and ask any final questions about the role, company and mission.

Aquila welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. If you are interested in joining our growing team, please apply to thislinkdirectly.

title: Cybersecurity Architect
description:

As a Cybersecurity Architect on our project, you’ll lead the architecture and design efforts of innovative cybersecurity solutions and service offerings to protect federal networks. You’ll lead the team through a critical approach to network and systems design, providing alternatives and customizing solutions to maintain a balance of security and mission needs. This is a chance to make a difference in the security of the government. Your technical expertise will be vital as you help customers overcome their most difficult challenges by leading cybersecurity technologies and domains, including IoT and Cloud security, Automation and Orchestration (A&O), identity and access management, and machine learning.

Join our team, as we tackle cybersecurity challenges and shape opportunities to implement solutions and service offerings leveraging investments and proven capabilities.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 8+ years of experience with cybersecurity

  • 5+ years of experience in network architecture and design

  • Experience architecting Zero Trust solutions, roadmaps, and capabilities in alignment with industry standards, including NIST 800-207 and DoD Zero Trust Reference Architecture

  • Experience leading product selection initiatives, including perimeter defense, zero trust, A&O, AI, analytics, secure DevOps, identity and access management, or network access control

title: Deployment Strategist - London
description:
Murphy AI is a next-generation debt collection platform powered by artificial intelligence, designed to optimize recovery rates while maintaining respectful and personalized communication. Our advanced automation streamlines the process of collecting overdue invoices for businesses, providing a seamless and effective solution.

At Murphy AI, we’re tackling one of the toughest challenges in fintech: making debt recovery more efficient, autonomous and scalable. Our AI-powered agents adapt instantly, engaging with debtors across channels like voice, email and sms to maximize results while preserving trust. By combining advanced artificial intelligence with powerful automation, we’re setting a new standard for how businesses recover payments.

As a fast-growing startup that has already made an impact within less than a year in the market, we are building a talented team to scale our operations and drive our vision forward 🌟

💼 About the Role

We are looking for a Deployment Strategist to own the successful transition from signed contract to validated roll-out.

You will lead the client relationship during the POC phase, ensure the solution is properly configured and deployed, and drive the POC toward a clear exit decision (go / no-go / expansion).

This role combines client leadership, commercial instinct, and structured execution to transform signed opportunities into scalable, high-performing live accounts.

You are not a project coordinator. You are the single-threaded owner of POC success and conversion.

📝 Responsibilities

Drive POC exit and roll-out conversion

  • Convert ≥ X% of POCs into validated roll-outs within agreed timelines.

  • Lead structured conversations toward clear go / no-go / expansion decisions.

  • Ensure POCs do not drift without commercial direction.

Deliver structured, on-time POC execution

  • Define milestones, scope, risks, and dependencies from day one.

  • Maintain full visibility for both clients and internal teams.

  • Prevent firefighting through proactive alignment and execution discipline.

Improve performance through structured iteration

  • Monitor core KPIs throughout the POC.

  • Work closely with Solutions Engineers to drive measurable performance improvements.

  • Translate performance evolution into clear, executive-level narratives for clients.

Align internal teams around outcomes

  • Ensure Solutions Engineering, Integrations, Legal, Account Management, and Product remain aligned and unblocked.

  • Act as the central coordination point during the POC phase.

  • Escalate early and clearly when needed — never late.

📚 Requirements

  • Analytical & Outcome focused: Ability to translate data insights into action, works with measurable success criteria and continuously evaluates outcomes to pivot strategy when needed.

  • Client Centric & Relationship Leadership: Builds trust with client stakeholders through clear communication, proactive problem solving, and demonstrated ownership of delivering value.

  • Operational Delivery & Execution Excellence: Manages complex, multi-task initiatives with rigor, from initial setup and launch through iterative refinement, milestone tracking, and final reporting.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Works effectively with product, engineering, sales, operations and solutions engineers to align on technical needs, surface product insights, and iterate assets like dashboards owned by OPS and configurations supported by tech, where necessary

  • Commercial Acumen: Understands business contexts and outcomes to identify meaningful upsell/expansion paths and makes data-backed cases for next steps.

🤝 What we offer

📈 Stock options: Because we all build Murphy together – you'll own a piece of what we’re creating.

🧩 Impact: Be part of our startup journey from day one, playing a key role in our growth and building something meaningful from the ground up.

📚 Learning: Continuous development through trainings, knowledge-sharing, and exposure to other top-tier startups in our ecosystem.

🍱 We are currently designing our Benefits package for London. Please stay tuned.

🛜 Hybrid & Flexible: Our default setup is hybrid – 3 days a week at our office in London, surrounded by a thriving tech scene, and 2 days of remote work. But if there’s one thing that defines us, it’s flexibility: we trust you to organize your time and space in the way that helps you do your best work.

📚 Our Process

We believe that hiring is a two-way street: while we get to know you, you also deserve the chance to understand who we are, how we work, and what makes Murphy AI special. Here’s what you can expect:

1️⃣ First Interview – Getting to Know You
A conversation with a future teammate who’s excited to find a new colleague. We’ll talk about your story, what drives you, and what you’re looking for next—no trick questions, just a genuine exchange.

2️⃣ Second Interview – Deep Dive
You’ll meet the Hiring Manager and potentially another team member. This is a more technical discussion where we explore your skills in detail, walk through real scenarios, and answer any questions you might have about the role.

3️⃣ Tech Assessment or Business Case
A practical exercise to see how you approach challenges similar to those you’d tackle at Murphy. You’ll have time to reflect and showcase your thinking—no rush, no surprises.

4️⃣ Meet the Founders
Finally, you’ll get to meet with the founders and the Hiring Manager. It’s the perfect opportunity to experience our culture firsthand and meet more of the team who could soon be your colleagues.

👉 To learn more about how we hire and what to expect at every step, feel free to explore our Hiring Guide!

👉 We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where everyone, regardless of background, identity, or experience, feels valued and empowered to thrive. We believe that different perspectives drive innovation and success, and we actively foster an environment where all voices are heard and respected.

We are seeking a Senior Backend Developer focused on high-throughput platform development to design, build, and operate the foundational platforms and shared services that other engineering teams rely on to deliver their products. This role focuses on building backend platform capabilities — request routing, traffic management, data fan-out, caching layers, asynchronous job execution, and durable event processing — that must handle very high traffic volumes with predictable latency and minimal operational toil. The ideal candidate combines deep distributed systems expertise with strong platform-engineering instincts, values internal developer experience as a first-class concern, and has a track record of leading multi-quarter platform initiatives that meaningfully raise the engineering bar for the organizations they support.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and build internal platform services and shared infrastructure that hundreds of engineers depend on every day, with explicit focus on developer experience and operational ergonomics.
  • Architect high-throughput, latency-sensitive backend platforms capable of sustaining very high request volumes with predictable, well-bounded tail latency.
  • Build durable, replayable event-processing pipelines and asynchronous job execution platforms that other product teams compose to ship features faster.
  • Design and operate caching, rate-limiting, and request-shaping layers that protect upstream systems and enable safe scaling under bursty workloads.
  • Develop platform abstractions, SDKs, and paved-road libraries that codify best practices and let product teams consume capabilities without re-implementing them.
  • Establish robust observability, SLOs, and capacity-planning practices for platform services, raising the operational bar across the organization.
  • Drive multi-region, fault-tolerant, and geo-distributed designs with rigorous attention to availability, durability, and graceful degradation under failure.
  • Lead incident response for high-impact platform issues, conduct blameless post-mortems, and drive durable engineering improvements that prevent recurrence.
  • Define and enforce platform-wide standards around API design, schema evolution, deployment, and backward-compatibility guarantees.
  • Optimize platform performance through careful profiling, data-driven tuning, and algorithmic improvements that move the needle on throughput and cost.
  • Partner with infrastructure, security, and SRE teams to ensure platform services meet enterprise reliability, compliance, and security obligations.
  • Mentor mid-level engineers and lead architectural discussions across teams, helping the broader organization grow in distributed-systems maturity.
  • Produce clear technical design documents, decision records, and operational runbooks that make the platform legible to future maintainers.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging platform technologies, open-source projects, and architectural patterns for strategic adoption.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Six or more years of professional backend or platform engineering experience.
  • Demonstrated track record building and operating internal platforms or shared services consumed by multiple engineering teams.
  • Strong, hands-on expertise designing distributed systems with rigorous attention to consistency, availability, latency, and failure-mode behavior.
  • Advanced proficiency in at least one major backend language such as Java, Go, Scala, Rust, or modern C++.
  • Deep understanding of high-throughput messaging, streaming, and event-driven architectures using technologies such as Kafka, Pulsar, or NATS.
  • Strong working knowledge of data storage systems across relational, key-value, document, and search workloads.
  • Proven experience leading multi-quarter platform initiatives across teams, including stakeholder management and technical decision-making.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including ability to author crisp technical design documents and present trade-offs clearly.

title: Data Product Ops Lead
description:
Stand Together is a philanthropic community that helps America’s boldest changemakers tackle the root causes of our country’s biggest problems, from education to the economy, broken communities, and toxic division, among dozens of other pressing issues. We provide our partners with access to resources including funding, thought leadership, a network of peers, and a playbook for applying proven principles to transform lives and society.
The Enterprise Data & Information (EDI) team is seeking a Data Product Ops Lead to architect, run, and mature the Product + Analysis operating model for the organization. This is a player–coach leadership role that designs the operating system for how we prioritize, define, deliver, and scale data products, while also directly supporting the execution of the most strategic products in-flight.
You will step into a high-functioning team and immediately develop and drive a capability maturity plan. You will also partner with other core capabilities (Engineering & Platform, Data Governance) to ensure EDI delivers high-quality, AI-ready, strategically aligned data products at scale.

How You Will Contribute

    Capability Leadership & Operating Model Strategy

  • Own and evolve the Product Operating Model capability, defining standards, processes, structures, and rhythms for predictable, high‑quality delivery.
  • Within 60–90 days, conduct a start/stop/continue assessment of current practices; sequence improvements without pausing delivery.
  • Lead the full Product + Analysis function (AI/Technical PM, Analysts) to operate with clarity, cohesion, and shared direction.
  • Work closely with Engineering & Platform to align roadmaps, enforce SLAs/SLOs, adopt standards, and maintain platform reliability and observability.
  • Build productive relationships across domain stakeholder groups (Finance & Strategy, Audience, etc.) and enterprise governance bodies.

    • Governance, Prioritization & Lifecycle Ownership

  • Define and run the end‑to‑end data product lifecycle, including artifacts, stage gates, and decision rights.
  • Drive evidence‑based prioritization (e.g., RICE); ensure consistent intake, triage, and governance for every product/enhancement and enable transparent prioritization and trade‑off decisions across competing needs in the product portfolio.

    • Strategy + Execution (Player–Coach Delivery)

  • Personally lead strategy and delivery for select, high‑impact data products as needed—especially during strategic moments or capability transitions.
  • Work side‑by‑side with senior PMs and Analysts to shape requirements, define success metrics, support prototyping, and validate that outputs are meaningful and AI‑ready.
  • Ensure ongoing product delivery continues at pace while the operating model matures (no “pause” on execution).
    • Product Operations, Measurement & Continuous Improvement
  • Establish KPIs for product maturity, predictability, throughput, quality, adoption, satisfaction, and artifact/documentation compliance.
  • Publish dashboards for leadership visibility; drive continuous improvement against targets.
  • Embed AI‑assisted practices into product workflows (requirements, documentation, prototype testing, user guidance).

What You Will Bring

  • 6–10 years in Product Management, Product Operations, Delivery Management, or similar strategy/execution leadership roles.
  • Proven ability to enter an active organization and rapidly diagnose operating gaps; implement a pragmatic start/stop/continue plan.
  • Demonstrated success leading senior contributors (PMs, Analysts, Engineers) through influence, clarity, structure, and partnership.
  • Experience building and governing product operating models (prioritization frameworks, lifecycle discipline, governance).
  • Track record of translating strategy into execution as a player–coach (able to own critical products/workstreams hands‑on).
  • Comfort operating in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments with evolving roles, processes, and technologies.
  • Strong facilitation and communication skills across technical and non‑technical stakeholders; excellent alignment skills.
  • Experience partnering with data engineering, analytics, and platform teams.
  • Enthusiasm to contribute to Stand Together's vision and principled approach to solving problems, and a commitment to stewarding our culture, which champions values including transformation and innovation, entrepreneurialism, humility, and respect.

Standout Candidates Will Bring

  • Experience in data product management, analytics product development, or enterprise data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, dbt, semantic layers).
  • Familiarity with federated governance/data mesh and AI‑enabled product workflows.
  • Experience in Finance & Strategy or adjacent enterprise data domain approaches.
  • Product Owner or Product Management certification (e.g., CSPO).

What We Offer

    • Competitive benefits: Enjoy a 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting, flexible time off, comprehensive health and dental plans, plus wellness and mental health support through Peloton and Talkspace.
    • A meaningful career: Join a passionate community of over 1,300 employees dedicated to improving lives and driving innovative solutions to complex social challenges.
    • Commitment to growth: Thrive in a non-hierarchical environment that empowers employees to discover, develop and apply their unique talents.
    • Competitive compensation: Our approach rewards the value you create through competitive salaries and bonus opportunities, allowing you to share in the success you help drive.
Our Values: Working for an organization within the Stand Together philanthropic community is different from many other places. The culture is deeply rooted in Principle Based Management® (PBM®), a framework guided by the principles that drive human progress, such as dignity, openness, and bottom-up empowerment. PBM® empowers employees to be entrepreneurial, to innovate, and to continually drive transformation.
We believe diversity fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success. That is why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and strive to treat all employees and applicants with honesty, dignity, and respect.

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
Neat brings people together with beautifully simple, versatile video devices and experiences. By minimising the physical and virtual divide, we enable everyone to feel more connected, present and understood, however they prefer to work. Neat's pioneering portfolio addresses the needs of today's workplace and natively supports Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Google and a range of compelling business apps.

We are an ambitious, accountable, collaborative, responsible, and growing team that fosters an environment where creativity and ingenuity can flourish. We strive to bring out the best in our Neaters and make amazing products and experiences. We are headquartered in Oslo with Neaters working all over the world, and a new office in Cambridge.

The Opportunity

We are looking for bright and enthusiastic AI/software engineers to join our R&D team in Cambridge or Oslo as we continue the next chapter of product development on Neat Open, our solution to the world of hybrid collaboration technology. As an AI/software engineer, you will work on everything from research and design to testing and delivering AI-centric features across our entire product range.

You will be part of a small, dynamic team and happy to get stuck into a variety of engineering problems. You will be part of bleeding-edge product development, building AI-powered features, be they on Neat devices or in the cloud. Modalities for AI include all of audio, video, and text, resulting in a rich, challenging and novel environment.

This is a hybrid research-and-product role — you'll be expected to explore emerging AI capabilities and bring them into production, working closely with a tight-knit and supportive engineering team.

AI Research & Innovation

  • Proactively stay on top of the latest developments in AI agents, visual understanding, and acoustic/audio models — and discuss relevant findings with the engineering and leadership teams.

  • Maintain a working understanding of transformer architectures and how they extend to multimodal (audio + visual) inputs

  • Research and evaluate new AI technologies for meeting room applications, presenting clear pros/cons to engineering and leadership

  • Use and experiment with cloud AI services (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) to prototype and validate new ideas

Product Development

  • Deliver AI features end-to-end across our products, working closely with the software engineering team

  • Monitor production AI features and develop evaluations to detect and prevent quality regressions across our products

  • Develop and maintain high-quality software in Go, Kotlin, and TypeScript/React

  • Collaborate with designers and product managers to build simple, intuitive experiences

  • Design technical architectures jointly with the product and engineering team

  • Participate in code review and help uphold a strong engineering culture


About you
You will have achieved excellent academic results from a leading university or be able to demonstrate outstanding technical skills and be proficient in English. You will be excited by working on a combination of AI topics and production software engineering. We don't expect you to be strong across every area — if you bring deep expertise in some and genuine curiosity in the rest, we're happy to invest in your growth.

We are looking for a team player who thinks holistically, enjoys solving complex problems and thrives working autonomously, while not afraid to ask for input and learn from your teammates if you’re stuck.

You should take pride in your work and want a career where your creative abilities will make a difference in the world of technology, whilst being part of an impressive R&D environment.

About Neat

Founded in 2019, Neat was created to make the meeting space the best it can be. We understand the meeting space better than anyone else and we pour all our energy into every last detail of what we do.
